Chain Attacks against a Stunned enemy have an additional 30% increased Anomalia Buildup Rate.When any squad member Stuns an enemy, gain 2 stacks of Dance Prowess, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, lasting 15s. With Dance Prowess, when a heavy Ataque from Nangong Yu's Ataque Especial EX: The Unbearable Weight of Love, Ataque Básico: Adorable Explosive Impacto, or Suporte Rápido: Emergency Save hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomalia, 1 stack of Dance Prowess is consumed to trigger the special Disorder effect Polarity Disorder against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's Suporte Rápido. Polarity Disorder does not clear the target's Attribute Anomalia. If the skill fails to trigger Polarity Disorder, Dance Prowess will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has Dance Prowess, the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of Ataque Básico: Adorable Explosive Impacto, which will always trigger precise charging.When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu's next Ataque Especial EX will not consume Energy. This effect lasts 15s and can trigger once every 15s.When Nangong Yu and Aria are in the same squad, if Aria's Ataque Básico: Perfect Pitch heavy Ataque hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomalia, and Nangong Yu fully participates in the Ataque, 1 stack of Dance Prowess will also be consumed to trigger Polarity Disorder on the enemy.When the third hit of Nangong Yu's Ataque Básico: Adorable Explosive Impacto or Suprema (Ultimate): Meteor Shower hits an enemy, the enemy suffers Misstep. Under this effect, Atordoamento (Stun) DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and when an enemy becomes Stunned, their Atordoamento (Stun) duration increases by 3s. m1 quick reload cinema (mindscape) 1.name: M1 Quick Reload Cinema (Mindscape) 1
m1 quick reload cinema (mindscape) 1.desc: When Zhu Yuan activates Chain Attacks/Ultimates, gain the Quick Reload effect. When Zhu Yuan has the Quick Reload effect and uses up all Enhanced Shotshells, the Quick Reload effect will be consumed to instantly gain 6/9 Enhanced Shotshells.

m2 ether ember cinema (mindscape) 2.name: M2 Ether Ember Cinema (Mindscape) 2
m2 ether ember cinema (mindscape) 2.desc: In Suppressive Mode, Zhu Yuan’s Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG taken reduced by 10%. When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, the target takes 10% more Dano de Éter from Ataque Básico: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Ataque: Overwhelming Firepower DMG, stacking up to 5 times and lasting for 5s. Each shot adds one stack of this effect, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

m3 public security special training cine.name: M3 Public Security Special Training Cinema (Mindscape) 3
m3 public security special training cine.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

m4 ether perforation cinema (mindscape).name: M4 Ether Perforation Cinema (Mindscape) 4
m4 ether perforation cinema (mindscape).desc: When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, her Ataque Básico: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Ataque: Overwhelming Firepower ignore 25% of the target’s Ether RES.

m5 special ops experience cinema (mindsc.name: M5 Special Ops Experience Cinema (Mindscape) 5
m5 special ops experience cinema (mindsc.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

m6 expanded energy pack iii cinema (mind.name: M6 Expanded Energy Pack III Cinema (Mindscape) 6
m6 expanded energy pack iii cinema (mind.desc: When Zhu Yuan consumes a total of 12 Enhanced Shotshells, she receives the Ether Afterglow effect, and the Energy cost of the next Ataque Especial EX is reduced by 30. Launching an Ataque Especial EX will consume Ether Afterglow and shoot an additional 4-bullet Ether Buckshot. Each extra bullet deals DMG equal to 220% of Zhu Yuan's ATK.

alice.name: Ataque Básico: Celestial Overture
alice.desc: Press to activate: Perform up to 5 slashes forward, dealing Dano Físico. When Alice triggers Assault through Attribute Anomalia Buildup, the 5th hit of her next Ataque Básico is enhanced.

alice.name: Ataque Básico: Starshine Waltz
alice.desc: When Alice's Blade Etiquette reaches 1 bar, hold to activate: Hold to charge, expending up to 3 bars of Blade Etiquette. Release or when Blade Etiquette is below 1 bar, Alice performs a series of slashes in an area centered on the target enemy, with the number of hits determined by charge level, dealing massive Dano Físico. When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged Ataque Básico: Starshine Waltz hits, it triggers a special Assault effect: Polarized Assault. This deals DMG equal to 100.0% of the original Assault, ignoring Anomalia Buildup, and can interact with other Attribute Anomalies, including Physical, to trigger Disorder. Blade Etiquette does not accumulate when hitting an enemy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Esquiva: Jumpy Bunny
alice.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Dash Ataque: Blade-Dancer's Gale
alice.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

alice.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Ceremony of Swordlight
alice.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Ataque Especial: Piercing Dawn
alice.desc: Press to activate. Hurl the blade to strike and pass through enemies ahead, dealing Dano Físico. Upon activating this skill, a Perfect Esquiva can be triggered. After triggering a Perfect Esquiva, press to follow up with the 5th hit of a Ataque Básico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Ataque Especial EX: Aurora Thrust - Northern Cross
alice.desc: With enough energy, drag the stick/joystick forward and press to activate. A thrust Ataque that goes through enemies ahead, dealing massive Dano Físico. Activating the skill can trigger Perfect Esquiva and restores 10 Blade Etiquette. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Ataque Especial EX: Aurora Thrust - Southern Cross
alice.desc: With enough energy, and without moving the stick/joystick or when dragging it backwards, press to activate. Back away with a slash, then thrust forward, dealing Dano Físico. Activating the skill can trigger Perfect Esquiva and restores 10 Blade Etiquette. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Starfall Intermission
alice.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes powerful consecutive slashes at enemies ahead, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Starfall Finale
alice.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Dano Físico. Activating this skill restores 200 Blade Etiquette. Blade Etiquette does not accumulate when hitting an enemy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Ataque de Suporte: Cross Riposte
alice.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: SCharge forward and slash enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Suporte Defensivo: Parry Guard
alice.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Suporte Rápido: Intertwined Stab
alice.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

alice.name: Passiva de Núcleo Twin Rainbows of the Swordheart
alice.desc: Lv. 1

alice.name: Habilidade Adicional Mystery Hunt
alice.desc: When another character in your squad is an Anomalia or Suporte character:When any squad member triggers Disorder, Alice gains 30 Blade Etiquette.If Alice's Maestria de Anomalia exceeds 140, each additional point grants her 1.6 Proficiência de Anomalia.Upon entering the battlefield, Alice gains 300 Blade Etiquette. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.

alice.name: M1 Palmful of Cilantro Cinema (Mindscape) 1
alice.desc: When Alice triggers a Polarized Assault, she gains 25 Blade Etiquette. When she triggers Assault against an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 20% for 30s.

alice.name: M2 Sage at the Sword's Tip Cinema (Mindscape) 2
alice.desc: When Suprema (Ultimate): Starfall Finale's Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers Polarized Assault. All squad members' Assault DMG increases by 15%. Disorder DMG against enemies suffering from Physical Anomalia increases by 15%. Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.

alice.name: M3 Symmetrism Cinema (Mindscape) 3
alice.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

alice.name: M4 Rosemary on Her Lips Cinema (Mindscape) 4
alice.desc: Alice ignores 10% of the target's Physical RES. Enhanced Ataque Básico: Celestial Overture accumulates 25% more Physical Anomalia Buildup.

alice.name: M5 Passion for the Supernatural Cinema (Mindscape) 5
alice.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

alice.name: M6 A Heart of Thyme Cinema (Mindscape) 6
alice.desc: When Alice uses a third-stage charged Ataque Básico: Starshine Waltz or Suprema (Ultimate): Starfall Finale, she enters the Victory State for 30s. During this time, whenever any squad member lands a hit on a target, Alice will follow up with an extra Ataque against the target, dealing Dano Físico equal to 3,300% of her Proficiência de Anomalia. This effect can trigger once every 1s and is guaranteed to CRIT. This effect can trigger up to 6 times. Gaining the Victory State again refreshes the available trigger count.

anby.name: Ataque Básico: Turbo Volt
anby.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes up to 4 slashes. The first 3 hits deal Dano Físico the 4th hit deals Dano Elétrico.

anby.name: Ataque Básico: Thunderbolt
anby.desc: After unleashing the 3rd hit of the Ataque Básico, hold down or pause for a short while, and then press to activate. Unleashes a downward strike that deals Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

anby.name: Esquiva: Slide
anby.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anby.name: Dash Ataque: Taser Blast
anby.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Slashes all nearby enemies, dealing Dano Físico.

anby.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Thunderclap
anby.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anby.name: Ataque Especial: Fork Lightning
anby.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes an upward slash that deals Dano Elétrico. This Ataque launches faster when used after the 3rd-hit of the Ataque Básico or Ataque Básico: Thunderbolt. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

anby.name: Ataque Especial EX: Lightning Bolt
anby.desc: With enough energy, press to activate. Unleashes a powerful upward slash that deals Dano Elétrico. This Ataque launches faster when used after the 3rd hit of her Ataque Básico or Ataque Básico: Thunderbolt. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anby.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Electro Engine
anby.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate. Unleashes a powerful upwards slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anby.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Overdrive Engine
anby.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleashes a powerful upward slash at enemies in a small area followed by several falling attacks, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anby.name: Ataque de Suporte: Lightning Whirl
anby.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Perform a spinning slash against enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anby.name: Suporte Defensivo: Flash
anby.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anby.name: Suporte Rápido: Thunderfall
anby.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anby.name: Passiva de Núcleo Fluctuating Voltage
anby.desc: Lv. 1

anby.name: Habilidade Adicional Parallel Connection
anby.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:When Anby's Contra-ataque de Esquiva hits an enemy, she gains an extra 7.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

anby.name: M1 Rapid Charge Mode Cinema (Mindscape) 1
anby.desc: When the 4th-hit of Anby's Ataque Básico hits an enemy, her Energy Generation Rate is increased by 12% for 30s.

anby.name: M2 Precision Discharge Cinema (Mindscape) 2
anby.desc: When Ataque Básico: Thunderbolt hits a Stunned enemy, its DMG is increased by 30%. When Anby's Ataque Especial EX hits an enemy that is not Stunned, the Atordoamento (Daze) inflicted is increased by 10%.

anby.name: M3 Well-Disciplined Cinema (Mindscape) 3
anby.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

anby.name: M4 Conducting Charge Cinema (Mindscape) 4
anby.desc: When Anby launches a Ataque em Cadeia or uses her Suprema (Ultimate), off-field Electric Agents recover 3 Energy. For every 12% Energy Generation Anby Has, recover an additional 2 Energy, up to a maximum of 6.

anby.name: M5 Street Experience Cinema (Mindscape) 5
anby.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

anby.name: M6 Charging Field Cinema (Mindscape) 6
anby.desc: When Anby uses her Ataque Especial EX, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her Ataque Básico or Dash Ataque, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that Ataque's DMG by 45%.

anton.name: Ataque Básico: Enthusiastic Drills
anton.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes up to 4 mixed attacks in front, dealing Dano Físico. The 4th-hit is a Piledriver Ataque.

anton.name: Ataque Básico: Enthusiastic Drills (Burst Mode)
anton.desc: Press while Anton is in Burst Mode to activate: Unleashes up to 3 mixed attacks in front, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. During the 2nd Drill Ataque and 3rd Pile Driver Ataque, press repeatedly or hold to extend the skill duration.

anton.name: Esquiva: Let's Move
anton.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anton.name: Dash Ataque: Fire With Fire
anton.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Rams into enemies in front of him, dealing Dano Físico.

anton.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Retaliation
anton.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Continuously strikes enemies in front with heavy punches, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable during the Ataque.

anton.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Overload Drill (Burst Mode)
anton.desc: While in Burst Mode, press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Launch a Drill Ataque at enemies in front of him, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable during the Ataque.

anton.name: Ataque Especial: Spin, Bro!
anton.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes a Pile Driver Ataque against enemies in a line in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

anton.name: Ataque Especial EX: Smash the Horizon, Bro!
anton.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Launches several Pile Driver Attacks at enemies in a line in front of him, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Anton enters Burst Mode after using this skill. When in Burst Mode, Anton's attacks become more powerful, dealing massive Dano Elétrico while continually consuming Energy upon hitting an enemy. Burst Mode remains active until his Energy is depleted.

anton.name: Ataque Especial: Explosive Drill (Burst Mode)
anton.desc: Press while in Burst Mode to activate. Launches a Pile Driver Ataque at enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

anton.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Go Go Go!
anton.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a Pile Driver Ataque onto the ground in front of him over a large area, dealing massive Dano Elétrico to enemies within range. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anton.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Go Go Go Go Go!
anton.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleashes a Pile Driver Ataque onto the ground in front of him over a large area, dealing massive Dano Elétrico to enemies within range. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anton.name: Ataque de Suporte: Limit Burst
anton.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Launches a Drill Ataque that ends in a Pile Driver Ataque, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anton.name: Suporte Defensivo: Iron Wrist
anton.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

anton.name: Suporte Rápido: Shoulder-To-Shoulder
anton.desc: When the character in combat is launched, press to activate. Continuously strikes enemies in front of him with heavy punches, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable during the Ataque.

anton.name: Suporte Rápido: Protective Drill (Burst Mode)
anton.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Attacks enemies in front with a Drill Ataque, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable during the Ataque.

anton.name: Passiva de Núcleo Brothers in Arms!
anton.desc: Lv. 1

anton.name: Habilidade Adicional Teamwork
anton.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:While Anton is in Burst Mode, for every 4 critical hits, the next Ataque hitting Shocked enemies triggers an additional bout of Shock DMG at 45% of the original DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

anton.name: M1 Warm-up Exercises Cinema (Mindscape) 1
anton.desc: When Drill Ataque hits an enemy, Anton gains additional Energy up to a maximum of 5 Energy per skill use.

anton.name: M2 State of Flow Cinema (Mindscape) 2
anton.desc: When Anton uses his Ataque Especial EX and enters Burst Mode, he gains a Shield that equals to 7.5% of his max HP. While in Burst Mode, entering combat or switching in reapplies the Shield effect. This effect can trigger once every 15s. The Shield dissipates when Burst Mode ends.

anton.name: M3 Rotational Training Cinema (Mindscape) 3
anton.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

anton.name: M4 Everyone Get Fired Up! Cinema (Mindscape) 4
anton.desc: When Anton uses a Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate), all squad members' Taxa Crítica increases by 10% for 12s.

anton.name: M5 Jack of All Trades Cinema (Mindscape) 5
anton.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

anton.name: M6 Break the Limit Cinema (Mindscape) 6
anton.desc: When Anton's Piledriver Ataque triggers a critical hit, his Ataque Básico: Enthusiastic Drills (Burst Mode) and Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Overload Drill (Burst Mode) deal 4% more DMG for 30s, stacking up to 6 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

aria.name: Ataque Básico: Sweet Melody
aria.desc: Press to activate: Launches up to four consecutive attacks forward, dealing Dano de Éter. After hitting an enemy with the fourth hit, 1 Fandom Power is generated on the field after the Ataque ends.

aria.name: Ataque Básico: Perfect Pitch
aria.desc: Hold to activate: Aria enters a charging state and can reach three levels of charge. Releasing or reaching the maximum charge time causes Aria to unleash a powerful downward Ataque forward based on the current charge level, dealing massive Dano de Éter. If there is Fandom Power nearby while Aria is charging, she will absorb the Fandom Power, with each absorbed Fandom Power instantly increasing charge level by 1 and granting 1 stack of a buff that increases the next Ataque Básico: Perfect Pitch's Ether Anomalia Buildup by 10%. This buff can stack up to 2 times and is removed after the Ataque ends. After the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Sweet Melody, Ataque Especial: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice, an Ataque Especial EX, the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Perfect Pitch, a Suporte Rápido, a Ataque em Cadeia, or an Suprema (Ultimate), if there are at least 2 Fandom Power nearby, hold to consume 2 Fandom Power and quickly activate the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Perfect Pitch. After the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Perfect Pitch, a Ataque em Cadeia, or an Suprema (Ultimate), if there are at least 2 Fandom Power nearby, the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Perfect Pitch can also be quickly activated by pressing within a short window, consuming 2 Fandom Power. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging, and received DMG is reduced by 40%. Character is invulnerable while using this Ataque.

aria.name: Esquiva: On-Beat Precision
aria.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. If activated during a Ataque Básico: Sweet Melody chain, this action does not reset the Ataque Básico count. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

aria.name: Dash Ataque: Silky-Smooth Combo
aria.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Flies forward with a swift slashing Ataque, dealing Dano de Éter. If activated during a Ataque Básico: Sweet Melody chain, this action does not reset the Ataque Básico count.

aria.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Slide-Shift Variation
aria.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Unleashes a powerful slash against the target, dealing Dano de Éter. After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Sweet Melody. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

aria.name: Ataque Especial: Full-Sugar Electronica
aria.desc: Press to activate. Delivers a forward kick, dealing Dano de Éter. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

aria.name: Ataque Especial: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice
aria.desc: After the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Sweet Melody, an Ataque de Suporte, a Ataque em Cadeia, or an Suprema (Ultimate), press to activate. Delivers a quicker forward kick, dealing Dano de Éter. If the Ataque hits an enemy, 1 Fandom Power is generated on the field after the Ataque ends. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

aria.name: Ataque Especial EX: Fall Into Delusion
aria.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Delivers a powerful forward kick followed by a sonic wave Ataque, dealing Dano de Éter. If the Ataque hits an enemy, 3 Fandom Power are generated on the field after the Ataque ends. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

aria.name: Ataque Especial EX: Instantly Hooked
aria.desc: After launching Ataque Especial EX: Fall Into Delusion, and with enough Energy, press to activate: Performs a powerful downward Ataque in front, dealing Dano de Éter. If the Ataque hits an enemy, 3 Fandom Power are generated on the field after the Ataque ends. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

aria.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Dream Collab
aria.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Dano de Éter. 4 Fandom Power are generated on the field on skill activation. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

aria.name: Suprema (Ultimate): 100% Energy
aria.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Releases all her power, entering Moment of Delusion, and fires multiple powerful shots at the target, dealing massive Dano de Éter. Upon entering Moment of Delusion, Aria gains 3 stacks of All-Out Cheering and activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will first cancel any existing instance of Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Aria is charging, if she has All-Out Cheering, stacks of All-Out Cheering are consumed first to charge. Each stack of All-Out Cheering consumed increases the charge level by 2. Upon entering Moment of Delusion, if Aria already has All-Out Cheering, all remaining stacks of All-Out Cheering are first converted into Fandom Power and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power. Moment of Delusion lasts for up to 15s. During Moment of Delusion, Aria's Ataque Básico: Perfect Pitch 3rd hit is upgraded to an enhanced version. When exiting Moment of Delusion, if Aria has All-Out Cheering, all remaining stacks of All-Out Cheering are converted into Fandom Power and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

aria.name: Ataque de Suporte: Encore Song
aria.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Unleashes a powerful series of slashes on the target, dealing massive Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

aria.name: Suporte Defensivo: Clutch Save
aria.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

aria.name: Suporte Rápido: Shatter Fantasy
aria.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Delivers a powerful slash to the target, dealing Dano de Éter. After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Sweet Melody. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

aria.name: Passiva de Núcleo Innate Stage Presence
aria.desc: Lv. 1

aria.name: Habilidade Adicional Collaborative Stage
aria.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun) or Suporte character, or shares the same Faction:When Ether Veil is activated, 4 Fandom Power are generated on the field. This can trigger once every 1s.When any squad member applies Corruption to an enemy, its duration is extended by 3s.

aria.name: M1 Energetic Sound Waves Cinema (Mindscape) 1
aria.desc: When Aria's Ataque Básico, Ataque Especial, or Ataque Especial EX deals DMG to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's Ether Anomalia Buildup RES. Additionally, when Aria triggers Abloom, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base Taxa Crítica is 25%, and Dano Crítico is 25%. If initial Maestria de Anomalia exceeds 100, each additional point of initial Maestria de Anomalia increases this effect's Taxa Crítica by 0.5%.

aria.name: M2 Fantastical Beat Cinema (Mindscape) 2
aria.desc: When Aria attacks or triggers Abloom, it ignores 16% of the target's DEF. During Moment of Delusion, attacks and Abloom triggers also ignore an additional 8% of the target's DEF.

aria.name: M3 Delulu Cinema (Mindscape) 3
aria.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

aria.name: M4 Mechanical Angel Cinema (Mindscape) 4
aria.desc: When Aria triggers Abloom, she gains 4 Energy and 70 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

aria.name: M5 Tears in the Rain Cinema (Mindscape) 5
aria.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

aria.name: M6 Construct's Dream Cinema (Mindscape) 6
aria.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Aria immediately gains 1,200 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. After Aria enters Moment of Delusion, she will not exit it, and enhanced Ataque Básico: Perfect Pitch and her Suprema (Ultimate) deal 40% increased Dano de Éter. While in Moment of Delusion, when an enemy on the field enters an Anomalia state, Aria gains 1 stacks of All-Out Cheering. This effect can occur once every 6s. When gaining the All-Out Cheering effect, if already at 3 stacks of All-Out Cheering, any excess All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power and generated on the field.

astrayao.name: Ataque Básico: "Capriccio"
astrayao.desc: Press to activate: Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing Dano de Éter. During the 3rd-hit, hold to charge, drawing enemies in and expanding the Ataque range for a stronger Ataque. After using other skills, hold to initiate the 3rd-hit directly.

astrayao.name: Ataque Básico: Interlude
astrayao.desc: While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, press to activate: Release Tremolo forward to Ataque, dealing Dano de Éter. A Suporte Rápido will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

astrayao.name: Ataque Básico: Chorus
astrayao.desc: While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Launch multiple Tremolo attacks at enemies in front, dealing massive Dano de Éter. A Suporte Rápido will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

astrayao.name: Ataque Básico: Finale
astrayao.desc: While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, press to activate: Release Tremolo forward to Ataque, dealing Dano de Éter and exit the Idyllic Cadenza state. Upon activation of the skill, it grants the buff from Passiva de Núcleo: "Graceful Andante". With enough Energy, consumes Energy to follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters. This Tremolo Ataque released is considered an Ataque Especial EX.

astrayao.name: Esquiva: "Mini Waltz"
astrayao.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

astrayao.name: Dash Ataque: "Lunar Eclipse Melody"
astrayao.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Ataque ahead, dealing Dano de Éter. When triggered, dragging thestick/joystick allows movement in the corresponding direction.

astrayao.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: "Umbrella Waltz"
astrayao.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Ataque enemies in front, dealing Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

astrayao.name: Ataque Especial: "Windchimes & Oaths"
astrayao.desc: Press to activate. Quickly move, then release Tremolo, dealing Dano de Éter, and enter the Idyllic Cadenza state. During activation, dragging the stick/joystick enables movement in the direction held. Hold to charge during activation, drawing enemies in, and follow up with 1 to 4 Tremolos depending on the charge duration. A Suporte Rápido will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

astrayao.name: Idyllic Cadenza
astrayao.desc: After entering the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao increases all squad members' DMG and Dano Crítico. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao cannot move, but pressing will activate Ataque Básico: Interlude, and pressing will activate a Esquiva. After triggering a Perfect Esquiva, press to activate Ataque Básico: Chorus. While in this state, Astra Yao's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and the DMG she takes is reduced by 40%. After switching to another character, Astra Yao will remain on the field and become Invulnerable. When switching back to her, she will automatically follow up with Ataque Especial: Windchimes & Oaths. During this state, hold to activate Ataque Básico: Finale, or hold to exit the Idyllic Cadenza state.

astrayao.name: Chord
astrayao.desc: For every 25 Energy, Astra Yao will have 1 Chord. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when Astra Yao has Chords, a Suporte Rápido can be triggered in the following situations: When the controlled character's Ataque hits an enemy, once per 3s. When the controlled character's heavy Ataque hits an enemy, once per 1s. When other characters in the squad switch in through a Suporte Rápido, Ataque em Cadeia, Suporte Defensivo, or Evasive Assist, Astra Yao will consume 25 Energy and release 1 Tremolo to Ataque. This Tremolo Ataque released is considered an Ataque Especial EX. After triggering a Suporte Rápido, quickly press to switch characters and trigger a Precise Assist, causing Astra Yao to follow up with 3 Tone Clusters to Ataque. When other squad members switch in through a Ataque em Cadeia, Suporte Defensivo, or Evasive Assist, it will automatically trigger a Precise Assist.

astrayao.name: Ataque em Cadeia: "Tipsy Concerto"
astrayao.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After the skill, Astra Yao enters the Idyllic Cadenza state.

astrayao.name: Suprema (Ultimate): "Fantasian Sonata"
astrayao.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Dano de Éter, and restoring some HP to all squad members. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After the skill, Astra Yao enters the Idyllic Cadenza state. After the skill, the next two Quick Assists will be replaced by Chain Attacks.

astrayao.name: Ataque de Suporte: "Three Lifetimes of Fate"
astrayao.desc: Press after an Evasive Assist to activate: Release an energy beam forward, dealing Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

astrayao.name: Evasive Assist: "Two Hearts"
astrayao.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Dodges the enemy's Ataque and activates Vital View. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

astrayao.name: Suporte Rápido: "One Luminous Sky"
astrayao.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Ataque enemies in front, dealing Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

astrayao.name: Passiva de Núcleo Graceful Andante
astrayao.desc: Lv. 1

astrayao.name: Habilidade Adicional Moonlit Frenzy
astrayao.desc: When another character in your squad is an Ataque, Anomalia, or Rupture character:When Energy is consumed to trigger a Precise Assist or Ataque Básico: Finale, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters.

astrayao.name: M1 12-Tone Equal Temperament Cinema (Mindscape) 1
astrayao.desc: When Astra Yao's Ataque hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 6%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. Upon entering the battlefield, Astra Yao immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. When activating her Suprema (Ultimate), all squad members gain 1 stack of Song of Protection for 60s. When attacked by an enemy, consume Song of Protection, granting Invulnerability for 1s.

astrayao.name: M2 Art of Greed Cinema (Mindscape) 2
astrayao.desc: The ATK buff from Passiva de Núcleo: Graceful Andante is further increased by 19%, with an increased maximum of 400. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other characters switch in through a Suporte Rápido, Ataque em Cadeia, Suporte Defensivo, or Evasive Assist, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters to Ataque. This effect can trigger once every 3s.

astrayao.name: M3 Interwoven Staff Notation Cinema (Mindscape) 3
astrayao.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

astrayao.name: M4 Hair Upon Your Nape Cinema (Mindscape) 4
astrayao.desc: After activating a Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate), within 15s, Astra Yao can trigger a Suporte Rápido even if she does not have Chords. When the Ataque hits an enemy, the interval for triggering a Suporte Rápido is reduced to 1s. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other characters enter the field via a Suporte Rápido, they will receive different buffs based on their specialty, and this effect can be triggered once every 3s for the entire squad: Ataque: The next Suporte Rápido heavy Ataque on an enemy will deal extra DMG equal to 300% of Astra Yao's ATK; Anomalia: The next Suporte Rápido will have 50% increased Anomalia Buildup; Atordoamento (Stun): The next Suporte Rápido will inflict 50% increased Atordoamento (Daze).

astrayao.name: M5 Proxy and Silk String Cinema (Mindscape) 5
astrayao.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

astrayao.name: M6 We Are the World Cinema (Mindscape) 6
astrayao.desc: While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, the DMG multiplier for Tremolo and Tone Clusters released or followed up with will increase to 200% of the original, and Taxa Crítica is increased by 80%. When triggering a Precise Assist, Astra Yao will automatically follow up with the charged 3rd-hit of Ataque Básico: Capriccio, with a 80% increased Taxa Crítica. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

banyue.name: Ataque Básico: Towering Peaks
banyue.desc: Press to activate: Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque Básico: Majestic Summit
banyue.desc: Press to activate: Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque Básico: Immolate
banyue.desc: While not in the Visage of Wrath state and with at least 120 Wrathful Fires, hold to activate: Deals Dano de Fogo to nearby enemies, then enters the Visage of Wrath state.

banyue.name: Ataque Básico: Inflame
banyue.desc: While not in combat and with more than 50% HP and less than 120 Wrathful Fires, hold to activate: Banyue consumes HP to recover Wrathful Fires. Upon reaching 120 Wrathful Fires, Banyue immediately enters the Visage of Wrath state. Upon entering the battlefield, gain one chance to use this skill. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once per 180s. HP consumption will at most reduce Banyue's HP to 50% of Max HP.

banyue.name: Ataque Básico: Toppling Mountain
banyue.desc: When Banyue is in the Visage of Wrath state, hold to consume 120 Wrathful Fires and activate: Banyue hurls a massive mountain at the enemy, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. After using this move, Banyue exits the Visage of Wrath state. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque Básico: Crushing Peaks
banyue.desc: While Banyue is in the Visage of Wrath state and after performing two different EX Special Attacks through Ataque Básico branches or quick input commands, hold to activate: Banyue launches his beads forward to imprison enemies, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Banyue automatically follows up with Ataque Básico: Toppling Mountain. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Esquiva: Immovable Mountain
banyue.desc: While attacking, press without moving the stick/joystick to activate: Banyue enters a defensive stance. If attacked during this time, he parries the enemy's Ataque and accumulates Atordoamento (Daze). If attacked at the exact moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Block occurs. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Esquiva: Overcome Peaks
banyue.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Esquiva: Battle Cry
banyue.desc: Rotate the stick/joystick in a half-circle and press to activate. Dodges backward and taunts enemies. After any Ataque Especial EX, follow up with Esquiva: Battle Cry and quickly execute the required inputs during Esquiva: Battle Cry to then follow up with the corresponding Ataque Especial EX. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Dash Ataque: Scattering Sands
banyue.desc: During a Esquiva, press or during Esquiva: Battle Cry, hold to activate: Launches beads forward, dealing Dano de Fogo. After using this skill, can be followed up with the 2nd hit of Ataque Básico: Towering Peaks or the 2nd hit of Ataque Básico: Majestic Summit.

banyue.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Stoneburst
banyue.desc: After a Perfect Esquiva is triggered through Esquiva: Overcome Peaks, press , or after a Perfect Esquiva is triggered though Esquiva: Battle Cry, hold to activate: Launches a forward Ataque that deals Dano de Fogo. After using this skill, can be chained into the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Towering Peaks or the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Majestic Summit. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque Especial EX: Earth Shaker
banyue.desc: With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways: After the 3rd or 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Towering Peaks, press to activate: After an Ataque de Suporte, Contra-ataque de Esquiva, or Suporte Rápido, hold to activate: During an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque Básico: Immolate, Ataque em Cadeia, Suprema (Ultimate), Ataque de Suporte, Contra-ataque de Esquiva, or Suporte Rápido, quickly input in sequence to activate: Banyue slams the ground repeatedly, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque Especial EX: Mountain Tremor
banyue.desc: With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways: After the 1st or 2nd hit of Ataque Básico: Majestic Summit, press to activate: During an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque Básico: Immolate, Ataque em Cadeia, Suprema (Ultimate), Ataque de Suporte, Contra-ataque de Esquiva, or Suporte Rápido, quickly input in sequence to activate: Banyue throws a mountain, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque Especial EX: One's Path
banyue.desc: With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways: After the 3rd or 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Majestic Summit, press to activate: After an Ataque de Suporte, Contra-ataque de Esquiva, or Suporte Rápido, hold to activate: During an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque Básico: Immolate, Ataque em Cadeia, Suprema (Ultimate), Ataque de Suporte, Contra-ataque de Esquiva, or Suporte Rápido, quickly input in sequence to activate: Banyue throws out his beads, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque Especial EX: Lion's Roar
banyue.desc: With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways: After the 1st or 2nd hit of Ataque Básico: Towering Peaks, press to activate: During an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque Básico: Immolate, Ataque em Cadeia, Suprema (Ultimate), Ataque de Suporte, Contra-ataque de Esquiva, or Suporte Rápido, quickly input in sequence to activate: Banyue sends out a sonic wave forward, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque Especial EX: Mountain Tremor - Wrath
banyue.desc: With enough Adrenaline when using Ataque Especial EX: Earth Shaker, quickly input in sequence to activate: Banyue throws out an even larger mountain, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque Especial EX: Lion's Roar - Wrath
banyue.desc: With enough Adrenaline when using Ataque Especial EX: One's Path, quickly input in sequence to activate: Banyue releases a powerful sonic wave in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Cancel
banyue.desc: When Banyue activates an Ataque Especial EX ALT through quick input commands, the currently activating Ataque Especial EX can be interrupted. Each Ataque Especial EX has its own Perfect Interrupt window. Interrupting an Ataque Especial EX after its Perfect Interrupt window will not affect the interrupted Ataque Especial EX's effect. Interrupting an Ataque Especial EX during the Perfect Interrupt window is equal to triggering a Perfect Cancel. While in the Visage of Wrath state and with Mountain's Might, Perfect Cancel is easier to trigger.

banyue.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Blazing Wrath
banyue.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Launches a large area Ataque in front, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. If Banyue has more than 120 Wrathful Fires, he automatically enters the Visage of Wrath state after the Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Suprema (Ultimate): The World Trembles
banyue.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Launches a large area Ataque in front, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. If Banyue has more than 120 Wrathful Fires, he automatically enters the Visage of Wrath state after the Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque de Suporte: Lofty Ascent
banyue.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Quickly dash forward and Ataque, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Ataque de Suporte: Pierce Heavens
banyue.desc: After successfully parrying an enemy Ataque with Esquiva: Immovable Mountain, press to activate: Quickly dash forward and Ataque, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Suporte Defensivo: Iron Bastion
banyue.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Suporte Rápido: Batholith
banyue.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Executes a series of attacks against enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

banyue.name: Passiva de Núcleo One With the Mountains
banyue.desc: Lv. 1

banyue.name: Habilidade Adicional Mountain's Zenith
banyue.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun) or Suporte character:While in the Visage of Wrath state, when Banyue consumes Mountain's Might to unleash an Ataque Especial EX through a Ataque Básico branch or quick input commands, he gains one stack of Vidyaraja. Each stack of Vidyaraja increases his Dano de Fogo by 5%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

banyue.name: M1 Greed Burns Like Fire Cinema (Mindscape) 1
banyue.desc: When Banyue hits an enemy with Ataque Especial EX: One's Path or Ataque Especial EX: Earth Shaker, he inflicts the Tremor state. In this state, enemies' Fire RES is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s. When Ataque Especial EX: Lion's Roar, Ataque Especial EX: Lion's Roar - Wrath, Ataque Especial EX: Mountain Tremor, Ataque Especial EX: Mountain Tremor - Wrath, Ataque Básico: Toppling Mountain, and Ataque Básico: Crushing Peaks hits an enemy in the Tremor state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%. When Ataque Básico: Crushing Peaks hits a Stunned enemy, the current Atordoamento (Stun) duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Atordoamento (Stun) and does not stack with similar effects.

banyue.name: M2 Anger Cuts Like a Blade Cinema (Mindscape) 2
banyue.desc: The Dano Crítico bonus from the Passiva de Núcleo is increased by an additional 15%, and the Bônus de Dano de Fogo is increased by an additional 15%. While in the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue restores an additional 5 Adrenaline when consuming Mountain's Might to unleash an Ataque Especial EX.

banyue.name: M3 Ignorance Binds Like Chains Cinema (Mindscape) 3
banyue.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

banyue.name: M4 Purge Unit - Type Zero Cinema (Mindscape) 4
banyue.desc: Ataque Especial EX: Lion's Roar - Wrath, Ataque Especial EX: Mountain Tremor - Wrath, Ataque Básico: Toppling Mountain, and Ataque Básico: Crushing Peaks DMG increase by 30%.

banyue.name: M5 Student Cinema (Mindscape) 5
banyue.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

banyue.name: M6 Descended Vidyaraja Cinema (Mindscape) 6
banyue.desc: At any time, when Banyue uses an Ataque Especial EX, he also gains Vidyaraja. The Bônus de Dano de Fogo from Vidyaraja is increased by an additional 8%, and its duration is extended to 30s. When activating Ataque Básico: Crushing Peaks, Banyue deals Dano de Fogo equal to 600% of his Sheer Force to nearby enemies. Using Esquiva: Battle Cry immediately after an Ataque Especial EX also grants Vidyaraja.

ben.name: Ataque Básico: Debt Reconciliation
ben.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Dano Físico.

ben.name: Esquiva: Missing Invoice
ben.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ben.name: Dash Ataque: Incoming Expense
ben.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Strikes enemies in front of him, dealing Dano Físico.

ben.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Accounts Settled
ben.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Strike enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ben.name: Ataque Especial: Fiscal Fist
ben.desc: Press to activate. Ben lifts his weapon, blocking the enemy's Ataque before unleashing a forward strike, dealing Dano Físico. Successfully blocking an Ataque enhances the power of this skill and triggers Block Counter, dealing massive Dano Físico. Hold to remain in the Blocking stance. While in the Blocking stance, Ben gains a Shield that weakens over time. After leaving the blocking stance, the Shield is removed and recovers over time. The Shield cannot exceed 16% of Ben's Max HP. Ben is invulnerable when activating Block. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while launching strikes.

ben.name: Ataque Especial EX: Cashflow Counter
ben.desc: With enough energy, press to activate. Ben lifts his weapon, blocking the enemy's attacks before unleashing a forward strike, dealing Dano de Fogo. Successfully blocking an Ataque enhances the power of this skill and triggers Block Counter, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Hold to remain in the Blocking stance. While in the Blocking stance, Ben gains a Shield that weakens over time. After leaving the blocking stance, the Shield is removed and recovers over time. The Shield cannot exceed 16% of Ben's Max HP. When this skill is activated, the Shield is restored to its maximum value. After activating the skill, press again to follow up with a powerful forward strike, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Ben is invulnerable when activating Block. Ben is invulnerable while launching strikes.

ben.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Signed and Sealed
ben.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate. Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in front of him in a large area, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ben.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Complete Payback
ben.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. When activating the skill, additionally recover 3 Assist Points. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ben.name: Ataque de Suporte: Don't Break Contract
ben.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Charge and strike enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ben.name: Suporte Defensivo: Risk Allocation
ben.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ben.name: Suporte Rápido: Joint Account
ben.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable during the Ataque.

ben.name: Habilidade Adicional Contractual Agreement
ben.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:While the Shield from Passiva de Núcleo: Guardian is in effect, the character's Taxa Crítica is increased by 16%.

ben.name: M1 Reacting Force Cinema (Mindscape) 1
ben.desc: When successfully Blocking an enemy with Ben's Ataque Especial or Ataque Especial EX, the DMG dealt by the blocked enemy is reduced by 30% for 15s.

ben.name: M2 Offense Through Defesa Cinema (Mindscape) 2
ben.desc: When successfully triggering a Block Counter during Ben's Ataque Especial or Ataque Especial EX, inflict an additional 300% of Ben's DEF as DMG.

ben.name: M3 Careful Accounting Cinema (Mindscape) 3
ben.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

ben.name: M4 Agile Adaptation Cinema (Mindscape) 4
ben.desc: When successfully blocking enemy DMG with Ben’s invulnerable effect during his Ataque Especial or Ataque Especial EX, the following counter deals 30% more DMG.

ben.name: M5 Meticulous Detail Cinema (Mindscape) 5
ben.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

ben.name: M6 Wild spirit Cinema (Mindscape) 6
ben.desc: After launching an Ataque or follow-up Ataque during Ben's Ataque Especial EX, Atordoamento (Daze) inflicted by Basic Attacks, Dash Ataque, and Contra-ataque de Esquiva is increased by 20%, lasting 12s.

billy.name: Ataque Básico: Full Firepower
billy.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes a piercing Ataque, dealing Dano Físico. Repeatedly press or hold to enter Crouching Shot to extend the Ataque duration. Drag the joystick during Crouching Shot to launch Rolling Shot and adjust the character's position, dealing Dano Físico. Stop pressing or holding during Crouching Shot to launch Finishing Shot at enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

billy.name: Esquiva: Risky Business
billy.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy.name: Dash Ataque: Starlight Sanction
billy.desc: When dragging the during a Esquiva, press : Launches a piercing Ataque at nearby enemies within a large area, dealing Dano Físico. When not dragging the during a Esquiva, press : Launches a piercing Ataque at enemies in a line, dealing Dano Físico.

billy.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Fair Fight
billy.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Pierces enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy.name: Ataque Especial: Stand Still
billy.desc: Press to activate. Performs up to 3 piercing attacks in a line, dealing Dano Físico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

billy.name: Ataque Especial EX: Clearance Time
billy.desc: With enough energy, press to activate. Launches a powerful piercing Ataque in a straight line, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Starlight Mirage
billy.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate. Unleashes a powerful piercing Ataque at surrounding enemies in a large area, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Starlight Sparkle
billy.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleashes a powerful piercing Ataque at surrounding enemies in a large area, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy.name: Ataque de Suporte: Fatal Shot
billy.desc: Press after an Evasive Assist to activate. Pierce enemies in a large area in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy.name: Evasive Assist: Flash Spin
billy.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Dodges the enemy's Ataque and activates Vital View. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy.name: Suporte Rápido: Power of Teamwork
billy.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Launches a piercing Ataque at enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable during the Ataque.

billy.name: Habilidade Adicional Team Starlight
billy.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:After Billy uses a Ataque em Cadeia, the DMG of his next Suprema (Ultimate) is increased by 50%, stacking up to 2 times. This effect resets whenever an Suprema (Ultimate) is activated.

billy.name: M1 Dazzling Entrance Cinema (Mindscape) 1
billy.desc: When Billy hits an enemy with a Dash Ataque or Contra-ataque de Esquiva, he gains an additional 2.7 Energy. Can trigger once every 5s.

billy.name: M2 Roaming Gunslinger Cinema (Mindscape) 2
billy.desc: Billy's Contra-ataque de Esquiva DMG increases by 25%. Rolling Shots during his Basic Attacks count as dodges, making Billy Invulnerable during skill activation and able to trigger Perfect Dodges. When a Rolling Shot triggers a Perfect Esquiva, it will automatically follow up a Contra-ataque de Esquiva.

billy.name: M3 Teachings of the Starlight Knights Cinema (Mindscape) 3
billy.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

billy.name: M4 Starlight Ballistics Cinema (Mindscape) 4
billy.desc: When Billy hits an enemy with his Ataque Especial EX, the skill's Taxa Crítica increases based on the distance from the enemy. The closer he is to the target, the greater the effect, up to a maximum increase of 32%.

billy.name: M5 Lost Technological Construct Cinema (Mindscape) 5
billy.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

billy.name: M6 Starlight Hero Cinema (Mindscape) 6
billy.desc: When Billy accumulates 10 hits on enemies or triggers a Perfect Esquiva, his DMG increases by 6%, stacking up to 5 times. The effect resets is he is knocked back or launched by an enemy.

billy-starlight.name: Ataque Básico: Knight's Technique
billy-starlight.desc: Press to activate: Performs up to four attacks forward, dealing Dano Físico. During the 4th hit, press to use Ataque Especial: Drive Suppression, reducing HP consumption by 50%. Restores a small amount of HP on hit.

billy-starlight.name: Ataque Básico: Full-Throttle Starlight
billy-starlight.desc: With enough Determination, hold to activate: Charges forward on the motorcycle, then fires a laser beam, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Esquiva: Close Call!
billy-starlight.desc: Press to activate: A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Esquiva: Through the Galaxy
billy-starlight.desc: During Ataque Especial: Drive Suppression, drag the / or hold to activate: Drifts with the motorcycle, enabling Perfect Dodges for a brief duration. If a Perfect Esquiva is successfully triggered, it immediately chains into Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Afterfire Spin. During this skill, continue dragging the / or holding to continue drifting. During this skill, the duration of Ataque Especial: Drive Suppression will continue, and upon reaching the maximum duration, it automatically chains into Ataque Especial EX: Cool Wheelie. If the skill ends early, it automatically chains into Ataque Especial: Run Wild. Character is briefly invulnerable and Anti-Interrupt Level increases during this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Dash Ataque: Starlight Retribution
billy-starlight.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Performs a quick forward slash, dealing Dano Físico.

billy-starlight.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Duel King
billy-starlight.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Fires a blast from his arm cannon, dealing Dano Físico. If this skill is triggered via a Perfect Esquiva, hitting an enemy restores 10% of Max HP, and it can be chained into the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Knight's Technique. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Afterfire Spin
billy-starlight.desc: During Esquiva: Through the Galaxy, trigger a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Spins with the bike to deal Dano Físico to surrounding enemies. After using this skill, it automatically chains into Ataque Especial EX: Cool Wheelie. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Ataque Especial: Drive Suppression
billy-starlight.desc: When HP is above 25%, press to activate: Consumes HP equal to 16% of Max HP to summon a motorcycle and swiftly crash into enemies, continuously dealing Dano Físico. If attacked by an enemy as the active character shortly upon activating this skill, triggers a block, negating the Ataque and restoring 5 Determination. After triggering a block, immediately chains into Ataque Especial EX: Cool Wheelie. After the skill continues for a while, it automatically chains into Ataque Especial EX: Cool Wheelie. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Ataque Especial: Run Wild
billy-starlight.desc: Triggers automatically when Esquiva: Through the Galaxy is interrupted: Kicks his motorcycle at enemies, dealing Dano Físico. After using this skill, it can be chained into Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Duel King. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Ataque Especial: Cool Wheelie
billy-starlight.desc: Triggers automatically when Ataque Especial: Drive Suppression reaches its maximum duration or a block is triggered: Lifts the motorcycle to Ataque enemies, dealing Dano Físico. On hit, restores an additional 8 Determination. After using this skill, with enough Adrenaline, press or hold to chain into Ataque Especial EX: Rocking Footwork. After the skill animation ends, automatically chains into Ataque Especial: Run Wild. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Ataque Especial EX: High-Traction Wheels
billy-starlight.desc: With enough Adrenaline, hold to activate: Slams down with the motorcycle, dealing Dano Físico. Restores 30% of Max HP upon activating this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Ataque Especial EX: Rocking Footwork
billy-starlight.desc: After activating Ataque Especial EX: Cool Wheelie and with enough Adrenaline, press or hold to activate: Uses the motorcycle and hand cannon for a combined Ataque, dealing Dano Físico. Upon activating this skill, restore 15% of Max HP. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Knight's Swagger
billy-starlight.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Dano Físico. Upon activating this skill, gains 15 Determination. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Starlight Knight Flying Kick
billy-starlight.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Leaps into the air and delivers a flying kick at the target, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Ataque de Suporte: Villain's Exit
billy-starlight.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Kicks the motorcycle at the target, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Suporte Defensivo: Hero's Entrance
billy-starlight.desc: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate: Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Suporte Rápido: Starlight - Power of Bonds
billy-starlight.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate: Fires a blast from his arm cannon ahead, dealing Dano Físico. When HP is above 25%, this skill is replaced with Ataque Especial: Drive Suppression. This effect can trigger once every 5s. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

billy-starlight.name: Passiva de Núcleo Knight's Resolve
billy-starlight.desc: Lv. 1

billy-starlight.name: Habilidade Adicional Blazing Starlight
billy-starlight.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun), Defesa, or Suporte character:Hitting an enemy with Ataque Especial EX: Cool Wheelie, the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Knight's Technique, Ataque em Cadeia, or Suprema (Ultimate) grants 1 stack of Starlight for 45s, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, Only one stack can be obtained per use of a skill. Each stack increases the DMG of Chain Attacks, Ultimates, EX Special Attacks, and Ataque Básico: Full-Throttle Starlight by 20%.

billy-starlight.name: M1 Heroic Entrance Cinema (Mindscape) 1
billy-starlight.desc: Passiva de Núcleo: Knight's Resolve restores an additional 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. Hitting an enemy with an Ataque Especial EX causes Starlight - Billy's DMG to ignore 18% Physical RES for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

billy-starlight.name: M2 Wasteland Automaton Cinema (Mindscape) 2
billy-starlight.desc: Increases the DMG dealt by Ataque Básico: Full-Throttle Starlight, Ataque Especial EX: Cool Wheelie, and Suprema (Ultimate): Starlight Knight Flying Kick by 50%. Activating Ataque Especial EX: Rocking Footwork, Ataque Especial EX: High-Traction Wheels, or hitting a Stunned enemy with Ataque Especial: Drive Suppression grants the Turbocharged effect: Ataque Especial: Drive Suppression consumes this effect to immediately follow up with Ataque Especial EX: Cool Wheelie, and increases that instance's Dano Crítico by 50%. Only 1 stack of Turbocharged can be held.

billy-starlight.name: M3 Knight's Chivalry Cinema (Mindscape) 3
billy-starlight.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

billy-starlight.name: M4 Flames of Justice Cinema (Mindscape) 4
billy-starlight.desc: While in combat, each use of Ataque Especial: Drive Suppression increases Starlight - Billy's Dano Crítico by 8%, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If HP is below 35% and Starlight - Billy is not the active character, he continuously recovers HP, up to 35%.

billy-starlight.name: M5 Radiant Armaments Cinema (Mindscape) 5
billy-starlight.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

billy-starlight.name: M6 Starlight Knight Cinema (Mindscape) 6
billy-starlight.desc: Suprema (Ultimate): Starlight Knight Flying Kick and Ataque Básico: Full-Throttle Starlight's Sheer DMG increases by 18%. Landing the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Knight's Technique, Ataque Especial EX: Cool Wheelie, or Ataque em Cadeia: Knight's Swagger grants 1 stack of Brilliant Starlight, stacking up to 6 times, and gaining at most 1 stack per skill use. When using Suprema (Ultimate): Starlight Knight Flying Kick or Ataque Básico: Full-Throttle Starlight, consumes up to 2 stacks of Brilliant Starlight, with each stack consumed causing that skill's final hit to deal 100% Sheer Force as additional Dano Físico.

burnice.name: Potential Awakened Potential: Boiling Point Party
burnice.desc: Lv. 1

burnice.name: Ataque Básico: Direct Flame Blend
burnice.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Fogo.

burnice.name: Ataque Básico: Mixed Flame Blend
burnice.desc: In the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, hold to activate: Spins continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move, then triggers an extra instance of Afterburn that doesn't cost Heat and deals Dano de Fogo. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration. The DMG dealt by this skill also counts as Assist Ataque DMG. Upon activation, it consumes 20 Heat. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill. After executing the Finishing Move, press to immediately follow up with Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

burnice.name: Esquiva: Fiery Phantom Dash
burnice.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

burnice.name: Dash Ataque: Dangerous Fermentation
burnice.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Perform a forward rush Ataque with the flamethrower, dealing Dano de Fogo.

burnice.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Fluttering Steps
burnice.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. SLaunch a series of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

burnice.name: Ataque Especial: Intense Heat Aging Method
burnice.desc: Press to activate. Unleash a fire blast forward, inflicting Dano de Fogo; Press and hold to charge, boosting the moves power. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

burnice.name: Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method
burnice.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Continue holding to steadily consume Energy and extend the spray's duration. While continuously spraying, drag the stick/joystick to execute a sidestep Esquiva, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 60%. Character is invulnerable during sidestep Esquiva and fire blast.

burnice.name: Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot
burnice.desc: While using Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method, with enough Energy, press to activate: Use both flamethrowers to continuously spray flames, followed by a fire blast in a front line, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Keep holding to continue consuming Energy and extend the spray's duration. Character is invulnerable during the moment the spray is activated and during the activation of the fire blast. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while spraying, and DMG received is reduced by 60%.

burnice.name: Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Tossing Method
burnice.desc: If Burnice has Emberflow, coming on-field activates this skill. After squadmates trigger Afterburn 12 times, Burnice gains 1 point of Emberflow. With Emberflow, Burnice's next entry onto the field consumes 1 stack to automatically activate this skill. This entry is considered a Suporte Rápido. When Afterburn triggered by Ataque Básico: Mixed Flame Blend hits an enemy, it counts for 2 times. While possessing Emberflow, the counter no longer increases. Consuming Emberflow clears the counter. Quickly dashes forward and passes through the enemy, unleashing a fiery Impacto that deals Dano Físico and Dano de Fogo. When the skill's heavy Ataque hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomalia, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 480%/240%/600%/40%/60%/24% of the original Anomalia's DMG. The Fire Anomalia Buildup increase from Habilidade Adicional: Fire Kindling applies to this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, press to immediately follow up with Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

burnice.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Fuel-Fed Flame
burnice.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Quickly dash forward while spraying flames in all directions, then launch a fire blast in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. After using the skill, press to immediately follow up with Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

burnice.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Glorious Inferno
burnice.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Dash forward quickly, then leap into the air and continuously spray flames over a wide area ahead, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. When leaping into the air, a Suporte Rápido will be triggered. If the Suporte Rápido is activated, Burnice will extend the duration of her flame spray. Upon activation, recover 50 Heat. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

burnice.name: Ataque de Suporte: Scorching Dew
burnice.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Leap into the air and quickly spin forward while spraying flames in all directions, dealing Dano de Fogo. After using the skill, press to immediately follow up with Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

burnice.name: Suporte Defensivo: Smoky Cauldron
burnice.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

burnice.name: Suporte Rápido: Energizing Specialty Drink
burnice.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Launches a series of attacks at enemies ahead and sprays flames, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, press to immediately follow up with Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

burnice.name: Passiva de Núcleo Nitro-Fuel Cocktail
burnice.desc: Lv. 1

burnice.name: Habilidade Adicional Fire Kindling
burnice.desc: When another character in your squad is an Anomalia character or shares the same Faction:When Burnice's Ataque Básico: Mixed Flame Blend, Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method or Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot hits an enemy, or when the Afterburn effect is triggered, the move's accumulated Anomalia Buildup increases by 65%. When any squad member applies the Burn effect to an enemy, the duration of that effect is extended by 3s.

burnice.name: M1 Kindred Flames Cinema (Mindscape) 1
burnice.desc: Increases the limit of Heat from 100 to 140. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice accumulates an additional 40 Heat. Increases the DMG Multiplier of the Afterburn effect by 100% of Burnice's ATK. Additionally, the accumulated Fire Anomalia Buildup from the Afterburn effect is increased by 25%.

burnice.name: M2 Extra at No Additional Charge Cinema (Mindscape) 2
burnice.desc: When triggering the Afterburn effect, Thermal Penetration is applied to the enemy, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any allied unit in the squad hits the enemy, the Ataque's Perfuração Ratio is increased by 4% for each stack of Thermal Penetration, up to a max of 20%.

burnice.name: M3 Optimistic by Nature Cinema (Mindscape) 3
burnice.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

burnice.name: M4 Suprema (Ultimate) Fuel Supply Cinema (Mindscape) 4
burnice.desc: When an Ataque Especial EX or Assist Ataque hits an enemy, the move's Taxa Crítica increases by 30%. The max flame spray duration of Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot is increased by 1s.

burnice.name: M5 Dance of Fire and Ice Cinema (Mindscape) 5
burnice.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

burnice.name: M6 Burning Invitation Cinema (Mindscape) 6
burnice.desc: When Burnice hits an enemy with Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, it triggers an additional special Afterburn effect, dealing 60% of Burnice's ATK as Dano de Fogo to the target. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and does not consume Heat. After hitting an enemy with Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, while the move is active, Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, special Afterburn effects, and Burn effects will ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES. When Ataque Especial EX: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot's fire blast hits an enemy, if that enemy is Burned, trigger an additional instance of Burn DMG equal to 1,800% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 20s for each target.

caesar.name: Ataque Básico: Rampaging Slash
caesar.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 6 slashes ahead, dealing Dano Físico.

caesar.name: Ataque Básico: Dead End
caesar.desc: When there are sufficient Assist Points, hold to activate: Consume 1 Assist Point to toss the shield and Ataque nearby enemies in all directions, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

caesar.name: Esquiva: Adrift
caesar.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

caesar.name: Dash Ataque: Hog Rush
caesar.desc: While dodging, press to activate. Strikes forward with the shield, dealing Dano Físico. During skill activation, damage taken is reduced by 40%. When attacked by an enemy Caesar blocks with the shield and gets slightly knocked back. Press or to trigger Retaliation and activate Ataque Especial: Roaring Thrust or Ataque Especial EX: Overpowered Shield Bash.

caesar.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Eye For an Eye
caesar.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

caesar.name: Ataque Especial: Shockwave Shield Bash
caesar.desc: Press to activate. Strike forward with the shield, dealing Dano Físico. If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation, it will trigger a Perfect Block, negating the damage once and automatically following up with a Ataque Especial: Roaring Thrust. After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy Caesar blocks with the shield and gets slightly knocked back. Press or to trigger Retaliation, activating Ataque Especial: Roaring Thrust or Ataque Especial EX: Overpowered Shield Bash. When Retaliation is triggered, Caesar is invulnerable while using the skill.

caesar.name: Ataque Especial: Roaring Thrust
caesar.desc: After activating Ataque Especial: Shockwave Shield Bash, press to activate: Thrusts forward, dealing Dano Físico. If Perfect Block or Retaliation is not triggered, the Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill when Perfect Block or Retaliationis triggered.

caesar.name: Ataque Especial EX: Parry Counter
caesar.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Strikes forward with the shield, followed by a powerful thrust, dealing massive Dano Físico. If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or a Interrupt is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger Perfect Block, negating incoming damage once and countering with a shield bash. After triggering Perfect Block, press to activate Ataque Especial EX: Overpowered Shield Bash without consuming energy. After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks the Ataque and is slightly knocked back. Press or to trigger Retaliation and activate Ataque Especial: Roaring Thrust or Ataque Especial EX: Overpowered Shield Bash. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

caesar.name: Ataque Especial EX: Overpowered Shield Bash
caesar.desc: After activating Ataque Especial EX: Parry Counter, with enough energy, press to activate: Strikes forward with the shield, dealing massive Dano Físico. If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or a Interrupt is triggered with a shield strike, it will trigger Perfect Block, negating incoming damage once and recovering the Energy used to activate the skill.
