When the skill is activated through Perfect Block or Retaliation, Perfect Block cannot be triggered again. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

caesar.name: Stance Switch
caesar.desc: When Caesar triggers a Perfect Block, Retaliation, or Suporte Defensivo, her Impacto is increased for 3s.

caesar.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Road Rage Slam
caesar.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a powerful downward strike at enemies ahead, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

caesar.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Savage Smash
caesar.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning Ataque on enemies in front, followed by a downward strike, dealing massive Dano Físico. When hitting shielded enemies, the Atordoamento (Daze) dealt is increased. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

caesar.name: Ataque de Suporte: Aiding Blade
caesar.desc: After activating Suporte Defensivo, press to activate: Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning Ataque on enemies in front, followed by a slash that deals Dano Físico. After activating the skill, press or or to trigger a Retaliation, activating Ataque Especial: Roaring Thrust or Ataque Especial EX: Overpowered Shield Bash. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

caesar.name: Suporte Defensivo: Aegis Shield
caesar.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

caesar.name: Suporte Rápido: Lane Change
caesar.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

caesar.name: Passiva de Núcleo Barrier of Resilience
caesar.desc: Lv. 1

caesar.name: Habilidade Adicional Battle Spirit
caesar.desc: When another character in your squad can activate Suporte Defensivo or shares the same Faction:When Caesar activates Perfect Block, Retaliation, Suporte Defensivo, or Ataque Básico: Dead End, she applies a Debuff effect to enemies within a 7m radius, increasing the damage they take from all teammates by 25% for 30s.

caesar.name: M1 Spearhead Advance Cinema (Mindscape) 1
caesar.desc: When Caesar enters combat or switches in, she instantly buffs the entire team with a Radiant Aegis shield, which can be can be triggered once every 300s. While Radiant Aegis is active, enemies within a 5m radius of the shield bearer suffer a 15% Attribute DMG RES reduction.

caesar.name: M2 Legacy of the Far Lands Cinema (Mindscape) 2
caesar.desc: While Radiant Aegis is active during Passiva de Núcleo: Barrier of Resilience, Caesar's Energy Generation increases by 10%, and the shield bearer's Ataque boost is increased to 150% of its original value.

caesar.name: M3 Absolute Trust Cinema (Mindscape) 3
caesar.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

caesar.name: M4 Aries the Battering-Ram Cinema (Mindscape) 4
caesar.desc: When Caesar uses a Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate), she gains 3 additional Assist Points. If her Energy is below 20, she can activate Ataque Especial EX: Overpowered Shield Bash with 1 Assist Point instead. This substitution can only be triggered once every 5s.

caesar.name: M5 Romantic Conquest Cinema (Mindscape) 5
caesar.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

caesar.name: M6 Overlord's Will Cinema (Mindscape) 6
caesar.desc: Ataque Especial EX: Overpowered Shield Bash and Ataque de Suporte is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit. The skill's DMG is increased by 50% with an additional damage of 50% dealt to the primary target. When Caesar uses Ataque Especial EX: Overpowered Shield Bash or Ataque de Suporte, her Taxa Crítica is increased by 30% and her Dano Crítico is increased by 60% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

cissia.name: Ataque Básico: Tongue Flick
cissia.desc: Press to activate: Launch up to four attacks forward, dealing Dano Elétrico. When the 4th hit lands, gain 2 points of Venom. Hitting a Stunned enemy grants an additional 1 point of Venom.

cissia.name: Ataque Básico: Serpent's Kiss
cissia.desc: With Serpentine Shadow, hold to launch: Cissia leaps into the air and locks onto a target, then slams down, dealing Dano Elétrico to enemies in the area. While locking on, continue to hold and drag the / to extend the lock-on duration and freely control the landing position. For every 6 points of Venom gained, gain 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow, stacking up to 3 times. Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow. Using this skill consumes 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow. Upon hitting an enemy, all Venom is consumed to trigger Corrode Bone. Upon activating this skill, a Suporte Rápido is triggered. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cissia.name: Corrode Bone
cissia.desc: Deal Dano Elétrico to nearby enemies. Each trigger increases Taxa Crítica by 6% for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

cissia.name: Esquiva: Slither
cissia.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cissia.name: Dash Ataque: Bite Mark
cissia.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Dash forward with a swift slash, dealing Dano Elétrico.

cissia.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Bite Back
cissia.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Leap forward and perform a sweeping Ataque upon landing, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cissia.name: Ataque Especial: Bared Fangs
cissia.desc: Press to activate. Launches a long-range snake bite forward, dealing Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

cissia.name: Ataque Especial EX: Venomous Bite
cissia.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Unleash multiple long-range snake bites forward, dealing Dano Elétrico. Grants 5 Energy when the move is used. When activating by holding, consumes additional Energy. For every 20 additional Energy consumed, unleash 1 extra strike that deals Dano Elétrico, up to a maximum of 60 additional Energy. After activation, gain 3 Venom. For every additional 20 Energy consumed while holding, gain 1 more Venom. After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Tongue Flick. A Suporte Rápido is triggered when this skill hits an enemy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cissia.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Gang Operation
cissia.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Launch multiple attacks ahead, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. After using this skill, gain 3 Venom. A Suporte Rápido is triggered when this skill hits an enemy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cissia.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Ophidiophobia
cissia.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Deliver a thunderbolt Ataque in front, dealing massive Dano Elétrico.After using this skill, obtain 3 Venom. After using this skill, activate Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded, lasting 30s. All squad members' Dano Crítico increases by 5% for the duration. Re-activating Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded a second time will first deactivate the active Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded. A Suporte Rápido is triggered when this skill hits an enemy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cissia.name: Ataque de Suporte: Partners in Crime
cissia.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Unleash a series of attacks, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cissia.name: Suporte Defensivo: Extra Prison Rations
cissia.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cissia.name: Suporte Rápido: Alarm System
cissia.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Leaps forward and performs a sweeping Ataque upon landing, dealing Dano Elétrico. During this skill, you can quickly chain into Ataque Especial: Bared Fangs, Ataque Especial EX: Venomous Bite, and Ataque Básico: Serpent's Kiss. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

cissia.name: Passiva de Núcleo Fatal Concoction
cissia.desc: Lv. 1

cissia.name: Habilidade Adicional Festering Venom
cissia.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun) character or shares the same attribute:While possessing Venom, increases all squad members' Dano Crítico by 40%, with Cissia gaining an additional 10%. The effect lasts until 30s after Venom is depleted.

cissia.name: M1 Traveler and Prey Cinema (Mindscape) 1
cissia.desc: The Venom gained upon entering the battlefield increases to 6. The DEF ignore from the Passiva de Núcleo increases to 140% of its original value, and all squad members ignore 5% of the target's Electric RES. Corrode Bone DMG ignores 10% of the target's Electric RES.

cissia.name: M2 Hunger and Hard Truths Cinema (Mindscape) 2
cissia.desc: After a Ataque em Cadeia: Gang Operation or Suprema (Ultimate): Ophidiophobia hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 Venom. Ataque Básico: Serpent's Kiss deals 35% increased DMG.

cissia.name: M3 Chains and a Warm Nest Cinema (Mindscape) 3
cissia.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

cissia.name: M4 A Rogue's Resolve Cinema (Mindscape) 4
cissia.desc: When using an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque em Cadeia, or Suprema (Ultimate), gain 1 stack of Decidedness, stacking up to 3 times. When using Ataque Básico: Serpent's Kiss, consume all Decidedness. Each stack consumed triggers 1 special instance of Corrode Bone that does not consume Venom. This Corrode Bone does not cause Atordoamento (Daze).

cissia.name: M5 False Evidence and Fangs Cinema (Mindscape) 5
cissia.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

cissia.name: M6 Home and Sixth Street Cinema (Mindscape) 6
cissia.desc: Each time Corrode Bone is triggered, gain 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion. When attacks from any squad member, other than Corrode Bone, hit an enemy, consume 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion to trigger 1 special Corrode Bone. This instance of Corrode Bone cannot inflict Atordoamento (Daze), and at most 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion can be consumed every 3s.

claret.name: Ataque Básico: Bloodforging Four Forms
claret.desc: Press to activate: Performs up to four strikes forward, dealing Dano Elétrico.

claret.name: Ataque Básico: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging
claret.desc: Press while in the Crimson Inscription state to activate: Use the Blood Axe to perform up to three slashes forward, dealing Dano Elétrico. When the second Ataque is launched, Claret leaps backward and throws the Blood Axe. A Perfect Esquiva can be triggered during the retreat. When the third Ataque is launched, Claret performs a series of slashes before leaping up and performing a downward smash. During the repeated slashes, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. Repeatedly press or hold to extend the duration of the repeated slashes. Stop pressing or release to make Claret immediately leap up and perform a downward smash. A Perfect Esquiva can be triggered while leaping. After successfully triggering a Perfect Esquiva, press or hold to follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging. Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.

claret.name: Ataque Básico: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe
claret.desc: While in the Crimson Inscription state, after launching [Ataque Especial: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron] or [Ataque Especial: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault] and successfully triggering [Maim], press or hold to activate: Use the Blood Axe to spin and leap into the air, then slam down and slash the target enemy, dealing Dano Elétrico. A Perfect Esquiva can be triggered while leaping. After using this skill, press or hold to chain into the 3rd hit of [Ataque Básico: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging]. [Crimson Inscription] will not end during this skill.

claret.name: Esquiva: Night Vision
claret.desc: Press to activate: A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Dash Ataque: Tempering
claret.desc: While not in the Crimson Inscription state, press during a Esquiva to activate: Perform a forward hammer strike, dealing Dano Elétrico.

claret.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Returning Edge
claret.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Use the hammer handle to deliver a powerful forward counterattack, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill

claret.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Bloodbloom Oath - Returning Edge
claret.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Use the Blood Axe to deliver a powerful forward counterattack, dealing Dano Elétrico. Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Ataque Especial: Porcelume's First Call
claret.desc: Press to activate: Launch two bludgeoning attacks forward, dealing Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

claret.name: Ataque Especial EX: Bloodbloom Oath - Secret Forging Techniques
claret.desc: With enough Sharpness, and while Claret is not in the Crimson Inscription state, press to activate: Transforms the forging hammer into the Blood Axe to slash the target enemy, dealing Dano Elétrico. After using this skill, Claret enters the Crimson Inscription state for 16s. While off-field, its duration no longer decreases. When Claret's attacks hit an enemy, if the enemy is defeated within 0.5s, the duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 3s. This effect can trigger once every 3s. During this skill, keep holding Icon_SpecialReady_Ep to skip the slash and quickly chain into the alternate Ataque Especial: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron and Ataque Especial: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault. After using this skill, press or hold to chain into the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Ataque Especial: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron
claret.desc: While in the Crimson Inscription state, press or to activate: Perform a powerful upward slash forward, then follow up with a horizontal Slash, dealing Dano Elétrico. When the horizontal Slash hits an enemy suffering [Gash], inflict [Maim] on the target, dealing additional AoE Dano Elétrico. [Crimson Inscription] will not end during this skill. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill. After successfully triggering [Maim], Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Ataque Especial: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault
claret.desc: While in the Crimson Inscription state and the upward slash of Ataque Especial: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron, keep holding or to activate: Perform three consecutive horizontal slashes forward, dealing massive Dano Elétrico; Each horizontal slash that hits an enemy holding [Gash] triggers [Maim] on the target, dealing additional AoE Dano Elétrico. Up to 3 consecutive instances of [Maim] can be triggered during this skill, with the 3rd [Maim] having a higher Interrupt Level; Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill; Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill. After successfully triggering [Maim], Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact
claret.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Launch a series of slashes against enemies ahead, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Crimson Inscription's duration does not decrease, and the state does not end during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial
claret.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Launch a series of slashes against enemies ahead, dealing massive Dano Elétrico; During this skill, Crimson Inscription's duration does not decrease, and the state does not end; Upon activating this skill, restore 10 Sharpness; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Suporte Rápido: Return of the Dire Moon
claret.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate: Deals Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Suporte Rápido: Bloodbloom Oath - Return of the Dire Moon
claret.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate: Deals Dano Elétrico. Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Suporte Defensivo: Unyielding Heart of the Furnace
claret.desc: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate: Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Ataque de Suporte: Bloodbloom Oath - Pureforged Edge
claret.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Deals massive Dano Elétrico. Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Counter Assist: Give Not an Inch of Steel
claret.desc: When the character or the on-field character is about to be hit by a Control Skill from certain enemies, press to activate: Engage the enemy in a power struggle. Win the struggle to neutralize the enemy's Control Skill and deal Dano Elétrico. Crimson Inscription's duration does not decrease during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Ataque de Suporte: Bloodbloom Oath - Hammer Into Shape
claret.desc: After using a Counter Assist, press to activate: Deals massive Dano Elétrico. When the heavy Ataque hits an enemy, it adds one stack of Gash to the target. Crimson Inscription's duration does not decrease during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

claret.name: Passiva de Núcleo Banquet of Pale Blood
claret.desc: Lv. 1

claret.name: Habilidade Adicional Bloodline Legacy
claret.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun) or Armorer character, or shares the same attribute:When any Agent in the squad triggers Contamination, Claret gains 300 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s.When Claret or another squad member triggers Maim, all Armorer Agents in the squad enter Remnant Edge. While in the Remnant Edge state, Laceration DMG is increased by 25%, lasting 40s. Triggering Remnant Edge again refreshes its duration.

claret.name: M1 Bloodstained Chronicle Cinema (Mindscape) 1
claret.desc: When Claret's attacks hit enemies and trigger Laceration, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 20%. The DMG Multiplier of Maim triggered by Claret increases to 130% of its original value.

claret.name: M2 Crown of Inherited Flame Cinema (Mindscape) 2
claret.desc: The maximum duration of [Crimson Inscription] is extended by 2s. While Claret is in the [Crimson Inscription] state, or while using a [Ataque em Cadeia], [Suprema (Ultimate)], [Counter Assist], or [Ataque de Suporte], attacks ignore 18% of the target's Electric RES.

claret.name: M3 Oath Written in Frosting Cinema (Mindscape) 3
claret.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

claret.name: M4 Crimson Moon Wanderer Cinema (Mindscape) 4
claret.desc: During the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging, the time by which the consecutive slashes can be extended is increased. DMG dealt by the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging, Ataque em Cadeia: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact, and Suprema (Ultimate): Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial increases by 20%.

claret.name: M5 Duskblood Furnace Cinema (Mindscape) 5
claret.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

claret.name: M6 Warm Night's Dream Cinema (Mindscape) 6
claret.desc: When the heavy attacks of Ataque em Cadeia: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact and Suprema (Ultimate): Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial hit an enemy, Claret directly triggers 1 instance of single-target Maim without consuming Gash.

corin.name: Ataque Básico: Wipeout
corin.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 5 slashes, dealing Dano Físico. Repeatedly press or hold the button during the 3rd and 5th hits to extend the chainsaw slash Ataque.

corin.name: Esquiva: Shoo!
corin.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

corin.name: Dash Ataque: Oopsy-Daisy!
corin.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw Ataque's duration.

corin.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Nope!
corin.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Slashes enemies in front before detonating her chainsaw, dealing Dano Físico. Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

corin.name: Ataque Especial: Clean Sweep
corin.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes a series of slashes upon enemies in front, before detonating the chainsaw, dealing Dano Físico. Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the duration of the chainsaw slash Ataque. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

corin.name: Ataque Especial EX: Beware the Skirt
corin.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Unleashes a series of powerful slashes upon enemies in front, before detonating the chainsaw, dealing massive Dano Físico. Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the duration of the chainsaw slash Ataque at the cost of Energy if the Ataque connects. Character is invulnerable during the spinning Slash. Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the extended slash, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

corin.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Sorry...
corin.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Dano Físico. Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

corin.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Very, Very Sorry!
corin.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in a small area, dealing massive Dano Físico. Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

corin.name: Ataque de Suporte: Quick Sweep
corin.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Unleash a series of slashes against enemies in front followed by an explosive chainsaw, dealing Dano Físico. Repeatedly press or hold to extend the chainsaw slash Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

corin.name: Suporte Defensivo: P—Please allow me!
corin.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

corin.name: Suporte Rápido: Emergency Measures
corin.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Slashes enemies in front before detonating her chainsaw, dealing Dano Físico. Repeatedly press or hold the button to extend the chainsaw slash Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

corin.name: Habilidade Adicional Cleanup Assistance
corin.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:Corin deals 35% more DMG to Stunned enemies.

corin.name: M1 Open Trauma Cinema (Mindscape) 1
corin.desc: When Corin's Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate) hits an enemy, her DMG against the target increases by 12% for 15s.

corin.name: M2 Atomic Smash Cinema (Mindscape) 2
corin.desc: When Corin's Ataque Especial EX, Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate) hits an enemy, the target's Physical RES is reduced by 0.5%, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

corin.name: M3 Amatuer Maid Cinema (Mindscape) 3
corin.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

corin.name: M4 Battlefield Retainer Cinema (Mindscape) 4
corin.desc: When Corin uses a Suporte Rápido, Suporte Defensivo, or Ataque em Cadeia, she recovers 7.2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 16s.

corin.name: M5 Special Ops Maid Cinema (Mindscape) 5
corin.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

corin.name: M6 Accumulated Release Cinema (Mindscape) 6
corin.desc: When Corin's extended slash hits an enemy, she obtains a stack of Charge (max 40 stacks). During a Contra-ataque de Esquiva, Ataque Especial, Ataque Especial EX, Suporte Rápido, or Ataque de Suporte, when her chainsaw detonation hits an enemy, consumes all stacks of Charge. Each stack consumed causes the Ataque to deal an additional 3% of ATK as DMG.

dialyn.name: Ataque Básico: Happy to Be of Service
dialyn.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to four attacks, dealing Dano Físico.

dialyn.name: Ataque Básico: Rock, Paper, Scissors
dialyn.desc: After Ataque Especial EX: Rock or Ataque Especial EX: Scissors, press to activate: Performs up to two attacks, dealing Dano Físico. During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

dialyn.name: Esquiva: Line Busy
dialyn.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Dash Ataque: Sudden Call
dialyn.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Launches a dashing Ataque at enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

dialyn.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Number Unavailable
dialyn.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Launches consecutive attacks against enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Happy to Be of Service. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Ataque Especial EX: Get Lost!
dialyn.desc: With Customer Complaint, hold to activate. Delivers a forward martial salute Ataque. On activation, it consumes 1 Customer Complaint and deals Dano Físico. On activation, the previous character's Suporte Rápido is triggered. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Ataque Especial: Welcome Gesture
dialyn.desc: Press to activate. Throws dual rings to slash enemies, dealing Dano Físico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Ataque Especial EX: Rock
dialyn.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate: Launches a fist Ataque, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Ataque Especial EX: Scissors
dialyn.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate: Launches a scissors Ataque, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Ataque Especial EX: Paper!
dialyn.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate: Launches a paper Ataque, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Welcome Mat
dialyn.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Launches consecutive kicks against enemies in front, dealing massive Dano Físico. After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Happy to Be of Service. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Service Stopped for Number Dialed
dialyn.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Rushes forward and performs a finger flick Ataque, dealing massive Dano Físico. After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Happy to Be of Service. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Ataque de Suporte: Back-to-Back Calls
dialyn.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Performs a rapid dash followed by a slash Ataque, dealing Dano Físico. After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Happy to Be of Service. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
dialyn.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Suporte Rápido: Forward Call
dialyn.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Launches consecutive attacks against enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Happy to Be of Service. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dialyn.name: Passiva de Núcleo Five-Star Service Hotline
dialyn.desc: Lv. 1

dialyn.name: Habilidade Adicional External Line
dialyn.desc: When another character in your squad is an Ataque or Rupture character or shares the same Faction:Dialyn's Ataque Especial EX Dano Crítico is increased by 50%.When an Ataque Especial EX or Suprema (Ultimate) is activated, all squad members gain the Overwhelmingly Positive effect. While Overwhelmingly Positive is active, DMG dealt is increased by 40% for 15s. When Dialyn uses an Ataque Especial EX or Suprema (Ultimate) while Overwhelmingly Positive is active, if the remaining duration of Overwhelmingly Positive is less than 35s, its duration is extended by 10s.When a heavy Ataque from Ataque Especial EX: Rock, Ataque Especial EX: Scissors, or Ataque Especial EX: Paper! hits, additional DMG is dealt based on the previous squad member's Specialty:If the squad member is an Ataque Agent, Ataque Especial EX: Rock, Ataque Especial EX: Scissors, and Ataque Especial EX: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 320% of that Ataque Agent's ATK.If the squad member is a Rupture Agent, Ataque Especial EX: Rock, Ataque Especial EX: Scissors, and Ataque Especial EX: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 400% of that Rupture Agent's Sheer Force.

dialyn.name: M1 Boundless Hospitality Cinema (Mindscape) 1
dialyn.desc: The amount of Positive Reviews accumulated each second and gained when Ataque Especial EX: Rock, Ataque Especial EX: Scissors, or Ataque Especial EX: Paper! hits an enemy increase by 16%. While the Overwhelmingly Positive effect is active, characters ignore 15% of enemy All-Attribute RES.

dialyn.name: M2 24/7 Hotline Cinema (Mindscape) 2
dialyn.desc: Enemies affected by Malicious Complaint gain an additional 20% Atordoamento (Stun) DMG Multiplier when Stunned, and all units deal 15% increased DMG to targets affected by Malicious Complaint.

dialyn.name: M3 Call From the Hollow Cinema (Mindscape) 3
dialyn.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

dialyn.name: M4 The Past Never Fades Cinema (Mindscape) 4
dialyn.desc: Upon entering combat, Dialyn recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. While the Overwhelmingly Positive effect is active, Dialyn's ATK increases by 500.

dialyn.name: M5 Lies Cinema (Mindscape) 5
dialyn.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

dialyn.name: M6 Truth Cinema (Mindscape) 6
dialyn.desc: When an ally enters the field with an Suprema (Ultimate) through the Passiva de Núcleo's effect, that ally gains the Aftertone effect. With this effect, landing an Ataque causes Dialyn to deal an additional instance of Dano Físico equal to 480% of Dialyn's ATK. This DMG is treated as Ataque Especial EX DMG, and can trigger once every second, up to 12 times. Gaining Aftertone again refreshes its trigger count. Only one ally can have Aftertone at a time.

ellen.name: Potential Potential Awakening: Permafrost Zone
ellen.desc: Lv. 1

ellen.name: Ataque Básico: Saw Teeth Trimming
ellen.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes up to 3 slashes, dealing Dano Físico. Press repeatedly or hold during the 3rd Ataque to extend the skill duration.

ellen.name: Ataque Básico: Flash Freeze Trimming
ellen.desc: While Flash Freeze is in effect, press to activate. Launch up to 3 attacks at enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Each Ataque consumes 1 Flash Freeze Charge. Press repeatedly or hold during the 3rd Ataque to extend the skill duration.

ellen.name: Ataque Básico: Glacial Blade Wave
ellen.desc: After the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Flash Freeze Trimming, Dash Ataque: Arctic Ambush's charged scissor strike, Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Reef Rock, and Suporte Rápido, if Ellen has Flash Freeze Charges, pressing will launch Ataque Básico: Glacial Blade Wave, dealing Dano de Gelo. This skill consumes 2 points of Flash Freeze Charge. After use, it can be directly followed up with the 3rd hit of her Ataque Básico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ellen.name: Ataque Básico: Icy Blade
ellen.desc: After the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Flash Freeze Trimming, Ataque Especial EX: Sharknami, Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Reef Rock, and Ataque de Suporte, automatically launch Ataque Básico: Icy Blade, dealing multiple instances of Dano de Gelo to all enemies in a large area ahead. It inflicts additional instances of Dano de Gelo against Medium and Large foes. After the skill, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect. Ataque Básico: Icy Blade does not affect the branch or form of the original skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ellen.name: Esquiva: Vortex
ellen.desc: Press to activate. A rapid dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. When Perfect Esquiva is triggered, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, reducing the charge time of Dash Ataque: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5 seconds or until it triggers.

ellen.name: Dash: Roaming Hunt
ellen.desc: Hold or double-tap to activate. Enter the Roaming state, allowing dashing movement. In the Roaming state, drag the stick/joystick to control Ellen's direction, and release to stop. Ellen is invulnerable for a brief time after activation.

ellen.name: Flash Freeze
ellen.desc: When Ellen has Flash Freeze Charges, the Flash Freeze effect is activated. Once Flash Freeze activates, Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks expend Flash Freeze Charges, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Ellen can have up to a maximum of 6 Flash Freeze Charges.

ellen.name: Dash Ataque: Arctic Ambush
ellen.desc: While in the Roaming state, press to activate. Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing Dano de Gelo. Gain 1 point of Flash Freeze Charge when the Swift Scissors strike hits. While in the Roaming state, hold to activate. Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissor strike, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Gain 3 points of Flash Freeze Charge when the Charged Scissor strike hits. If the enemy is Frozen, it always triggers Shatter. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. When taking DMG from enemies while the skill is charging, that instance of DMG is nullified, and charging instantly completes. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ellen.name: Dash Ataque: Monstrous Wave
ellen.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Launches a dashing slash Ataque at enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

ellen.name: Dash Ataque: Cold Snap
ellen.desc: While Flash Freeze is active, press during a Esquiva to activate: Launches a dashing slash Ataque at enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Consumes 1 Flash Freeze Charge.

ellen.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Reef Rock
ellen.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Rapidly move through enemies with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable during the Ataque.

ellen.name: Ataque Especial: Drift
ellen.desc: Press to activate. Use a quick tail sweep Ataque in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ellen.name: Ataque Especial EX: Tail Swipe
ellen.desc: With enough energy, press to activate. Perform a forceful tail whip Ataque that deals massive Dano de Gelo. Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy. After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Ataque Básico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ellen.name: Ataque Especial EX: Sharknami
ellen.desc: After activating Ataque Especial EX: Tail Swipe, with enough Energy, press to activate: Perform a powerful series of slashes ahead that deal massive Dano de Gelo. Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy. After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Ataque Básico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ellen.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Avalanche
ellen.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, press the character icon to activate. Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ellen.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Endless Winter
ellen.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm before a powerful scissor strike, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ellen.name: Ataque de Suporte: Shark Cruiser
ellen.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Press repeatedly or hold during the Ataque to extend the skill duration. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ellen.name: Suporte Defensivo: Wavefront Impacto
ellen.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ellen.name: Suporte Rápido: Shark Sentinel
ellen.desc: When the character on the field is knocked back, press to activate. Speedily move through the enemy with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. When the character on the field is launched, drag and press to activate. Enter the Roaming state, enabling dashing movement. While in the Roaming state, use the stick/joystick to change directions and release to stop. Character is invulnerable briefly when triggering the skill. Upon triggering a Suporte Rápido, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, shortening the charging time of Dash Ataque: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5s or until it triggers once.

ellen.name: Passiva de Núcleo Sharp-Toothed
ellen.desc: Lv. 1

ellen.name: Habilidade Adicional Rising Storm
ellen.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun) character or shares the same Attribute or Faction:When Ellen deals Dano de Gelo, subsequent Dano de Gelo increases by 3% for 10s. This effect can stack up to 10 times, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

ellen.name: M1 Glacial Omen Cinema (Mindscape) 1
ellen.desc: Upon hitting an enemy with a Swift Scissors during Dash Ataque: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 3. Upon hitting an enemy with a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Ataque: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 6. For each Flash Freeze Charge consumed, Ellen's Taxa Crítica is increased by 2% for 15s, stacking up to 6 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

ellen.name: M2 Arctic Ocean Predator Cinema (Mindscape) 2
ellen.desc: The 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Flash Freeze Trimming can be directly followed up with Ataque Especial EX: Sharknami. When using an Ataque Especial EX, each Flash Freeze Charge increases the current Ataque's Dano Crítico by 20%, up to a max of 60%.

ellen.name: M3 Overtime-Intolerant Cinema (Mindscape) 3
ellen.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

ellen.name: M4 Endless Hoarfrost Cinema (Mindscape) 4
ellen.desc: Whenever a squad member Freezes or Stuns an enemy, Ellen gains 6 Flash Freeze Charges and the Quick Charge effect. She also recovers 4 Energy. The Energy recovery effect can trigger once per 10s.

ellen.name: M5 Adequate Sleep Cinema (Mindscape) 5
ellen.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

ellen.name: M6 The Feast Begins Cinema (Mindscape) 6
ellen.desc: When Ellen uses an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque em Cadeia, or gains Quick Charge, her Perfuração Ratio increases by 20% for 6s. She also gains 1 stack of The Feast Begins, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. With 3 stacks of The Feast Begins, using a Charge Scissor Strike during Dash Ataque: Arctic Ambush consumes all stacks, increasing the DMG of the current Ataque by 250%.

evelyn.name: Ataque Básico: Razor Wire
evelyn.desc: Press to activate: Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Fogo. When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.

evelyn.name: Passive: Bind
evelyn.desc: When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate Burning Embers. When Evelyn consumes Burning Embers to activate Garrote or consumes Decibels to perform an Suprema (Ultimate), she gains 1 Burning Tether Point. Once Evelyn has 3 Burning Tether Points, her next use of Garrote will consume all Burning Tether Points to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of Ataque em Cadeia: Lunalux - Snare.

evelyn.name: Ataque Básico: Garrote - First Form
evelyn.desc: When Burning Embers is at 50% or higher, hold or to activate: Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a slashing Ataque, dealing Dano de Fogo. During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

evelyn.name: Ataque Básico: Garrote - Second Form
evelyn.desc: When Burning Embers is 50% or higher, after using Ataque Básico: Garrote - First Form, continue to hold or to activate: Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a follow-up Ataque, dealing Dano de Fogo. During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

evelyn.name: Esquiva: Arc Step
evelyn.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

evelyn.name: Dash Ataque: Piercing Ambush
evelyn.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Deliver a kick to the enemy in front, causing Dano Físico.

evelyn.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Strangling Reversal
evelyn.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Dano de Fogo; When the Ataque hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

evelyn.name: Ataque Especial: Locked Position
evelyn.desc: Before entering Binding Seal, press to activate. Use Lunalux Garrote to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing Dano de Fogo. When the Ataque hits the enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

evelyn.name: Ataque Especial: Binding Sunder - First Form
evelyn.desc: After entering Binding Seal, press or hold to activate: Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing Dano de Fogo. Binding Seal will end after detonation. Esquiva enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Esquiva is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers. After tethering surrounding enemies, press to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Ataque Básico's 3rd hit. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

evelyn.name: Ataque Especial EX: Binding Sunder - Final Form
evelyn.desc: After entering Binding Seal and with enough Energy, press or hold to activate: Centered on the target affected by Binding Seal, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Binding Seal will end after detonation. Esquiva enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a Perfect Esquiva is triggered, gain an additional 25% Burning Embers. After pulling in surrounding enemies, press to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the Ataque Básico's 3rd hit. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

evelyn.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Lunalux - Snare"
evelyn.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Dano de Fogo to enemies in the area. When the Ataque hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enters Binding Seal. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

evelyn.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Lunalux Garrote - Timbre
evelyn.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Dano de Fogo to enemies in the area. Upon activating this skill, Evelyn removes her jacket and enters the Dance of Awakened Fire state, which lasts for the entire battle. While in the Dance of Awakened Fire state, when Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Points to activate Ataque em Cadeia: Lunalux - Snare, she will retain 1 point of Burning Tether Point. When the Ataque hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target, entering Binding Seal. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

evelyn.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Lunalux Garrote - Shadow
evelyn.desc: While under the Dance of Awakened Fire state, and when Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Evelyn slashes in front with multiple Lunalux Garrotes and detonates an explosion, dealing massive Dano de Fogo to enemies in the area. When the Ataque hits an enemy, Evelyn uses Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enters Binding Seal. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

evelyn.name: Ataque de Suporte: Course Disruption
evelyn.desc: Press after an Suporte Defensivo to activate: Evelyn slashes with Lunalux Garrote, then triggers an explosion ahead, dealing Dano de Fogo. When the Ataque hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

evelyn.name: Suporte Defensivo: Silent Protection
evelyn.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

evelyn.name: Suporte Rápido: Fierce Blade
evelyn.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Use Lunalux Garrote to slash surrounding enemies, dealing Dano de Fogo. When the Ataque hits an enemy, Evelyn will use Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

evelyn.name: Passiva de Núcleo Entangle
evelyn.desc: Lv. 1

evelyn.name: Habilidade Adicional Ambush Point
evelyn.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun) or Suporte character:Evelyn's Ataque em Cadeia and Suprema (Ultimate) DMG increases by 30%. When Evelyn's Taxa Crítica is at or over 80%, the DMG multiplier for her Ataque em Cadeia and Suprema (Ultimate) increases to 125% of the original value.

evelyn.name: M1 Dreamweave Cinema (Mindscape) 1
evelyn.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Evelyn immediately gains 1,500 Decibels. Enemies affected by Binding Seal will be Bound. When Evelyn attacks Bound enemies, she ignores 12% of their DEF. When Evelyn uses Ataque Especial: Binding Sunder - First Form or Ataque Especial EX: Binding Sunder - Final Form, the Bound effect spreads to all enemies hit by the skill. This spread Bound effect lasts for 10s.

evelyn.name: M2 Dance of Fire Cinema (Mindscape) 2
evelyn.desc: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses Ataque Básico: Garrote - First Form or Ataque Básico: Garrote - Second Form, the Burning Embers consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Point to trigger Ataque em Cadeia: Lunalux - Snare, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.

evelyn.name: M3 Metamorphosis Cinema (Mindscape) 3
evelyn.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

evelyn.name: M4 Fate's Melody Cinema (Mindscape) 4
evelyn.desc: Upon activating a Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate), Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's Dano Crítico increases by 40%.

evelyn.name: M5 Crimson Threads Like the Dawn Cinema (Mindscape) 5
evelyn.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

evelyn.name: M6 Bond of Light and Shadow Cinema (Mindscape) 6
evelyn.desc: When activating her Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate), Evelyn gains Shadowstring Edge for 20s. During Shadowstring Edge, when Evelyn hits enemies with a Ataque Básico, Dash Ataque, Ataque Especial, or Ataque Especial EX, an additional Lunalux Garrote will be released for a follow-up Ataque, dealing Dano de Fogo equal to 375% of Evelyn's ATK. This DMG is considered Ataque em Cadeia DMG and can trigger up to 16 times. The number of triggers will be refreshed each time Shadowstring Edge is gained.

grace.name: Potential Awakened Potential: Overclocked Engineering Engine
grace.desc: Lv. 1

grace.name: Ataque Básico: High-Pressure Spike
grace.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes up to 4 attacks, dealing Dano Físico and Dano Elétrico. While launching Basic Attacks, drag the stick/joystick to move while attacking. This allows Grace to reposition herself and deal Dano Físico. If used after the 1st or 2nd hit of a Ataque Básico, pressing again resumes the combo from the 3rd or 4th hit of the Ataque Básico. While Grace is launching Basic Attacks, her Ataque Básico combo will not be interrupted by her Special Attacks, EX Special Attacks, Esquiva, Dash Attacks, or Contra-ataque de Esquiva.

grace.name: Esquiva: Safety Regulation
grace.desc: Press to Esquiva. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

grace.name: Dash Ataque: Quick Inspection
grace.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Slide forward while shooting, dealing Dano Físico.

grace.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Violation Penalty
grace.desc: Press during a perfect Esquiva to activate. Throws a grenade at enemies, dealing Dano Elétrico, then automatically triggers the Ataque Básico's 4th hit. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

grace.name: Ataque Especial: Obstruction Removal
grace.desc: Press to activate. Throws a grenade to the front, dealing Dano Elétrico. During the skill, drag the stick/joystick to reposition in that direction. When activated via consuming Zap, Esquiva incoming enemy attacks. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

grace.name: Ataque Especial EX: Supercharged Obstruction Removal
grace.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate: Leaps into the air and throws two grenades forward, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. During the skill, drag the stick/joystick to change directions. If Zap reaches max stacks, throws an additional Vortex Cluster Grenade, generating an electromagnetic field at the point of detonation that pulls in enemies and deals Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

grace.name: Pulse
grace.desc: Activating an Suprema (Ultimate) grants 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks). When gaining Zap, consumes 1 stack of Pulse. After consuming Pulse to obtain 8 stacks of Zap, the next grenade throw includes an additional Pulse Grenade. If it hits an enemy suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomalia, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 560%/280%/700%/50%/70%/28 of the original Anomalia's DMG. While in the Pulse state, Ataque Especial: Obstruction Removal - Cycle is unlocked.

grace.name: Ataque Especial: Obstruction Removal - Cycle
grace.desc: While in the Pulse state, hold to activate: Repeatedly hurls grenades forward during the skill, dealing Dano Elétrico and granting 1 Zap stack each time grenades are thrown. During the skill, tilt the stick/joystick to reposition and Esquiva enemy attacks. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

grace.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Collaborative Construction
grace.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the corresponding character to activate. Throws three grenades into the air then strafes to detonate them, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

grace.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Demolition Blast - Beware
grace.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum press to activate. Throws a custom grenade which explodes in the air and splits into four smaller grenades, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Gains 8 stacks of Zap and 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

grace.name: Ataque de Suporte: Counter Volt Needle
grace.desc: Press after an Evasive Assist to activate. Unleashes a spinning hail of bullets against enemies in front and throws a grenade, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

grace.name: Evasive Assist: Rapid Risk Response
grace.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Dodges the enemy's Ataque and activates the Vital View. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

grace.name: Suporte Rápido: Incident Management
grace.desc: When the on-field character is launched in the air, press to activate. Throws a grenade at the enemy, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

grace.name: Passiva de Núcleo Pre-Driven Needle
grace.desc: Lv. 1

grace.name: Habilidade Adicional Tech Suporte Dept.
grace.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:When Grace's Ataque Especial EX hits an enemy, the next time that target is afflicted with Shock that instance of Shock DMG is increased by 18%, stacking up to 2 times. This effect can trigger on each enemy only once per skill use, and all stacks reset when the Shock state ends.

grace.name: M1 Recharge Chamber Cinema (Mindscape) 1
grace.desc: When the 4th hit of Grace's Ataque Básico hits an enemy, all squad members gain 0.25 Energy. Within the same move, this effect can grant a max of 2 Energy to all squad members.

grace.name: M2 Lightning Piercer Cinema (Mindscape) 2
grace.desc: When Grace's grenade hits an enemy during a Ataque Básico, Ataque Especial, or Ataque Especial EX, the target's Electric RES is reduced by 8.5%, and Electric Anomalia Buildup RES is reduced by 8.5%, lasting for 8s.

grace.name: M3 Chief Mechanic Cinema (Mindscape) 3
grace.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

grace.name: M4 Burst Capacitor Cinema (Mindscape) 4
grace.desc: When Grace uses her Ataque Especial EX, she gains 6 stacks of Charge (max 6 stacks). When her Ataque Básico or Dash Ataque hits an enemy, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing her Energy Generation Rate of the Ataque by 20%.

grace.name: M5 Frosty Cold Iron Witch Cinema (Mindscape) 5
grace.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

grace.name: M6 Detonation Trigger Cinema (Mindscape) 6
grace.desc: When all Zap stacks are consumed to activate a Ataque Especial or Ataque Especial EX, Grace's skill is enhanced, tossing an extra grenade and increasing each grenade's DMG to 200%.

harumasa.name: Potential Potential Awakening: Focus
harumasa.desc: Lv. 1

harumasa.name: Ataque Básico: Cloud Piercer
harumasa.desc: Press or hold to activate: Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing Dano Físico and Dano Elétrico. When the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico hits an enemy, it generates 2 Electro Quivers. After activating a Ataque em Cadeia, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Cloud Piercer and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.

harumasa.name: Ataque Básico: Cloud Piercer - Drift
harumasa.desc: During Ataque Básico: Cloud Piercer, drag the stick/joystick and press to activate: Shoot a ranged piercing Ataque and reposition towards the corresponding drag direction, dealing Dano Físico.

harumasa.name: Ataque Básico: Falling Feather
harumasa.desc: After the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Cloud Piercer, a Ataque Especial, an Ataque Especial EX, or a Ataque em Cadeia, hold to activate: Immediately shoot Falling Feather at enemies ahead, dealing Dano Elétrico. Hold to aim at a target and release to activate: After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot Falling Feather at the target, dealing Dano Elétrico.

harumasa.name: Ataque Básico: Ha-Oto no Ya
harumasa.desc: When the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Cloud Piercer/Ataque Especial EX/Ataque em Cadeia hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 Electro Quivers. If there are no Electro Quivers on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomalia to an enemy, generate 6 Electro Quivers. This effect can trigger once every 12s. There can be up to 6 Electro Quivers present at a time. If there are any Electro Quivers present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with Falling Feather, the Electro Quivers will activate and fire Ha-Oto no Ya at the enemies hit by Falling Feather, dealing Dano Elétrico. Ha-Oto no Ya will apply Electro Prison to enemies hit, stacking up to 8 times and lasting 10s, repeated triggers reset the duration. While a target has at least 2 stacks of Electro Prison, they will be X-Marked.

harumasa.name: Esquiva: Quick Flash
harumasa.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

harumasa.name: Dash Ataque: Hiten no Tsuru
harumasa.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Launch multiple piercing attacks ahead, dealing Dano Físico.

harumasa.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Hidden Edge
harumasa.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Pierces enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

harumasa.name: Dash Ataque: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
harumasa.desc: While there are X-Marked enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the Awakened state, switching Dash Ataque: Hiten no Tsuru for Dash Ataque: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. While in the Awakened state, press during a Esquiva to activate: Rush forwards to the closest X-Marked enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing Dano Elétrico. When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of Electro Prison. With less than 2 stacks of Electro Prison, X-Marked will be removed from the enemy. Before X-Marked is removed, repeatedly press to repeatedly use Dash Ataque: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. While no X-Marked enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the Awakened state. While in the Awakened state, press after Ataque Básico: Falling Featherto quickly follow up with Dash Ataque: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

harumasa.name: Ataque Especial: Nowhere to Hide
harumasa.desc: Press to activate. Launch an arrow forward, dealing Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

harumasa.name: Ataque Especial EX: Nowhere to Run
harumasa.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers. Character is invulnerable while using this skill

harumasa.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Kai - Hanare
harumasa.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleash a piercing Ataque on enemies in a large area ahead then fire an enhanced arrow, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. When the arrow hits the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

harumasa.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Zanshin
harumasa.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleash a piercing Ataque on enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

harumasa.name: Suporte Defensivo: Yugamae
harumasa.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

harumasa.name: Suporte Defensivo: Yugamae - Slash
harumasa.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

harumasa.name: Suporte Rápido: Braced Bow
harumasa.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Unleash a piercing Ataque at enemies ahead, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

harumasa.name: Passiva de Núcleo Day Break
harumasa.desc: Lv. 1

harumasa.name: Habilidade Adicional Overclock
harumasa.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun) or Anomalia character:When Harumasa's attacks hit Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomalia, his DMG increases by 40%. When Harumasa's Falling Feather hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomalia, it will apply 2 stacks of Electro Prison to the target.

harumasa.name: M1 High Spirit Cinema (Mindscape) 1
harumasa.desc: The maximum stack limit of Electro Prison from Ataque Básico: Ha-Oto no Ya increases to 14 stacks. When an Electro Quiver is triggered, 2 consecutive Ha-Oto no Ya will be fired at the target.

harumasa.name: M2 Languish Cinema (Mindscape) 2
harumasa.desc: When using an Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate), Harumasa gains 7 stacks of Electro Blitz, up to a max of 7 stacks. While possessing Electro Blitz, the DMG of Dash Ataque: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash increases by 50%. Consume 1 stack of Electro Blitz once Dash Ataque: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash ends.

harumasa.name: M3 White Lies Cinema (Mindscape) 3
harumasa.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

harumasa.name: M4 Occasionally Motivated Cinema (Mindscape) 4
harumasa.desc: Electro Prison now lasts for 20s. When Dash Ataque: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash hits enemies, Harumasa gains 30 Decibels once per use of this skill. Upon activating Suprema (Ultimate), apply maximum stacks of Electro Prison to all on-field enemies.

harumasa.name: M5 No One Knows Cinema (Mindscape) 5
harumasa.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

harumasa.name: M6 Tacit Understanding Cinema (Mindscape) 6
harumasa.desc: After Ha-Oto no Ya hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomalies, Harumasa will ignore 15% of the target's Electric RES for 12s. Every 12 times an enemy is hit by Ha-Oto no Ya, trigger an extra electromagnetic explosion, dealing 1500% of Harumasa's ATK to the target as Dano Elétrico.

hugo.name: Ataque Básico: Dark Abyss Quartet
hugo.desc: Press to activate: Perform up to four attacks forward, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Gelo. The fourth Ataque is a shot. During this Ataque, hold to charge and perform a charged shot. Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the fourth Ataque.

hugo.name: Ataque Básico: Dark Abyss Concerto
hugo.desc: After the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Dark Abyss Quartet, the shot of Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Phantasm - Slash, or the shot of Suporte Rápido: Elegy, press or hold to activate: Throw the scythe forward to perform a slash, followed by a shot, dealing Dano de Gelo. During the shot, hold to charge and perform a charged shot. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

hugo.name: Esquiva: Phantasm
hugo.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

hugo.name: Dash Ataque: Phantasm - Shatter
hugo.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Launch a dashing Ataque at enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

hugo.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Phantasm - Slash
hugo.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. During the skill, hold to launch a shot. During the shot, hold to charge and perform a charged shot. The shot is considered a Ataque Básico, with its DMG treated as Ataque Básico DMG. After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Dark Abyss Quartet. Character is Invulnerable during the slashes and shooting retreat of the skill.

hugo.name: Ataque Especial: Soul Hunter - Judgment
hugo.desc: Press to activate. Spins the scythe and then unleashes a forward slash, dealing Dano de Gelo. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

hugo.name: Ataque Especial EX: Soul Hunter - Punishment
hugo.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Spins the scythe and then executes a powerful upward Ataque, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. This skill is not counted as a heavy Ataque. After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Dark Abyss Quartet. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

hugo.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Trick of Fate
hugo.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Dash forward to perform a slash across a large area, then launch a shot, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. The shot activated by this skill is considered a charged shot. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

hugo.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Blaspheme
hugo.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Throws the scythe in a powerful spinning Ataque, then catches the scythe and launches a slash in a large area, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. This skill is not counted as a heavy Ataque. After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Dark Abyss Quartet. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

hugo.name: Ataque de Suporte: Ace Reversal
hugo.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Dash forward and perform two slashes, dealing Dano de Gelo. After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Dark Abyss Quartet. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

hugo.name: Suporte Defensivo: The End Has Not Come
hugo.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

hugo.name: Suporte Rápido: Elegy
hugo.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. During the skill, hold to launch a shot. During the shot, hold to charge and perform a charged shot. The shot is considered a Ataque Básico, with the DMG treated as Ataque Básico DMG. After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Dark Abyss Quartet. Character is Invulnerable during the slashes and shooting retreat of the skill.

hugo.name: Passiva de Núcleo Terminating Verdict
hugo.desc: Lv. 1

hugo.name: Habilidade Adicional Prelude to Finality
hugo.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun) character or shares the same attribute:Ataque em Cadeia: Trick of Fate's DMG increases by 15%, with a further increase of 35% against normal enemies. When Totalize is triggered, the DMG dealt by the skill increases by 40%. Ataque Especial EX: Soul Hunter - Punishment generates an additional 20 Energy when triggering Totalize on normal enemies. The Energy generation effect can trigger once every 30s.

hugo.name: M1 Child of Hatred Cinema (Mindscape) 1
hugo.desc: When triggering the Totalize effect in the Dark Abyss Reverb state, the skill's Taxa Crítica is increased by an additional 12%, and Dano Crítico by 30%.

hugo.name: M2 The Child Within Cinema (Mindscape) 2
hugo.desc: When Suprema (Ultimate): Blaspheme triggers Totalize, it will not end the enemy's Stunned state. Additionally, when Totalize is triggered, the skill will ignore 15% of the enemy's DEF.

hugo.name: M3 Fruit of the Poisonous Tree Cinema (Mindscape) 3
hugo.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

hugo.name: M4 Dramatic Theory Cinema (Mindscape) 4
hugo.desc: After a Charged Shot hits an enemy, Hugo's attacks against that target will ignore 12% of that target's Ice RES for 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration.

hugo.name: M5 Nirvana Cinema (Mindscape) 5
hugo.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

hugo.name: M6 Crown of Thorns Cinema (Mindscape) 6
hugo.desc: All shooting attacks that hit enemies trigger the Dark Abyss Reverb state, lasting up to 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. Additionally, whenever any skill triggers the Totalize effect, that DMG is further increased by 60%. The Finishing Move of Ataque Especial EX: Soul Hunter - Punishment also triggers the Totalize effect when hitting an enemy that isn't Stunned, boosting the DMG multiplier of the Finishing Move by a fixed 1,000 %.

janedoe.name: Potential Heartsnatch Tango
janedoe.desc: Lv. 1

janedoe.name: Ataque Básico: Dancing Blades
janedoe.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to six consecutive attacks ahead, dealing Dano Físico. The sixth Ataque Básico is also treated as a Dash Ataque, and Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

janedoe.name: Passion
janedoe.desc: When Jane triggers Perfect Esquiva, Suporte Defensivo, or performs a move that deals DMG to the enemy, she accumulates Passion Stream. Upon reaching the maximum Passion Stream, Jane enters the Passion state. While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomalia Buildup Rate is increased by 25%. Additionally, if Jane's Proficiência de Anomalia exceeds 120, each extra point raises her ATK by 2, up to a maximum of 600. In the Passion state, Jane's skills that deal damage consume Passion Stream. Activating a Perfect Esquiva or Suporte Defensivo regenerates Passion Stream. Jane exits the Passion state when all of her Passion Stream is consumed.

janedoe.name: Ataque Básico: Salchow Jump
janedoe.desc: Entering the Passion state grants Jane one use of Ataque Básico: Salchow Jump. When available, hold to activate: Launch rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Dano Físico. Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to greatly extend the skill duration. Release to trigger the Finishing Move early. Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the Finishing Move, which can also trigger a Perfect Esquiva upon activation. If a Perfect Esquiva is triggered, the Finishing Move restores more Passion Stream on hit. Using and damaging an enemy with Ataque Básico: Salchow Jump while in the Passion state generates Passion Stream.

janedoe.name: Esquiva: Phantom
janedoe.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Jane has an extra Esquiva. Before she enters the Passion state, she alternates between the two dodges. After entering the Passion state, Jane can pass through enemies in front when dodging.

janedoe.name: Dash Ataque: Edge Jump
janedoe.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. If after the first Esquiva, launch an upward slash in front, dealing Dano Físico. If after the second Esquiva, perform a consecutive slashes in front, dealing Dano Físico.

janedoe.name: Dash Ataque: Phantom Thrust
janedoe.desc: While in the Passion state, press during a Esquiva to activate: Launch three quick rushing slashes in front, dealing Dano Físico.

janedoe.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Swift Shadow
janedoe.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. If after the first Esquiva, unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing Dano Físico. If after the second Esquiva, leap up and deliver three consecutive attacks to enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

janedoe.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Swift Shadow Dance
janedoe.desc: While in the Passion state, press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Slash enemies in front quickly multiple times, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

janedoe.name: Ataque Especial EX: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught
janedoe.desc: While in the Passion state and with enough Energy, press to activate: Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill, which also counts as a Dash Ataque.

janedoe.name: Ataque Especial: Aerial Sweep
janedoe.desc: Press to activate. Leaps into the air to launch consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing Dano Físico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

janedoe.name: Ataque Especial EX: Aerial Sweep - Clearout
janedoe.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate: Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill, which also counts as a Dash Ataque.

janedoe.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Flowers of Sin
janedoe.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Weaves between and slashes enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive Dano Físico. Jane directly enters the Passion state upon activating the skill, and gains max Passion Stream. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

janedoe.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Final Curtain
janedoe.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Weaves between and slashes enemies with a powerful Ataque in a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Dano Físico. Jane directly enters the Passion state upon activating the skill, and gains max Passion Stream. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

janedoe.name: Ataque de Suporte: Gale Sweep
janedoe.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Leap up and swiftly slash the enemy, then execute a wide sweeping slash across a large area in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

janedoe.name: Suporte Defensivo: Last Defesa
janedoe.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

janedoe.name: Suporte Rápido: Dark Thorn
janedoe.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Unleash multiple slashes at enemies in front, followed by a downward thrust, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

janedoe.name: Suporte Rápido: Lutz Jump
janedoe.desc: While in the Passion state, when the on-field character is launched, press to activate: Slash enemies in front quickly multiple times, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

janedoe.name: Passiva de Núcleo Insight
janedoe.desc: Lv. 1

janedoe.name: Habilidade Adicional Sore Spot
janedoe.desc: When another character in your squad is an Anomalia character or shares the same Faction:Jane's Physical Anomalia Buildup Rate is increased by 20%. When the enemy is already suffering from an Attribute Anomalia, Jane's Physical Anomalia Buildup towards the target is increased by an additional 15%.

janedoe.name: M1 Crime Counsel Cinema (Mindscape) 1
janedoe.desc: The maximum uses of Ataque Básico: Salchow Jump are increased by one. While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomalia Buildup Rate increases by an extra 15% and each point of Jane's Proficiência de Anomalia increases her damage by 0.1%, up to a maximum of 30%.

janedoe.name: M2 Adapt to the Environment Cinema (Mindscape) 2
janedoe.desc: When Jane's Ataque hits an enemy in the Gnawed state, or when any squad member triggers Assault on an enemy in the Gnawed state, 15% of the enemy's DEF is ignored. Additionally, when Assault DMG triggers a critical hit, the Dano Crítico dealt is increased by an additional 50%.

janedoe.name: M3 Anonymity Cinema (Mindscape) 3
janedoe.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

janedoe.name: M4 Adapt and Thrive Cinema (Mindscape) 4
janedoe.desc: When any squad member triggers the Assault or Disorder effects, all squad members' Attribute Anomalia DMG is increased by 18%, lasting 15s.

janedoe.name: M5 Compulsive Hoarder Cinema (Mindscape) 5
janedoe.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

janedoe.name: M6 Shady Technique Cinema (Mindscape) 6
janedoe.desc: While in the Passion state, Jane's Taxa Crítica increases by 20%, and Dano Crítico by 40%. After any squad member inflicts Assault, Jane instantly enters the Passion state, and gains max Passion Stream. When Assault deals a CRIT, Jane performs an additional Ataque on the target, dealing Dano Físico equal to 1,600% of her Proficiência de Anomalia.

jufufu.name: Ataque Básico: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw
jufufu.desc: Press to activate: Slash forward up to four times, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Fogo. During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press to maintain the combo and keep striking the enemy. During the 3rd hit, hold or pause before pressing to chain into the 4th hit. During the 3rd hit, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

jufufu.name: Ataque Básico: Hu Wei
jufufu.desc: During combat, Hu Wei will automatically Ataque enemies, dealing Dano de Fogo. Upon hitting an enemy, gain 20 points of Might, triggering up to once per use of a skill. The maximum for Might is 200.

jufufu.name: Esquiva: Tiger Seven Forms - Tigerwind
jufufu.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

jufufu.name: Dash Ataque: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge
jufufu.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Perform a quick slash forward, dealing Dano Físico.

jufufu.name: Dash Ataque: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain King's Game
jufufu.desc: After using Dash Ataque: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge, hold to activate: Enter a high-speed spinning state. While in this state, use the stick/joystick to move and deal Dano Físico upon contact with enemies. After Ju Fufu gains Momentum from other skills, she will be surrounded by flames in the high-speed spinning state.
