Upon contact with enemies, 1 point of Momentum is consumed, changing the DMG to Dano de Fogo and granting 25 points of Might. The maximum for Momentum is 15. When dealing Dano de Fogo, if Might is above 100 points, 100 points of Might will be automatically consumed to trigger Ataque em Cadeia: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron. Releasing will have Ju Fufu exit the spinning state and throw Hu Wei to Ataque enemies. When switching to another character, Ju Fufu will remain in the spinning state and attempt to collide with the nearest enemy. While Ju Fufu is the currently active character, DMG taken during the skill is reduced by 40%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If not the active character, she becomes Invulnerable.

jufufu.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Tiger Seven Forms - Reignited Mountain
jufufu.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Perform multiple slashes on enemies ahead, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

jufufu.name: Ataque Especial: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain-Descending Tiger
jufufu.desc: Press to activate. Perform a spinning slash forward, followed by a falling slash, dealing Dano de Fogo. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

jufufu.name: Ataque Especial EX: Tiger Seven Forms Alt - Mountain-Descending Savage Tiger
jufufu.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Swing Hu Wei forward for a powerful strike, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Upon activation, gain 3 points of Momentum and 80 points of Might. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

jufufu.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Tiger Cauldron Collapse
jufufu.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Swing Hu Wei to deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

jufufu.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron
jufufu.desc: With at least 100 points of Might, after triggering a Ataque em Cadeia, automatically activate: Consume 100 Might to open Hu Wei and fire flames and popcorn at enemies, striking them in a small area ahead, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. If Momentum is available, and while not the active character, Fiery Spin will activate after the skill ends. This is an Aftershock. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

jufufu.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Tiger Seven Forms - Raging Tiger Explosion
jufufu.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Perform two downward attacks with Hu Wei, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Upon activation, gain 6 points of Momentum and 100 points of Might. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

jufufu.name: Ataque de Suporte: Feral Blazing Maw
jufufu.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Slash forward at enemies, then use Hu Wei to follow up with a downward Ataque, dealing Dano de Fogo. Gain 1 point of Momentum upon activation at most once every 10s. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

jufufu.name: Suporte Defensivo: Steadfast Crouching Tiger
jufufu.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

jufufu.name: Suporte Rápido: Decisive Stomp
jufufu.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

jufufu.name: Passiva de Núcleo Fu-rocious Might
jufufu.desc: Lv. 1

jufufu.name: Habilidade Adicional Aura of Authority
jufufu.desc: When another character in your squad is an Ataque or Rupture character:The maximum Decibels for all characters in the squad increases by 1,000. When an Ataque or Rupture character uses an Suprema (Ultimate), that character gains 300 Decibels.

jufufu.name: M1 Super Scary Little Tiger Cinema (Mindscape) 1
jufufu.desc: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's Taxa Crítica increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 Might. When Ju Fufu's Ataque em Cadeia hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Atordoamento (Stun) DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.

jufufu.name: M2 Almighty Qingming Warrior Cinema (Mindscape) 2
jufufu.desc: While in the Tiger's Roar state, character Dano Crítico increases by an additional 22%. Whenever any character activates an Suprema (Ultimate), Ju Fufu gains 3 points of Momentum.

jufufu.name: M3 Righteous Young Hero Cinema (Mindscape) 3
jufufu.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

jufufu.name: M4 Monster-Slaying Tiger Mystic Cinema (Mindscape) 4
jufufu.desc: While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, her Dano Crítico increases by 35%.

jufufu.name: M5 Unrivaled Almighty Senior Cinema (Mindscape) 5
jufufu.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

jufufu.name: M6 Roar of My Inner Tiger Cinema (Mindscape) 6
jufufu.desc: Ju Fufu's Ataque em Cadeia DMG increases by 30%. Upon consuming Momentum and hitting an enemy in the high-speed spinning state, fire 3 popcorns, each dealing 160% of Fufu's ATK as DMG. This DMG is treated as Ataque em Cadeia DMG.

koleda.name: Potential Demolition Ops
koleda.desc: Lv. 1

koleda.name: Ataque Básico: Smash 'n' Bash
koleda.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing Dano Físico. When Koleda has the Furnace Fire effect, she can launch an enhanced Ataque Básico after the 2nd hit, consuming the Furnace Fire effect and dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Enhanced Ataque Básico consists of two stages. After performing the first stage, press or hold to follow up with the second stage. The pursuit effect of the first-stage enhanced Ataque Básico is also strengthened. Furnace Fire can stack up to 2 times. Performing an enhanced Ataque Básico consumes all stacks of Furnace Fire. When Furnace Fire is consumed, all Agents deal 35% more damage for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. For each stack of Furnace Fire consumed, the second stage of the enhanced Ataque Básico deals 10% more damage and inflicts 20% more Atordoamento (Daze). When switching Agents during the first stage of the enhanced Ataque Básico, Koleda remains on-field and automatically launches the second stage of the enhanced Ataque Básico. When Koleda and Ben are both in the squad, using an enhanced Ataque Básico without switching Agents during the first stage of the enhanced Ataque Básico causes the two to perform a Coordinated Ataque, further increasing the skill's power. Character is Invulnerable during the 4th hit of her Ataque Básico and her enhanced Ataque Básico. The invulnerability duration of the second-stage enhanced Ataque Básico is increased.

koleda.name: Esquiva: Wait 'n' See
koleda.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

koleda.name: Dash Ataque: Tremble!
koleda.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Perform a forward strike, dealing Dano Físico. During this skill, if she has Furnace Fire, then Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. Hold to follow up with an enhanced Ataque Básico.

koleda.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Don't Look Down on Me
koleda.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Strikes enemies in front and creates an explosion, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. If Furnace Fire is active, hold to follow up with an enhanced Ataque Básico.

koleda.name: Ataque Especial: Hammer Time
koleda.desc: Press to activate: Strikes enemies in front and triggers an explosion, dealing Dano de Fogo. This skill launches faster and directly triggers the explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Ataque Básico or enhanced Ataque Básico. During the 2nd hit of her Ataque Básico, holding can also trigger the explosion directly. When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad, and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced Ataque Básico, they team up to launch a coordinated Ataque, further increasing the power of the skill. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

koleda.name: Ataque Especial EX: Boiling Furnace
koleda.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate: Strikes enemies in front and triggers a powerful explosion, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Koleda also gains the Furnace Fire effect. This skill activates faster and triggers an explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Ataque Básico or enhanced Ataque Básico. Explosions triggered this way inflict 10% more Atordoamento (Daze). When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced Ataque Básico, they team up to launch a coordinated Ataque, further increasing the power of the skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Hold to follow up with Dash Ataque: Tremble!.

koleda.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Natural Disaster
koleda.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area, dealing massive Dano de Fogo while also obtaining the Furnace Fire effect. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

koleda.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Hammerquake
koleda.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive Dano de Fogo while also obtaining the Furnace Fire effect. Koleda and Ben can team up when fighting together to launch a coordinated Ataque, further increasing the power of the Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Hold to follow up with Dash Ataque: Tremble!.

koleda.name: Ataque de Suporte: Hammer Bell
koleda.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Koleda charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo and obtaining Furnace Fire effect. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Hold to follow up with Dash Ataque: Tremble!.

koleda.name: Suporte Defensivo: Protective Hammer
koleda.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate: Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

koleda.name: Suporte Rápido: Coming Thru!
koleda.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate: Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

koleda.name: Passiva de Núcleo Demolition Hammer
koleda.desc: Lv. 1

koleda.name: Habilidade Adicional Belobog Management
koleda.desc: When another character in your squad is a Rupture or Armorer character, or shares the same Attribute or Faction:When the explosion from Koleda's Ataque Especial EX hits an enemy, it applies a debuff to the target. While the target is Stunned, Chain Attacks deal 35% more DMG to the target. This effect can stack up to 2 times and resets when the Stunned effect ends.

koleda.name: M1 Beat of the Hammer Cinema (Mindscape) 1
koleda.desc: After the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Ataque Básico or her enhanced Ataque Básico, quickly use a Ataque Especial or Ataque Especial EX to increase the Atordoamento (Daze) dealt by 15%.

koleda.name: M2 Kinetic Recovery Cinema (Mindscape) 2
koleda.desc: When Koleda's Ataque Especial EX hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.

koleda.name: M3 Don’t Mess With Me! Cinema (Mindscape) 3
koleda.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

koleda.name: M4 Furnace’s Glow Cinema (Mindscape) 4
koleda.desc: Koleda gains one stack of Charge (max 2 stacks) when consuming Furnace Fire to use her Enhanced Ataque Básico. When her Ataque em Cadeia: Natural Disaster or Suprema (Ultimate): Hammerquake hits an enemy, she consumes all stacks of Charge to increase the Ataque's DMG by 18% per stack.

koleda.name: M5 You Dare Underestimate Me? Cinema (Mindscape) 5
koleda.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

koleda.name: M6 Saturated Blast Cinema (Mindscape) 6
koleda.desc: When Ataque Especial EX, Ataque em Cadeia, or Suprema (Ultimate) triggers an explosion that hits an enemy, it deals additional DMG equal to 360% of Koleda's ATK.

lighter.name: Ataque Básico: L-Form Thundering Fist
lighter.desc: Press or hold to activate: Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Fogo. During the 3rd hit of the Ataque Básico, drag the stick/joystick, and repeatedly press or hold to unleash a series of melee follow-up attacks. Release the stick/joystick to follow up with the 4th hit of the Ataque Básico. While performing the startup light punch in the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico, drag the stick/joystick and repeatedly press or hold to keep alternating between the light punch and 4th hit of the Ataque Básico. Release the stick/joystick to follow up with the subsequent jab combo. Continue repeatedly pressing or holding to extend the duration of the jab combo. When you stop pressing or holding , or when the combo reaches its maximum duration, launches a Finishing Move forward. Lighter is invulnerable during the Finishing Move. During the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico, Lighter takes 40% less DMG. While in the Morale Burst state, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during the 5th hit of his Ataque Básico, and the DMG reduction effect is increased to 80%.

lighter.name: Esquiva: Shadowed Slide
lighter.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Press while the character is attacking to activate: Perform a quick shuffle Esquiva in the direction of the stick/Joystick. This skill will not interrupt the combo count for Basic Attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lighter.name: Dash Ataque: Charging Slam
lighter.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

lighter.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Blazing Flash
lighter.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Strike enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using the skill, press or hold to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico.

lighter.name: Ataque Especial: V-Form Sunrise Uppercut
lighter.desc: Press to activate. Strikes enemies in front with an uppercut, dealing Dano de Fogo. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill. Press during a shuffle Esquiva to activate: Strike forward with a series of punches, dealing Dano de Fogo. This skill will not interrupt the combo count for Basic Attacks. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

lighter.name: Ataque Especial EX: V-Form Sunrise Uppercut - Full Distance
lighter.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Leaps into the air with a powerful uppercut, striking enemies in front and dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Press again during this skill to spend additional Energy to perform a powerful follow-up Ataque, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, press or hold to follow up with the 4th hit of the Ataque Básico. With enough Energy, press during the shuffle Esquiva to activate: Strike forward with a powerful punch combo, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. This skill will not interrupt the combo count for Basic Attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, press or hold to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico.

lighter.name: Ataque em Cadeia: V-Form Scorching Sun
lighter.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a small area, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lighter.name: Suprema (Ultimate): W-Form Crowned Inferno
lighter.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lighter.name: Ataque de Suporte: Charging Slam - Stab
lighter.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Strike enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, press or hold to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico.

lighter.name: Suporte Defensivo: Swift Break
lighter.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lighter.name: Suporte Rápido: Blazing Flash - Guard
lighter.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Strike enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using the skill, press or hold to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico.

lighter.name: Habilidade Adicional Fighting Spirit
lighter.desc: When another character in your squad is an Ataque character or shares the same Faction:While under the Morale Burst state, when the 5th hit of Lighter's Ataque Básico hits an enemy, all squad members gain a stack of Elation, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For each stack of Elation, an Agent's Dano de Gelo and Dano de Fogo increase by 1.25%.When obtaining Elation, if Lighter's Impacto exceeds 170, every additional 10 points of Impacto will increase the buff effect provided by each stack of Elation by an extra 0.25%. When any squad member launches a Ataque em Cadeia, it will refresh the duration of all squad members' Elation. Elation can increase the Dano de Gelo and Dano de Fogo of Agents by a maximum of 75%.

lighter.name: M1 The Champion Cinema (Mindscape) 1
lighter.desc: Among the debuffs imposed by Passiva de Núcleo: Accelerant, the Collapse effect increases Atordoamento (Stun) duration by 5s, while further reducing Ice RES and Fire RES by 10%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.

lighter.name: M2 Red Scarf Cinema (Mindscape) 2
lighter.desc: When applying Collapse by Passiva de Núcleo: Accelerant to enemies, the target's Atordoamento (Stun) DMG Multiplier increases by 25%. The increase to Dano de Gelo and Dano de Fogo provided by Elation from Habilidade Adicional: Fighting Spirit increases to 120% of the original.

lighter.name: M3 Mercenary Leader Cinema (Mindscape) 3
lighter.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

lighter.name: M4 Sunglasses Cinema (Mindscape) 4
lighter.desc: When Lighter is off-field, the Recuperação de Energia for the on-field character is increased by 10%. Upon entering the Morale Burst state, Lighter restores 4 Energy for off-field characters. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

lighter.name: M5 Decision Maker Cinema (Mindscape) 5
lighter.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

lighter.name: M6 Inhuman Blood Cinema (Mindscape) 6
lighter.desc: Lighter's Morale recovery efficiency is increased to 200% of its original value. When Lighter lands a heavy strike on enemies during a Ataque Básico, Contra-ataque de Esquiva, Ataque Especial, Ataque Especial EX, Suporte Rápido, Ataque de Suporte, Ataque em Cadeia, or Suprema (Ultimate), it will trigger the Blazing Impacto effect, dealing 250% of ATK as Dano de Fogo. This effect can trigger once every 8s on each enemy. If Lighter's Impacto exceeds 170 points, each additional point will further increase the multiplier of Blazing Impacto by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 500%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a light punch or jab combo will trigger an additional activation of Blazing Impacto when hitting an enemy, ignoring the effect's cooldown.

lucia.name: Ataque Básico: Orbital Combo
lucia.desc: Press to activate: Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Dano de Éter. The fifth Ataque is a Whim, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts Dano de Éter on enemies in a circular area ahead. When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Whim.

lucia.name: Esquiva: Fading Silhouette
lucia.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucia.name: Dash Ataque: Refraction
lucia.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Dano de Éter.

lucia.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Stardust Echo
lucia.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. This Contra-ataque de Esquiva is a Whim. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward Ataque in a circular area ahead, dealing Dano de Éter. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucia.name: Ataque Especial: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
lucia.desc: Press to activate. This Ataque Especial is a Whim. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing Dano de Éter. When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

lucia.name: Ataque Especial EX: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
lucia.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate: This Ataque Especial EX is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing Dano de Éter. When Lucia uses any Harmony, all squad members gain the Darkbreaker state. While in Darkbreaker state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional amount of Sheer Force. The Darkbreaker state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of X, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value. When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final Ataque's DMG by an additional % of her Max HP. If she activates this Ataque Especial EX while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s. After activating her Ataque Especial EX, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Ataque Básico. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucia.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Stage of Brilliance
lucia.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: This Ataque em Cadeia is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals Dano de Éter. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucia.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Charge, Great Armor!
lucia.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. This Suprema (Ultimate) is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1. When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Dano de Éter. A Suporte Rápido is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to % of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out. After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked. Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

lucia.name: Ataque de Suporte: Harmony of Painted Dreams
lucia.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: This Ataque de Suporte is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward Ataque in a circular area ahead, dealing Dano de Éter. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucia.name: Suporte Defensivo: Voice of Illusory Dreams
lucia.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucia.name: Suporte Rápido: Crushing Mist
lucia.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. This Suporte Rápido is a Whim. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward Ataque in a circular area ahead, dealing Dano de Éter. If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucia.name: Habilidade Adicional Ballad of the Long Night
lucia.desc: When another character in your squad is a Rupture or Atordoamento (Stun) character:When applying Darkbreaker, additionally applies a 30% Dano Crítico increase effect.

lucia.name: M1 Secret Friend Cinema (Mindscape) 1
lucia.desc: When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate. Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of Echo, stacking up to 4 times. When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme ends, if Lucia has any Echo stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme to all squad members.

lucia.name: M2 Great Magician Cinema (Mindscape) 2
lucia.desc: While Lucia is inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, Harmony deals 15% more DMG. Agents in the Darkbreaker state gain an additional 15% Sheer DMG increase while in Ether Veil: Wellspring.

lucia.name: M3 The Best Partner Cinema (Mindscape) 3
lucia.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

lucia.name: M4 Late-Night Hours Cinema (Mindscape) 4
lucia.desc: When Ether Veil is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

lucia.name: M5 Dream Watcher Cinema (Mindscape) 5
lucia.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

lucia.name: M6 The Never-Ending Journey Cinema (Mindscape) 6
lucia.desc: When Lucia is inside any Ether Veil, her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and Harmony always triggers a CRIT with Harmony Dano Crítico increased by 30%.

lucy.name: Ataque Básico: Lady's Bat
lucy.desc: Press to activate. Strike forward up to 4 times, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Fogo. When Lucy uses her fourth Ataque Básico, the currently on-field guard boars will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing! together.

lucy.name: Guard Boars: To Arms!
lucy.desc: In combat, the guard boars will randomly use a baseball bat, boxing gloves, or a slingshot to automatically Ataque enemies, dealing Dano Físico.

lucy.name: Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!
lucy.desc: When Lucy uses the fourth Ataque Básico, or when she gains the Cheer On! status, the guard boars will whirl their baseball bats in a continuous motion, dealing Dano Físico to nearby enemies. If the Ataque cannot be executed immediately, the guard boars will remember the required number of times to execute it.

lucy.name: Esquiva: Foul Ball!
lucy.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucy.name: Dash Ataque: Fearless Boar!
lucy.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

lucy.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Returning Tusk!
lucy.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Strike enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucy.name: Ataque Especial: Solid Hit!
lucy.desc: Press to activate: Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies, or walls, dealing Dano de Fogo. Hold to activate: Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing Dano de Fogo.

lucy.name: Ataque Especial EX: Home Run!
lucy.desc: When enough energy, press to activate. Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies, or walls, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. When enough energy, hold to activate: Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Suporte Rápido.

lucy.name: Cheer On!
lucy.desc: Lv. 1

lucy.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Grand Slam!
lucy.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate. Lucy jumps up and sends a guard boar at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Suporte Rápido.

lucy.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Walk-Off Home Run!
lucy.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Launch all guard boards sequentially, dealing massive Dano de Fogo in a large area to enemies ahead. While using this skill, other squad members recover 10 energy, and the next character to switch in gains an additional 20 energy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Suporte Rápido.

lucy.name: Ataque de Suporte: Scored a Run!
lucy.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucy.name: Suporte Defensivo: Safe on Base!
lucy.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucy.name: Suporte Rápido: Hit By Pitch!
lucy.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lucy.name: Passiva de Núcleo Crimson Mane Guard
lucy.desc: Lv. 1

lucy.name: Habilidade Adicional Batter Up!
lucy.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction or is a Rupture character:The guard boars inherit Lucy's Taxa Crítica and Dano Crítico.

lucy.name: M1 Drill Formations Cinema (Mindscape) 1
lucy.desc: When the guard boars launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!, Lucy recovers 2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 15s, with each guard boar having its own separate cooldown.

lucy.name: M2 Little Boar Captain Cinema (Mindscape) 2
lucy.desc: When Lucy uses a Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate), it grants all squad members, Bangboo, and the guard boars the Cheer On! status for 10s.

lucy.name: M3 Ironfist Overseer Cinema (Mindscape) 3
lucy.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

lucy.name: M4 Chaos Ball Game Cinema (Mindscape) 4
lucy.desc: While in the Cheer On! state, allies' Dano Crítico is increased by an additional 10%.

lucy.name: M5 Wildland Princess Cinema (Mindscape) 5
lucy.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

lucy.name: M6 Fierce Fangs of Fire Cinema (Mindscape) 6
lucy.desc: When an ally in the Cheer On! state hits an enemy with an Ataque Especial EX, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing Dano de Fogo equal to 300% of the guard boar's ATK. This will extend the duration of the Cheer On! buff for all squad members by 5s. The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the Cheer On! state resets the stack count. After the guard boar's explosion, it will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!.

lycaon.name: Potential Potential Awakening: Glacial Rush
lycaon.desc: Lv. 1

lycaon.name: Ataque Básico: Moon Hunter
lycaon.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes up to 5 strikes in front, dealing Dano Físico. Hold down to charge up, increasing the power of the Ataque and dealing Dano de Gelo.

lycaon.name: Esquiva: Suitable Positioning
lycaon.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lycaon.name: Dash Ataque: Keep it Clean
lycaon.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Slide forwards, launching a series of strikes in front, dealing Dano Físico.

lycaon.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Etiquette Manual
lycaon.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lycaon.name: Ataque Especial: Time to Hunt
lycaon.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes a series of strikes in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Hold down to charge up, increasing its power. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

lycaon.name: Ataque Especial EX: Thrill of the Hunt
lycaon.desc: With enough energy, press to activate. Unleashes a series of powerful strikes in front, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Hold down to charge up, consuming Energy and enhancing the power of the Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lycaon.name: Ataque em Cadeia: As You Wish
lycaon.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate. Unleashes a series of powerful strikes at enemies in a small area in front of him, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lycaon.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Mission Complete
lycaon.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleashes multiple powerful strikes at enemies in a large area, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lycaon.name: Ataque de Suporte: Vengeful Counterattack
lycaon.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Creates an icicle in front, which strikes all enemies within range, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lycaon.name: Suporte Defensivo: Disrupted Hunt
lycaon.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lycaon.name: Suporte Rápido: Wolf Pack
lycaon.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

lycaon.name: Passiva de Núcleo Metallic Paws
lycaon.desc: Lv. 1

lycaon.name: Habilidade Adicional Elegant Predator
lycaon.desc: When another character in your squad is an Anomalia character or shares the same Attribute or Faction:When Lycaon hits a Stunned enemy, the target's Atordoamento (Stun) DMG Multiplier increases by 35%.

lycaon.name: M1 Full Moon Momentum Cinema (Mindscape) 1
lycaon.desc: When Lycaon's Ataque Especial EX hits an enemy, the Ataque's Atordoamento (Daze) increases by 12%. This effect can trigger once every 8s. When he charges his Ataque Especial EX to completion, this buff will increase by an additional 10%.

lycaon.name: M2 Energy Feedback Cinema (Mindscape) 2
lycaon.desc: When Stunning an enemy or triggering a squad member's Ataque em Cadeia, Lycaon gains 5 Energy. Can trigger once every 1s.

lycaon.name: M3 Attendant Training Cinema (Mindscape) 3
lycaon.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

lycaon.name: M4 Graceful Demeanor Cinema (Mindscape) 4
lycaon.desc: If Lycaon is attacked while using a Ataque Básico or Ataque Especial, he will immediately gain a Shield effect equal to 7.5% of his max HP, lasting for 15s. During the Shield's duration, his Anti-Interrupt level is increased. This effect can trigger once every 15s.

lycaon.name: M5 Alpha Nature Cinema (Mindscape) 5
lycaon.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

lycaon.name: M6 Ruthless Hunter Cinema (Mindscape) 6
lycaon.desc: When a charged Ataque hits an enemy, the target suffers 10% increased DMG from Lycaon, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 12s. Only one stack can be gained per skill use, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

manato.name: Ataque Básico: Blazing Wind Slash
manato.desc: Press to activate: Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing Dano Físico. During each slash, pressing triggers Scorchwind, causing the Ataque to deal increased Dano de Fogo.

manato.name: Ataque Básico: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash
manato.desc: While in the Molten Edge state, press to activate: Unleash up to four forward slashes, dealing Dano de Fogo. If Manato's HP is above 30% when the skill is activated, 3.5% of his Max HP will be consumed.

manato.name: Esquiva: Radiant Blade
manato.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

manato.name: Dash Ataque: Radiant Blade - Zanshin
manato.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Dano de Éter.

manato.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
manato.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

manato.name: Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes
manato.desc: Press to activate. Slash forward at enemies, dealing Dano de Fogo. If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes and Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s. If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced. DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

manato.name: Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
manato.desc: Hold to activate. Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 Blazing Heart. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP. Release the button to activate Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes and Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s. If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced. DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

manato.name: Ataque Especial EX: Return to Ashes - Fall
manato.desc: While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press to activate: Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

manato.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Blazing Eruption
manato.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Hurls his sword forward, then charges the enemy to trigger an explosion, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

manato.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Charge, Great Armor!
manato.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by an explosion, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

manato.name: Ataque de Suporte: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
manato.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Dano de Fogo. Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes. During the consecutive slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. The DMG taken during the consecutive slashes is reduced by 60%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased.

manato.name: Suporte Defensivo: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
manato.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze) and dealing Dano de Fogo. Gain 75 Blazing Heart upon activating this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

manato.name: Suporte Rápido: Lone Shadow - Regroup
manato.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

manato.name: Passiva de Núcleo Mighty Molten Edge
manato.desc: Lv. 1

manato.name: Habilidade Adicional Rekindled Heart
manato.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun) or Suporte character:When Manato uses his Suprema (Ultimate), he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Ataque em Cadeia, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s, stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While launching Ataque Básico: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes of an Ataque de Suporte, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.

manato.name: M1 Drifter's Rules of Survival Cinema (Mindscape) 1
manato.desc: As Manato's HP decreases, his HP lost is accumulated. Each 1% of his Max HP accumulated increases the Dano de Fogo of Assist Follow-Ups and Basic Attacks by 0.4%, up to a max of 20%.

manato.name: M2 Drifter's Rules of Survival Cinema (Mindscape) 2
manato.desc: While in the Molten Edge state, Manato ignores 8% of a target's Fire RES. After being hit by an enemy while using Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes or Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, press Normal Ataque to trigger an Ataque de Suporte.

manato.name: M3 Enter the Realm of Urban Legends Cinema (Mindscape) 3
manato.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

manato.name: M4 Childhood Oath Cinema (Mindscape) 4
manato.desc: Max HP increases by 8%. During Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes and Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1.

manato.name: M5 Lone Shadow Returns to the Pack Cinema (Mindscape) 5
manato.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

manato.name: M6 Beyond Dreams of the Past Cinema (Mindscape) 6
manato.desc: When Ataque Especial: Return to Ashes hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing Normal Ataque will launch an Ataque de Suporte. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his Ataque de Suporte hits an enemy, Manato's Dano de Fogo increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

miyabi.name: Ataque Básico: Kazahana
miyabi.desc: Press or hold to activate: Unleashes up to 5 slashes ahead, the first two deal Dano Físico, and the last three deal Frost DMG. Block enemy attacks during the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico.

miyabi.name: Ataque Básico: Shimotsuki
miyabi.desc: With at least 2 points of Fallen Frost, hold to activate: Hoshimi Miyabi sheaths her blade, enters Shimotsuki Stance and starts to charge up. Every level of charge will consume 2 points of Fallen Frost, up to a maximum of three levels of charge. When releasing , or when Fallen Frost is completely depleted, Hoshimi Miyabi will draw her blade and unleash a powerful slash ahead based on the current charge level, dealing massive Frost DMG. She then exits Shimotsuki Stance. Character is invulnerable during Shimotsuki Stance. Hoshimi Miyabi can have up to 6 points of Fallen Frost. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 3 points of Fallen Frost.

miyabi.name: Esquiva: Mizutori
miyabi.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. While dodging, repeatedly press or hold to activate: A dash Esquiva that covers a lot of ground. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

miyabi.name: Dash Ataque: Fuyubachi
miyabi.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

miyabi.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Kan Suzume
miyabi.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Frost DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

miyabi.name: Ataque Especial: Miyuki
miyabi.desc: Press to activate. Quickly draws her blade and slashes ahead, dealing Frost DMG. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

miyabi.name: Ataque Especial EX: Hisetsu
miyabi.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Rush forward, unleashing powerful slashes against enemies along the way, dealing massive Frost DMG. Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of Fallen Frost. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, with enough Energy, press again to activate: Consume extra Energy and unleash a powerful follow-up Ataque against enemies in front, dealing massive Frost DMG. Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of Fallen Frost. Character is invulnerable while using this skill

miyabi.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Spring's Call
miyabi.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Frost DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

miyabi.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Lingering Snow
miyabi.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies ahead in a large area then pauses, before unleashing a Finishing Move, dealing massive Frost DMG. Upon activating this skill, gain 3 points of Fallen Frost and increase Dano de Gelo by 30% for 12s. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

miyabi.name: Ataque de Suporte: Falling Petals
miyabi.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Charges and slashes enemies in front, dealing Frost DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

miyabi.name: Suporte Defensivo: Drifting Petals
miyabi.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

miyabi.name: Suporte Rápido: Dancing Petals
miyabi.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Frost DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

miyabi.name: Passiva de Núcleo Searing Cold
miyabi.desc: Lv. 1

miyabi.name: Habilidade Adicional Bask in Frost
miyabi.desc: When another character in your squad is a Suporte character or shares the same faction:Ataque Básico: Shimotsuki DMG increases by 60%. When any squad member triggers Disorder, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 2 points of Fallen Frost and Ataque Básico: Shimotsuki during the next Shimotsuki Stance will ignore 30% of the target's Ice Res.

miyabi.name: M1 Frost Atop the Snow Cinema (Mindscape) 1
miyabi.desc: While in Shimotsuki Stance, every 1 point of Fallen Frost consumed will allow Ataque Básico: Shimotsuki to ignore 6% of DEF, stacking up to 6 times and lasting until Shimotsuki Stance ends. When the slash for charge level three of Ataque Básico: Shimotsuki hits an enemy under Frostburn, it will immediately remove the Frostburn state and increase all squad members' Anomalia Buildup Rate by 20% for 10s.

miyabi.name: M2 Breath Technique Cinema (Mindscape) 2
miyabi.desc: Ataque Básico: Kazahana and Contra-ataque de Esquiva DMG increases by 30%. Hoshimi Miyabi gains 1 point of Fallen Frost when the final move of the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Kazahana hits an enemy. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 6 points of Fallen Frost and her Taxa Crítica increases by 15%.

miyabi.name: M3 Martial Discipline Cinema (Mindscape) 3
miyabi.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

miyabi.name: M4 Rupture Cinema (Mindscape) 4
miyabi.desc: Frostburn - Break DMG increases by 30%. Upon triggering Frostburn - Break, Hoshimi Miyabi generates 250 more Decibels.

miyabi.name: M5 Anniversary Cinema (Mindscape) 5
miyabi.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

miyabi.name: M6 Prodigious Talent Cinema (Mindscape) 6
miyabi.desc: During Shimotsuki Stance, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains Polar, which increases Ataque Básico: Shimotsuki DMG by 30%. After obtaining Polar, Hoshimi Miyabi will automatically draw her blade and unleash powerful slashes based on the current charge level upon consuming Fallen Frost. Before Fallen Frost is completely depleted, the draw and slashes will not interrupt charging under Shimotsuki Stance. Each occurrence of Shimotsuki Stance can perform up to 3 draws and slashes.

nangongyu.name: Ataque Básico: Shooting Star Step
nangongyu.desc: Press to activate: Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing Dano de Éter.

nangongyu.name: Ataque Básico: Adorable Explosive Impacto
nangongyu.desc: Hold to launch a charged Ataque, dealing Dano de Éter. Release the button at the right moment to trigger precise charging, increasing the Atordoamento (Daze) dealt by the skill by 20%. Nangong Yu can perform up to three hits. The second and third hits each must consume 50 Downbeats. After using a Ataque em Cadeia, Suprema (Ultimate), or Ataque Especial EX, if enough Downbeats are available, hold to skip the first hit and directly perform the second and third hits, which always trigger precise charging. When Nangong Yu is the active character, Chain Attacks, Ultimates, and EX Special Attacks do not interrupt the combo count of Ataque Básico: Adorable Explosive Impacto. While charging the first hit, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken decreases by 60%. While charging the second and third hits, the character is Invulnerable. During the dash phase of the first hit, enemy attacks can be Blocked. On a successful Block, the Ataque is treated as a precise charging Ataque. Character is invulnerable during all attacks.

nangongyu.name: Esquiva: Natural Dancer
nangongyu.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

nangongyu.name: Dash Ataque: Spinning Meteor
nangongyu.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Deliver a quick Ataque forward, dealing Dano de Éter.

nangongyu.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Asteroid Waltz
nangongyu.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Launch a series of attacks on the target, dealing Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

nangongyu.name: Ataque Especial: The Weight of Love
nangongyu.desc: Press to activate. Delivers a morning star Ataque, dealing Dano de Éter.

nangongyu.name: Ataque Especial EX: The Unbearable Weight of Love
nangongyu.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Delivers a morning star Ataque, dealing Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

nangongyu.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Comet Gravity
nangongyu.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Launch a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

nangongyu.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Meteor Shower
nangongyu.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Launch multiple attacks forward, dealing massive Dano de Éter. Upon activating this skill, Nangong Yu activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. If Nangong Yu activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise again, the current Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will first deactivate. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

nangongyu.name: Ataque de Suporte: Improvised Performance
nangongyu.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing massive Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

nangongyu.name: Suporte Defensivo: Perfected Choreography
nangongyu.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

nangongyu.name: Suporte Rápido: Emergency Save
nangongyu.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

nangongyu.name: Passiva de Núcleo Prodigious Idol
nangongyu.desc: Lv. 1

nangongyu.name: Habilidade Adicional Angel Captain
nangongyu.desc: When another character in your squad is an Anomalia character or shares the same Faction:Any squad member's Ataque against a Stunned enemy has 30% increased Anomalia Buildup Rate. Chain Attacks against a Stunned enemy have an additional 30% increased Anomalia Buildup Rate.When any squad member Stuns an enemy, gain 2 stacks of Dance Prowess, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, lasting 15s. With Dance Prowess, when a heavy Ataque from Nangong Yu's Ataque Especial EX: The Unbearable Weight of Love, Ataque Básico: Adorable Explosive Impacto, or Suporte Rápido: Emergency Save hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomalia, 1 stack of Dance Prowess is consumed to trigger the special Disorder effect Polarity Disorder against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's Suporte Rápido. Polarity Disorder does not clear the target's Attribute Anomalia. If the skill fails to trigger Polarity Disorder, Dance Prowess will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has Dance Prowess, the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of Ataque Básico: Adorable Explosive Impacto, which will always trigger precise charging.When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu's next Ataque Especial EX will not consume Energy. This effect lasts 15s and can trigger once every 15s.When Nangong Yu and Aria are in the same squad, if Aria's Ataque Básico: Perfect Pitch heavy Ataque hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomalia, and Nangong Yu fully participates in the Ataque, 1 stack of Dance Prowess will also be consumed to trigger Polarity Disorder on the enemy.When the third hit of Nangong Yu's Ataque Básico: Adorable Explosive Impacto or Suprema (Ultimate): Meteor Shower hits an enemy, the enemy suffers Misstep. Under this effect, Atordoamento (Stun) DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and when an enemy becomes Stunned, their Atordoamento (Stun) duration increases by 3s. Before recovering from Atordoamento (Stun), Misstep can only trigger once on the same target. The increased Atordoamento (Stun) duration cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy with Misstep recovers from Atordoamento (Stun), the Misstep effect ends.

nangongyu.name: M1 Lazy Spotlight Cinema (Mindscape) 1
nangongyu.desc: When Ataque Especial EX: The Unbearable Weight of Love or Ataque Básico: Adorable Explosive Impacto hits an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's Downbeat is restored to the maximum. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.

nangongyu.name: M2 Painless Tears Cinema (Mindscape) 2
nangongyu.desc: Each stack of Vibrato's additional Abloom DMG ratio increase from Passiva de Núcleo: Prodigious Idol increases by an additional 10%. The Atordoamento (Stun) DMG Multiplier provided by Habilidade Adicional: Angel Captain increases by an additional 30%. When the active character's Ataque em Cadeia heavy Ataque hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Anomalia, it triggers Polarity Disorder, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once during the same Atordoamento (Stun) period.

nangongyu.name: M3 Chips on the Scales Cinema (Mindscape) 3
nangongyu.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

nangongyu.name: M4 Accomplice's Dance Step Cinema (Mindscape) 4
nangongyu.desc: Proficiência de Anomalia increases by 40. The Anomalia Buildup of Ataque Básico: Adorable Explosive Impacto when hitting an enemy increases by 35%.

nangongyu.name: M5 Center Stage Cinema (Mindscape) 5
nangongyu.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2
