panyinhu.name: Ataque Especial: Sonic Pressure-Point Strike
panyinhu.desc: Press to activate. Delivers a forward melee technique while tossing firecrackers, dealing Dano Físico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

panyinhu.name: Ataque Especial: Touch of Death
panyinhu.desc: With Break Force, press to activate. Ataque Especial: Touch of Death attacks centered on the enemy, dealing Dano Físico. The skill can be chained up to three times. Each use of Ataque Especial: Touch of Death consumes 1 point of Break Force. When Pan Yinhu is the active Agent, DMG received during the skill is reduced by 60% and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If he isn't the active Agent, he becomes Invulnerable.

panyinhu.name: Ataque Especial EX: Mountainous Pulse Strike
panyinhu.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Ataque Especial EX: Mountainous Pulse Strike unleashes a powerful strike forward, dealing Dano Físico. Gain 3 points of Break Force on activation. Upon hitting an enemy, it triggers the Suporte Rápido of the previous character in the squad. Agents who enter the field via this Suporte Rápido will gain the Sheer Force bonus from the Passiva de Núcleo. After switching out, Pan Yinhu will stay on the field and automatically launch Ataque Especial: Touch of Death until his Break Force runs out, where he then leaves the field. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

panyinhu.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Anointed with Wok Steam
panyinhu.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Hop onto the Iron Wok and spin rapidly to ram into enemies, dealing massive Dano Físico to all enemies on the way.

panyinhu.name: Suprema (Ultimate): A Feast Fit for an Emperor!
panyinhu.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Perform a technique that compresses qi into fried rice and catapults it at foes, dealing massive Dano Físico and healing the whole squad for some HP, while also applying a 8s heal over time on Agents, recovering certain HP/s. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

panyinhu.name: Ataque de Suporte: Ride the Momentum
panyinhu.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Perform a melee Ataque on enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

panyinhu.name: Suporte Defensivo: Intimidating Presence
panyinhu.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

panyinhu.name: Suporte Rápido: Lift Your Gaze to Good Fortune
panyinhu.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Perform a melee Ataque on enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

panyinhu.name: Passiva de Núcleo Meridian Enlightenment
panyinhu.desc: Lv. 1

panyinhu.name: Habilidade Adicional Iron Stomach
panyinhu.desc: When another character in your squad is a Rupture character or shares the same Faction:When Pan Yinhu hits an enemy with Ataque Especial: Touch of Death, the enemy suffers the Depleted Qi effect, increasing all DMG against the target by 20%. Each hit of Ataque Especial: Touch of Death inflicts a 10s Depleted Qi effect. This effect can't stack, but repeated hits on the same enemy will extend the duration.

panyinhu.name: M1 Qi Shield Cinema (Mindscape) 1
panyinhu.desc: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by Depleted Qi.

panyinhu.name: M2 Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike Cinema (Mindscape) 2
panyinhu.desc: For every 6 points of Break Force consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the Depleted Qi effect applied when Ataque Especial: Touch of Death hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.

panyinhu.name: M3 Non-Meridian Acupuncture Points Cinema (Mindscape) 3
panyinhu.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

panyinhu.name: M4 First-Class Head Chef Cinema (Mindscape) 4
panyinhu.desc: When Suprema (Ultimate): A Feast Fit for an Emperor! heals the whole squad, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating Suprema (Ultimate): A Feast Fit for an Emperor!, gain the Backup Provisions effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the Backup Provisions effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with Suprema (Ultimate): A Feast Fit for an Emperor!'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect cannot stack.

panyinhu.name: M5 Thiren Cinema (Mindscape) 5
panyinhu.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

panyinhu.name: M6 6. Meridian Theory Cinema (Mindscape) 6
panyinhu.desc: The Meridian Flow effect provided by Passiva de Núcleo: Meridian Enlightenment increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.

piper.name: Ataque Básico: Load Up and Roll Out
piper.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing Dano Físico.

piper.name: Esquiva: Handbrake Drift
piper.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

piper.name: Dash Ataque: Pedal to the Metal
piper.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

piper.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Power Drift
piper.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Unleash a downward smash Ataque in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

piper.name: Ataque Especial: Tire Spin
piper.desc: Press to activate. Piper spins and launches a sweeping slash around her, dealing Dano Físico. Hold to extend the skill duration, unleashing increasingly powerful spinning slashes and increasing the charge level of the skill, up to 2 times. If the skill is used after the first 3 hits of a Ataque Básico, Dash Ataque, or Contra-ataque de Esquiva, you can quickly activate Ataque Especial: Tire Spin of an increased charged level. During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

piper.name: Ataque Especial EX: Engine Spin
piper.desc: With enough energy, continue holding after Ataque Especial: Tire Spin reaches maximum charge level to activate: Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes around her, dealing massive Dano Físico. This skill consumes Energy continuously for up to 3s. During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

piper.name: Ataque Especial: One Trillion Tons
piper.desc: While Ataque Especial: Tire Spin is active, release to trigger a downward smash Ataque based on the charge level of Ataque Especial: Tire Spin, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

piper.name: Ataque Especial EX: Really Heavy
piper.desc: During Ataque Especial EX: Engine Spin, release to activate: Piper unleashes a downward smash Ataque, dealing massive Dano Físico. If the duration of Ataque Especial EX: Engine Spin reaches its limit or Energy drops to 20, Ataque Especial EX: Really Heavy will automatically activate. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

piper.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Buckle Up
piper.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate. Unleashes a powerful downward smash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

piper.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Hold On Tight
piper.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, followed by a downward smash, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

piper.name: Ataque de Suporte: Overtaking Maneuver
piper.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

piper.name: Suporte Defensivo: Emergency Brake
piper.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

piper.name: Suporte Rápido: Brake Tap
piper.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Launches a downward smash Ataque at enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

piper.name: Passiva de Núcleo Power Charge
piper.desc: Lv. 1

piper.name: Habilidade Adicional Synced Acceleration
piper.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:When Piper has 20 or more stacks of Power, all squad members' DMG is increased by 18%.

piper.name: M1 Leisure Moment Cinema (Mindscape) 1
piper.desc: When Piper's Ataque Especial: Tire Spin, Ataque Especial EX: Engine Spin, or Suprema (Ultimate) hits an enemy with a spinning slash, there is a 50% chance to gain an additional stack of Power. The maximum stack limit of Power is increased to 30.

piper.name: M2 Motivation Cinema (Mindscape) 2
piper.desc: During Ataque Especial: Tire Spin and Ataque Especial EX: Engine Spin, Piper's movement speed increases. When using Ataque Especial: One Trillion Tons, Ataque Especial EX: Really Heavy, or Suprema (Ultimate) to launch a downward smash that hits an enemy, the Dano Físico dealt by the move is increased by 10%. For each stack of Power, this buff is further increased by 1%.

piper.name: M3 Truck Expert Cinema (Mindscape) 3
piper.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

piper.name: M4 Refined Techniques Cinema (Mindscape) 4
piper.desc: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomalia on an enemy, Piper recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

piper.name: M5 Personal Hobbies Cinema (Mindscape) 5
piper.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

piper.name: M6 Mild Excitement Cinema (Mindscape) 6
piper.desc: Increases the duration limit of Ataque Especial EX: Engine Spin by 2s and extends the duration of Power by 4s.

promeia.name: Ataque Básico: Sweeping Edge
promeia.desc: Press to activate: Performs up to five attacks against enemies ahead, dealing Dano de Gelo. After landing the fifth hit's downward Ataque, and with sufficient Trial by Cold, keep holding or to chain into Ataque Especial EX: Execution - Merciless Judgment. Enters the Bound Absolution state after throwing the cape during the fourth hit.

promeia.name: Ataque Básico: Whirling Blade
promeia.desc: Hold to activate: Promeia leaps into the air and attacks, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the Bound Absolution state, dealing Dano de Gelo. Hitting enemies does not accumulate Corrosive Chill.

promeia.name: Bound Absolution
promeia.desc: When using certain skills, Promeia throws her cape to continuously slice enemies, dealing Dano de Gelo. Does not accumulate Corrosive Chill upon hit. While the cape remains out, Promeia can walk slowly. Press during this period to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Sweeping Edge. If attacked during this period, Promeia triggers a Perfect Esquiva automatically. The Esquiva can trigger once every 20s.

promeia.name: Esquiva: Veiled Step
promeia.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Dash Ataque: Grim Reap
promeia.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Delivers a quick Ataque forward, dealing Dano de Gelo.

promeia.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Soaring Bat
promeia.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing Dano de Gelo. After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Sweeping Edge. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Ataque Especial: Execution - Cold Flash
promeia.desc: Press to activate. Launches a flying blade Ataque, dealing Dano de Gelo.

promeia.name: Ataque Especial EX: Execution - Glacial Death
promeia.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Performs a flying blade Ataque, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the Bound Absolution state, dealing Dano de Gelo. If attacked by an enemy shortly after using the move, automatically chains into Ataque Especial EX: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow. Upon use, Promeia gains the Absolute Order effect. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Ataque Especial: Execution - Descending Frost
promeia.desc: While under the Absolute Order effect, press or while in the Bound Absolution state to activate: Leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a descending Ataque that deals Dano de Gelo. After landing, if Promeia possesses Trial by Cold, keep holding or to chain into Ataque Especial EX: Execution - Merciless Judgment. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Ataque Especial: Execution - Layered Frost
promeia.desc: After triggering Ataque Especial EX: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow, press or to activate: Quickly launches a flurry of attacks, then leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a more powerful downward Ataque that deals Dano de Gelo. After landing, if Promeia possesses Trial by Cold, keep holding or to chain into Ataque Especial EX: Execution - Merciless Judgment. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Ataque Especial EX: Execution - Merciless Judgment
promeia.desc: With enough Trial by Cold and after performing the final hit of Ataque Básico: Sweeping Edge, Ataque Especial: Execution - Descending Frost, or Ataque Especial: Execution - Layered Frost, keep holding or after landing to activate: Quickly leaps back while unleashing a more powerful finishing move, dealing Dano de Gelo. Hitting enemies does not accumulate Corrosive Chill. After using this skill, hold or , or press to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Sweeping Edge. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Hanging Judgment
promeia.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Throws flying blades and hangs upside down above the enemy, unleashing a flurry of attacks and ending with a finishing move, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. When the heavy Ataque hits an enemy afflicted with Ice Anomalia, Ether Anomalia, Electric Anomalia, Fire Anomalia, Physical Anomalia, or Wind Anomalia, it triggers Abloom once, dealing 100% Attribute Anomalia DMG of the corresponding attribute. After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Sweeping Edge. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Glaciating Impalement
promeia.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Launches a series of forward attacks, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. When the heavy Ataque hits an enemy afflicted with Ice Anomalia, Ether Anomalia, Electric Anomalia, Fire Anomalia, Physical Anomalia, or Wind Anomalia, it triggers Abloom once, dealing 250% Attribute Anomalia DMG of the corresponding attribute. After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Sweeping Edge. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Ataque de Suporte: Intercepting Strike
promeia.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing Dano de Gelo. After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Sweeping Edge. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Suporte Defensivo: Injunction
promeia.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Suporte Rápido: Ambushing Strike
promeia.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

promeia.name: Passiva de Núcleo Thief of Flames
promeia.desc: Lv. 1

promeia.name: Habilidade Adicional Vessel of Ice
promeia.desc: When another character in your squad is an Anomalia or Suporte character:When using an Ataque Especial EX, Promeia's Ice Anomalia Buildup Rate increases by 30% for 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.When any squad member applies the Frostbite effect to an enemy, its duration is increased by 3s.When Promeia's Ataque Especial EX hits an enemy, it inflicts Presumption of Guilt. When any squad member triggers Abloom on a target with Presumption of Guilt, it ignores 40% of the target's DEF. Presumption of Guilt lasts 30s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.

promeia.name: M1 Innocent Idealism Cinema (Mindscape) 1
promeia.desc: When Promeia uses Suprema (Ultimate): Glaciating Impalement, she gains an additional effect: if Trial by Cold points are not at maximum, gain 1 point of Trial by Cold. This effect can trigger once after using Suprema (Ultimate): Glaciating Impalement. When any squad member triggers Abloom on enemies with Presumption of Guilt, it ignores an additional 20% DEF.

promeia.name: M2 Faltering Conviction Cinema (Mindscape) 2
promeia.desc: Promeia's Proficiência de Anomalia increases by 40. The multiplier of Abloom triggered by consuming Trial by Cold increases by 120%.

promeia.name: M3 Cruel Moonlight Cinema (Mindscape) 3
promeia.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

promeia.name: M4 Ruthless Accusation Cinema (Mindscape) 4
promeia.desc: When Promeia triggers Abloom, she restores 5 Corrosive Chill. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

promeia.name: M5 The Dying Moth Cinema (Mindscape) 5
promeia.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

promeia.name: M6 To Be Continued Cinema (Mindscape) 6
promeia.desc: When Promeia consumes Trial by Cold to trigger Abloom, it triggers an additional special Abloom effect, dealing Attribute Anomalia DMG of the corresponding attribute at a fixed 200% multiplier. 5 Corrosive Chill and 100 Decibels are also restored. This effect can trigger at most once every 15s. In addition, Attribute Anomalia DMG and Disorder DMG dealt by Promeia ignore 15% of enemies' All-Attribute RES.

pulchra.name: Ataque Básico: Swift Strike
pulchra.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing Dano Físico.

pulchra.name: Ataque Básico: Leaping Strike
pulchra.desc: Hold to activate: Leap forward and unleash a series of slashes, dealing Dano Físico.

pulchra.name: Esquiva: Reversal Shot
pulchra.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pulchra.name: Dash Ataque: First Strike Advantage
pulchra.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Dash forward and slash, dealing Dano Físico.

pulchra.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Relentless Retribution
pulchra.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Thrust at enemies in front, then follow up with a swift slash, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pulchra.name: Ataque Especial: Rending Claw
pulchra.desc: Press to activate. Perform a rapid back-and-forth piercing Ataque, dealing Dano Físico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

pulchra.name: Ataque Especial: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow
pulchra.desc: While Pulchra is in the Hunter's Gait state, and when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with a heavy Ataque from a Ataque Especial or Ataque Especial EX: Dash back-and-forth piercing enemies surrounding the target, dealing Dano Físico. After using this skill, if another active character in the squad hits an enemy, Pulchra will repeat the Ataque up to 5 additional times, with the final Ataque being a more powerful Finishing Move. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Ataque Especial: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow is an Aftershock Ataque.

pulchra.name: Ataque Especial EX: Rending Claw - Flashstep
pulchra.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Pierce back and forth times, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pulchra.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?
pulchra.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a charged shot forward, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pulchra.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Oh, Time to Play?
pulchra.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleash a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pulchra.name: Ataque de Suporte: Independent Pricing
pulchra.desc: Press after an Evasive Assist to activate: Leap forward into the air and fire, dealing Dano Físico. Upon activating this skill, consume 1 Assist Point to enter the Hunter's Gait state. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pulchra.name: Evasive Assist: Contract - Outsourced Combat
pulchra.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Dodges the enemy's Ataque and activates Vital View. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pulchra.name: Suporte Rápido: Contract - Bodyguard
pulchra.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Thrust at enemies in front, followed by rapid slashes, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pulchra.name: Passiva de Núcleo Hunter's Instinct
pulchra.desc: Lv. 1

pulchra.name: Habilidade Adicional Business Partner
pulchra.desc: When another character in your squad is an Ataque or Rupture character or shares the same Faction:When Pulchra hits enemies with Ataque Especial: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow, an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque de Suporte, Ataque em Cadeia, or Suprema (Ultimate), it applies the Binding Trap effect for 15s. After applying Binding Trap, all units' Aftershock DMG against the target is increased by 30%.

pulchra.name: M1 Self-Interest Cinema (Mindscape) 1
pulchra.desc: When dealing DMG to enemies affected by Binding Trap, increase own Taxa Crítica by 10%.

pulchra.name: M2 Opportunistic Cinema (Mindscape) 2
pulchra.desc: While in the Hunter's Gait state from Passiva de Núcleo: Hunter's Instinct, Pulchra's ATK is increased by an additional 10%.

pulchra.name: M3 Territorial Cinema (Mindscape) 3
pulchra.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

pulchra.name: M4 Joy of the Hunt Cinema (Mindscape) 4
pulchra.desc: Reduces Energy Cost of activating Ataque Especial EX: Rending Claw - Flashstep by 5.

pulchra.name: M5 Tail Game Cinema (Mindscape) 5
pulchra.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

pulchra.name: M6 Behind the Mask Cinema (Mindscape) 6
pulchra.desc: Ataque Especial: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated Ataque can trigger is increased by 2. Habilidade Adicional: Business Partner's Binding Trap effect now also applies to all damage types, not just Aftershock DMG.

pyrois.name: Ataque Básico: Emberglow
pyrois.desc: Press to activate: Performs up to three attacks forward, dealing Dano de Éter.

pyrois.name: Ataque Básico: Celestial Light
pyrois.desc: With 30 or more , hold to activate: Unleashes up to four attacks forward, dealing massive Dano de Éter. If another character is switched in during the 3rd hit, Pyrois automatically performs the 4th hit off-field. Each hit consumes a certain amount of Solar Prominence. Character is invulnerable during the 3rd and 4th hits.

pyrois.name: Esquiva: Twilight
pyrois.desc: Press to activate: A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pyrois.name: Dash Ataque: Sunrise
pyrois.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Delivers a quick slash forward, dealing Dano de Éter.

pyrois.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: First Light
pyrois.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Performs a forward spinning slash, dealing Dano de Éter. After using the skill and with 30 or more , hold Icon_Normal to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Celestial Light. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pyrois.name: Ataque Especial: Fading Rays
pyrois.desc: Press to activate: Performs a rush Ataque, dealing Dano de Éter.

pyrois.name: Ataque Especial EX: Sun's Halo
pyrois.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate: Quickly charges forward and performs a series of consecutive attacks, dealing massive Dano de Éter. If hit by an enemy Ataque during the charge, triggers a Perfect Block effect, nullifying the damage and increasing the move's Interrupt Level to that of a Heavy Suporte Defensivo. After using the skill and with 30 or more , hold to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Celestial Light. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pyrois.name: Ataque Especial: Assault Directive
pyrois.desc: When an Suprema (Ultimate) or Ataque Especial EX: Sun's Halo is used, Phaethon performs an assist Ataque, dealing Dano de Éter. This effect can trigger once every 2.5s, and is guaranteed to trigger when using an Suprema (Ultimate).

pyrois.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Ceremonial March
pyrois.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Performs a coordinated Ataque with Phaethon, dealing massive Dano de Éter. After using the skill and with 30 or more , press or hold to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Celestial Light. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pyrois.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Total Annihilation
pyrois.desc: When Decibel Rating is at or above Blasting, press and select the upper branch to activate: After charging, performs a downward slash, dealing massive Dano de Éter. After using the skill and with 30 or more , press or hold to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Celestial Light. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pyrois.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Triumphant Return
pyrois.desc: When Decibel Rating is at or above Blasting, press and select the lower branch to activate: Releases an energy burst in the surrounding area, dealing massive Dano de Éter. After using the skill and with 30 or more , hold to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Celestial Light. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pyrois.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Unbound Swordstorm
pyrois.desc: When Decibel Rating is at or above Blasting, press and select the left branch to activate: Unleashes consecutive attacks forward, dealing massive Dano de Éter. After using the skill and with 30 or more , hold to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Celestial Light. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pyrois.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Eternal Imprisonment
pyrois.desc: When Decibel Rating is at or above Blasting, press and select the right branch to activate: Gathers energy ahead before unleashing a Finishing Move, dealing massive Dano de Éter. After using the skill and with 30 or more , hold to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Celestial Light. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pyrois.name: Suporte Rápido: Duskguard
pyrois.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate: Launches a series of attacks against the target, dealing Dano de Éter. After using the skill and with 30 or more , hold Icon_Normal to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Celestial Light. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pyrois.name: Suporte Defensivo: Ironhide Behemoth

pyrois.name: Ataque de Suporte: Return to Daylight
pyrois.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Performs a forward thrust Ataque, dealing Dano de Éter. After using the skill and with 30 or more , press or hold to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Celestial Light. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

pyrois.name: M2 Blazing Cavalry Cinema (Mindscape) 2
pyrois.desc: Using Suprema (Ultimate): Triumphant Return grants 1,500 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 180s. Pyrois's Decibel limit increases by 1,000.

qingyi.name: Ataque Básico: Penultimate
qingyi.desc: Press to activate: Launch up to four attacks forward, dealing Physical and Dano Elétrico. During the 3rd-hit, repeatedly press to continue the Ataque, continuously striking the enemy. Using Esquiva during this period will not interrupt Qingyis Ataque Básico combo count. During the 3rd hit, stop pressing to interrupt the continuous Ataque, transitioning automatically to the 4th hit. If the continuous Ataque lasts for a certain time, the 4th hit will be enhanced. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the 3rd and 4th hit.

qingyi.name: Ataque Básico: Enchanted Blossoms
qingyi.desc: Hold to activate: Launches a forward rush Ataque, dealing Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

qingyi.name: Ataque Básico: Flash Connect
qingyi.desc: When Qingyi deals Dano Elétrico with a skill, she accumulates Flash Connect Voltage. When Flash Connect Voltage reaches 75%, she will enter the Flash Connect state. When using her Ataque Básico: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, Qingyi will consume all Flash Connect Voltage and exit the Flash Connect state. For every 1% of Flash Connect Voltage consumed over 75%, her Damage and Atordoamento (Daze) inflicted by this skill will be increased by 1%/0.5%. Ataque Básico: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms itself does not accumulate Flash Connect Voltage.

qingyi.name: Ataque Básico: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms
qingyi.desc: During the Flash Connect state, hold to activate: Launch five consecutive forward rush attacks, then execute a Finishing Move that inflicts massive Dano Elétrico. Release during the move to trigger the Finishing Move early. Activate the Finishing Move just before the character is attacked to trigger Perfect Esquiva. Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the rush Ataque and DMG received is reduced by 40%. Qingyi is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.

qingyi.name: Esquiva: Swan Song
qingyi.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

qingyi.name: Dash Ataque: Breach
qingyi.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Dash forward and then launch an upward slash, dealing Dano Físico.

qingyi.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Lingering Sentiments
qingyi.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Leap into the air and then perform a downward strike, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

qingyi.name: Ataque Especial: Sunlit Glory
qingyi.desc: Press to activate. Quickly strikes upward, followed by a downward smash, dealing Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

qingyi.name: Ataque Especial EX: Moonlit Begonia
qingyi.desc: When Qingyi has enough energy, press to activate: Quickly strikes upward and leaps into the air, turning around to launch a series of strikes, then follows up with a powerful downward smash, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Hold to consume additional energy to increase the combo hits of the series of strikes. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After executing the move, you can directly follow up with the 3rd-hit of a Ataque Básico.

qingyi.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Tranquil Serenade
qingyi.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select Qingyi to activate: Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. When this Ataque hits an enemy, the skills DMG increases by 3% for every stack of Subjugation in Passiva de Núcleo: Eternal Seasons the target has. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

qingyi.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Eight Sounds of Ganzhou
qingyi.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, followed by a finishing move, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

qingyi.name: Ataque de Suporte: Song of the Clear River
qingyi.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Dash forward quickly and inject electrical energy into the ground, then pull back to trigger an explosion, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

qingyi.name: Suporte Defensivo: Graceful Embellishment
qingyi.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

qingyi.name: Suporte Rápido: Wind Through the Pines
qingyi.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Leap into the air and perform a downward strike, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

qingyi.name: Passiva de Núcleo Eternal Seasons
qingyi.desc: Lv. 1

qingyi.name: Habilidade Adicional Three Verses of Farewell at Yang Pass
qingyi.desc: Activated when there is at least 1 Ataque-type character or a character from the same faction in your squad:Basic Attacks deal 20% increased Atordoamento (Daze). If Qingyi's Impacto is greater than 120, each point over increases her Ataque by 6, up to a maximum of 600.

qingyi.name: M1 Insulation Breakdown Cinema (Mindscape) 1
qingyi.desc: When Qingyi enters combat, Flash Connect Voltage is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. When using her Ataque Básico: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, if Flash Connect Voltage is at its maximum, the Ataque will reduce the Defesa of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's Taxa Crítica against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.

qingyi.name: M2 Minimal Effort, Maximum Impacto Cinema (Mindscape) 2
qingyi.desc: The Atordoamento (Stun) DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of Subjugation in Passiva de Núcleo: Eternal Seasons increases to 135% of its original value. When Qingyi's Ataque hits an enemy and the stacks of Subjugation she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Atordoamento (Daze) dealt to the target increases by 15%.

qingyi.name: M3 Drink Hot Water Cinema (Mindscape) 3
qingyi.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

qingyi.name: M4 Stable Arc Barrier Cinema (Mindscape) 4
qingyi.desc: Upon entering or exiting Flash Connect state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's max HP. If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.

qingyi.name: M5 Youthful Spirit Cinema (Mindscape) 5
qingyi.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

qingyi.name: M6 Eight Meridians Cinema (Mindscape) 6
qingyi.desc: The Interrupt Level of Ataque Básico: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms is greatly increased, and the Dano Crítico is increased by an additional 100%. When Qingyi hits an enemy with her Ataque Básico: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the target's Resistance to all Attribute DMG is reduced by 20% for 15s.

remielle.name: Ataque Básico: Leap
remielle.desc: Press to activate: Perform up to four attacks ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG. If the Ataque Básico hits the target, gain Floating Radiance after the skill ends. After the 4th hit of the Ataque Básico ends, 1 Lumiflux Buildup is applied to enemies hit.

remielle.name: Ataque Básico: Solo Dance
remielle.desc: Hold to activate: Perform a slash in an area ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG. If it hits a target, gain Floating Radiance after the skill ends.

remielle.name: Ataque Básico: Rainbow's End
remielle.desc: When Remielle has Voidflare, hold to activate: Unleash a powerful large area Ataque ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG. Grants a large amount of [Floating Radiance] when the skill ends. If the Ataque hits a target, triggers the Luminize effect after the skill ends with a X% multiplier. Consumes all stored [Voidflare] upon use.

remielle.name: Ataque Básico: Fleeting Grace
remielle.desc: When Remielle has stored Voidflare and is in the Luminous Reflection state, hold to activate: Unleash a powerful large area Ataque ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG. Grants a large amount of Floating Radiance when the skill ends. If the Ataque hits a target, it triggers the Luminize effect after the skill ends with a multiplier of X%. Consumes all stored Voidflare upon use.

remielle.name: Esquiva: Retreating Light
remielle.desc: Press to activate: A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

remielle.name: Dash Ataque: Keen Light
remielle.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Launch a quick Ataque ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.

remielle.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Mirrored Shadow
remielle.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Unleash a powerful slash at the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

remielle.name: Ataque Especial: Sliver of Light
remielle.desc: Press to activate: Launch a ranged Ataque ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.

remielle.name: Ataque Especial EX: Ode to Dawn
remielle.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, if the character has less than 60 Energy, recover Energy to 60. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s; With enough Energy, press to activate: Unleash a powerful Ataque across a large area ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG; After the skill ends, apply 2 [Lumiflux Buildup] to all enemies hit; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

remielle.name: Ataque Especial: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn
remielle.desc: When Remielle is in-combat and [Floating Radiance] reaches its maximum of 120, hold after a [Ataque Especial] or [Ataque Especial EX] to enter [Stance Shift]. Switching Characters while in [Stance Shift] enters the [Phase Flow] state: While in the [Phase Flow] state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. Some attacks also apply [Lumiflux Buildup] to the target. [Floating Radiance] is consumed over time while in the [Phase Flow] state. When [Floating Radiance] is depleted or Remielle leaves the in-combat state, she exits the [Phase Flow] state. Before exiting the [Phase Flow] state, Remielle cannot be switched in except via a [Ataque em Cadeia]; If Remielle triggers 3 Refringe reactions while in the [Phase Flow] state, or has at least 1 stored Voidflare when [Floating Radiance] is depleted, [Assist: Flower & Feather Dance] is activated, unlocking normal switch-ins and automatically triggering [Assist: Flower & Feather Dance] on Remielle's next normal switch-in; Upon entering the [Phase Flow] state, all squad members' DMG dealt is increased by X% for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration; If Remielle uses a [Ataque Especial] or [Ataque Especial EX] that hits a Stunned enemy and [Floating Radiance] has reached its maximum of 120, switching Characters during the [Ataque Especial] or [Ataque Especial EX] also enters the [Phase Flow] state; If no character is switched in after entering [Stance Shift], Remielle uses a downward Ataque to return to the ground.

remielle.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Interwoven Dance Steps
remielle.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Launch multiple attacks ahead in a large area, dealing Lumiflux DMG. Enter the Luminous Reflection state upon activation. The next Ataque Básico: Rainbow's End is upgraded to Ataque Básico: Fleeting Grace. After the skill ends, apply 2 Lumiflux Buildup to enemies hit. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

remielle.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Dazzling Curtain Call
remielle.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Launch a Ataque across a large area in front, dealing Lumiflux DMG. If the skill hits, the Luminize effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of X%. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

remielle.name: Suporte Rápido: Featherglow Rebirth
remielle.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate: Unleash a slash at the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

remielle.name: Suporte Defensivo: Fleeting Light
remielle.desc: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate: Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

remielle.name: Ataque de Suporte: Awakening Glimmer
remielle.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Unleashes a series of slashes against the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

remielle.name: Passiva de Núcleo Temporal Patterns = Stilled Colors
remielle.desc: Lv. 1

remielle.name: Habilidade Adicional Invitation to Bloom
remielle.desc: When another character in your squad is an [Anomalia] character or shares the same faction:When there are 1/2/3 [Anomalia] characters in the squad, upon entering the battlefield, all squad members gain an ATK increase equal to 6%/12%/40% of Remielle's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,600 ATK. Additionally, while in the Phase Flow state, Remielle's Atordoamento (Daze) dealt increases by 6%/12%/35%.When Remielle applies [Lumiflux Buildup] to an enemy, they also inflict [Prismatic]: When all squad members Ataque an enemy affected by [Prismatic], Anomalia Buildup Rate increases by 15%. [Prismatic] is removed when the enemy no longer has [Lumiflux Buildup]. After [Prismatic] is removed, the Anomalia Buildup Rate increase persists for an additional 8s.

remielle.name: M1 Naive Oath Cinema (Mindscape) 1
remielle.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflare. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Remielle triggers Luminize to deal DMG, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When using [Assist: Flower & Feather Dance], she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s. While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, other squad members' Attribute Anomalia DMG increases by 10%.

remielle.name: M2 Fall Into the Noise Cinema (Mindscape) 2
remielle.desc: Remielle's [Refringe Coefficient] increases by 20%. When an [Anomalia] character in the squad deals Attribute Anomalia DMG to an enemy affected by [Prismatic], the Ataque ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after [Prismatic] ends. While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, the frequency at which she automatically launches attacks to apply [Lumiflux Buildup] to enemies increases.

remielle.name: M3 The Garden of Diverging Time Cinema (Mindscape) 3
remielle.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

remielle.name: M4 The Long Goodbye Cinema (Mindscape) 4
remielle.desc: When Remielle triggers Luminize, the DMG multiplier is increased by an additional 12%. After Remielle enters the battlefield and gains 3 special Voidflare, if all [Voidflare] are consumed, she immediately gains the maximum number of special [Voidflare] again. This effect is removed after triggering once or when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state.

remielle.name: M5 To Drink Forgetfulness Cinema (Mindscape) 5
remielle.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

remielle.name: M6 Lone Feather's Endless Flight Cinema (Mindscape) 6
remielle.desc: When Remielle uses [Ataque Básico: Rainbow's End] or [Ataque Básico: Fleeting Grace], Luminize is triggered twice. If the 4th hit of her [Ataque Básico] lands, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflare after the move ends. Special [Voidflare] gained this way deal DMG equal to 25% of the special [Voidflare] gained upon entering the battlefield.

rina.name: Potential Big Cleanup
rina.desc: Lv. 1

rina.name: Ataque Básico: Morning Cleanup
rina.desc: After Rina uses an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque em Cadeia, or Suprema (Ultimate), she enters the Spotless state for 13s. During this time, Drusilla or Anastella attacks an enemy once every 2.5s, dealing Dano Físico and Dano Elétrico, and grants 1 stack of Fright, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

rina.name: Ataque Básico: Midnight Cleanup
rina.desc: When reaches 6 stacks, the next Ataque Básico: Morning Cleanup performed by Drusilla or Anastella consumes all Fright stacks and is replaced with Ataque Básico: Midnight Cleanup, dealing Dano Elétrico After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

rina.name: Ataque Básico: Whack the Dimwit
rina.desc: Press to activate. Order Drusilla and Anastella to Ataque up to 4 times, dealing Dano Físico and Dano Elétrico. Performing other actions with Rina during Drusilla and Anastella's attacks will not interrupt Rina's Ataque Básico combo count.

rina.name: Ataque Básico: Shoo the Fool
rina.desc: Hold or to activate. Calls back Drusilla and Anastella to swing them around for a ranged Ataque, dealing Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

rina.name: Esquiva: Dress Adjustment
rina.desc: Press to Esquiva. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

rina.name: Dash Ataque: Sudden Surprise
rina.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing Ataque, dealing Dano Físico.

rina.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Bangboo Callback
rina.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

rina.name: Ataque Especial: Beat the Blockhead
rina.desc: Press to activate. Order Anastella to execute a downward smash, dealing Dano Elétrico Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

rina.name: Ataque Especial EX: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
rina.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Commands Drusilla and Anastella to unleash a continuous downward smash Ataque, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, a Suporte Rápido is triggered.

rina.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Code of Conduct
rina.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate a ball-shaped electrical field that deals massive Dano Elétrico. During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to perform Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, Special Attacks, and EX Special Attacks, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Ataque Básico: Shoo the Fool. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. A Suporte Rápido is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

rina.name: Suprema (Ultimate): The Queen's Attendant
rina.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Commands Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to respond to Ataque Básico, Dash Ataque, Ataque Especial, or Ataque Especial EX commands, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Ataque Básico: Shoo the Fool. Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, a Suporte Rápido is triggered.

rina.name: Ataque de Suporte: Quadruple Meter Gavotte
rina.desc: Press after an Evasive Assist to trigger. Commands Drusilla and Anastella to continuously advance while generating a vortex of electricity, dealing Dano Elétrico. While using this skill, you can quickly chain into Ataque Especial EX: Dimwit Disappearing Trick. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

rina.name: Evasive Assist: Tripple Meter Courante
rina.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Dodges the enemy's Ataque and activates Vital View. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

rina.name: Suporte Rápido: Duple Meter Allemande
rina.desc: When the character on field is launched, press to activate. Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

rina.name: Passiva de Núcleo Mini Destruction Partner
rina.desc: Lv. 1

rina.name: Habilidade Adicional Banquet of Perfection
rina.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:Increases the duration of Shock inflicted on enemies by any character by 3s. When Shocked enemies are on the field, all squad members' Dano Elétrico increases by 10%.

rina.name: M1 Dance Duet Cinema (Mindscape) 1
rina.desc: After being sent out to launch an Ataque, Drusilla and Anastella stay in place for an additional 5.5s before returning to Rina.The effect gained from Passiva de Núcleo: Mini Destruction Partner by characters within 10m is increased to 130% of the original value.

rina.name: M2 Master's Paragon Cinema (Mindscape) 2
rina.desc: Upon becoming the active character in combat, Rina's DMG increases by 15% for 12s. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

rina.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

rina.desc: Rina's Recuperação de Energia increases by 0.5/s when both Drusilla and Anastella are deployed. The effect ends when Drusilla or Anastella returns to Rina.

rina.name: M5 Head Maid Perfectionist Cinema (Mindscape) 5
rina.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

rina.name: M6 Stormy Night's Fright Cinema (Mindscape) 6
rina.desc: When an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate) hits an enemy, the entire squad's Dano Elétrico is increased by 15% for 8s.

roxy.name: Ataque Básico: Do Stay a While
roxy.desc: Press to activate: Performs up to four strikes forward, dealing Dano de Vento.

roxy.name: Esquiva: Excuse Me
roxy.desc: Press to activate: Perform a quick Esquiva to the side.

roxy.name: Dash Ataque: Forgive My Rudeness
roxy.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Strike forward, dealing Dano de Vento.

roxy.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Returned Courtesy
roxy.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Strike enemies in front, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxy.name: Ataque Especial: Much Obliged
roxy.desc: Press to activate: Perform a forward strike, dealing Dano de Vento.

roxy.name: Ataque Especial: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off
roxy.desc: After activating Ataque Especial EX: Kindly Rest in Peace, this Ataque is automatically activated when the total number of Storm's Eye Eyes of the Storm on the field and Roxy's Wind Energy reaches at least 3: Throws her hammer at enemies on the field, dealing Dano de Vento. Eyes of the Storm hit by this Ataque are detonated, up to 3 Eyes of the Storm at a time. Based on the number detonated, a corresponding number of Miniature Windstorms are generated, dealing Dano de Vento. If 3 Eyes of the Storm are detonated at once, a Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxy.name: Ataque Especial EX: Don't Catch a Chill
roxy.desc: With enough energy, press or hold to activate: Slide forward, dealing Dano de Vento. While sliding, press and hold to have Roxy enter the Whirlwind state: While in the Whirlwind state, Roxy transforms into a tornado. Drag the joystick to control its direction. During this, Energy is continuously consumed, dealing Dano de Vento to enemies along its path. When Energy is depleted, or when is released while the joystick is not being moved, Roxy exits the Whirlwind state. When the slide ends or when exiting the Whirlwind state, automatically follow up with Ataque Especial EX: Kindly Rest in Peace. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxy.name: Ataque Especial EX: Kindly Rest in Peace
roxy.desc: Automatically activates after Ataque Especial EX: Don't Catch a Chill ends: Consume all Wind Energy to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing Dano de Vento. After the Ataque, for each point of Wind Energy consumed, deals an additional instance of Dano de Vento and generates 1 Storm's Eye at the current position.

roxy.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Gale-Burial Great Hammer
roxy.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front, dealing massive Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxy.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Requiem for the Night-Burial
roxy.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Dano de Vento; After using this skill, gain 1 Wind Energy; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxy.name: Assist: More Overtime?
roxy.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Roxy stays on field and Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Vento. Upon activating this skill, it is considered a Ataque Básico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxy.name: Suporte Rápido: At Your Service
roxy.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate: Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxy.name: Suporte Defensivo: Allow Me to Assist
roxy.desc: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate: Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of [Assist Points] when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxy.name: Ataque de Suporte: Midnight Code
roxy.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Perform a forward strike, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxy.name: Passiva de Núcleo Warm Night's Embrace
roxy.desc: Lv. 1

roxy.name: Habilidade Adicional Porcelloy Heart
roxy.desc: When another character in your squad is an Ataque, Rupture, or Armorer character:Roxy's DMG increases by 8%. roxy.name: M1 Versatile Attendant Cinema (Mindscape) 1
roxy.desc: When Ataque Especial EX: Kindly Rest in Peace hits, it reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s; repeated triggers reset the duration. Dano Crítico increases by 40%.

roxy.name: M5 Second Heartbeat Cinema (Mindscape) 5
roxy.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

roxy.name: M6 Eternity and the Clockwork Doll Cinema (Mindscape) 6
roxy.desc: The DMG dealt by attacks ignores 15% of the target's Wind RES. When Ataque Especial: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off detonates Eyes of the Storm to generate a Giant Windstorm, the primary target is inflicted with Afterecho. A Giant Windstorm is generated at the target's location every 3s, for a total of 2 additional Giant Windstorms. Repeated triggers stack the number of additional Giant Windstorm instances generated and refresh the duration of Afterecho. The DMG multiplier of the Giant Windstorm increases to 250% of its original value, and the Atordoamento (Daze) it inflicts increases by 20%.

roxynew.name: Ataque Básico: Do Stay a While
roxynew.desc: Press to activate: Performs up to four strikes forward, dealing Dano de Vento.

roxynew.name: Esquiva: Excuse Me
roxynew.desc: Press to activate: Perform a quick Esquiva to the side.

roxynew.name: Dash Ataque: Forgive My Rudeness
roxynew.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Strike forward, dealing Dano de Vento.

roxynew.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Returned Courtesy
roxynew.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Strike enemies in front, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxynew.name: Ataque Especial: Much Obliged
roxynew.desc: Press to activate: Perform a forward strike, dealing Dano de Vento.

roxynew.name: Ataque Especial: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off
roxynew.desc: After activating Ataque Especial EX: Kindly Rest in Peace, this Ataque is automatically activated when the total number of Storm's Eye Eyes of the Storm on the field and Roxy's Wind Energy reaches at least 3: Throws her hammer at enemies on the field, dealing Dano de Vento. Eyes of the Storm hit by this Ataque are detonated, up to 3 Eyes of the Storm at a time. Based on the number detonated, a corresponding number of Miniature Windstorms are generated, dealing Dano de Vento. If 3 Eyes of the Storm are detonated at once, a Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxynew.name: Ataque Especial EX: Don't Catch a Chill
roxynew.desc: With enough energy, press or hold to activate: Slide forward, dealing Dano de Vento. While sliding, press and hold to have Roxy enter the Whirlwind state: While in the Whirlwind state, Roxy transforms into a tornado. Drag the joystick to control its direction. During this, Energy is continuously consumed, dealing Dano de Vento to enemies along its path. When Energy is depleted, or when is released while the joystick is not being moved, Roxy exits the Whirlwind state. When the slide ends or when exiting the Whirlwind state, automatically follow up with Ataque Especial EX: Kindly Rest in Peace. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxynew.name: Ataque Especial EX: Kindly Rest in Peace
roxynew.desc: Automatically activates after Ataque Especial EX: Don't Catch a Chill ends: Consume all Wind Energy to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing Dano de Vento. After the Ataque, for each point of Wind Energy consumed, deals an additional instance of Dano de Vento and generates 1 Storm's Eye at the current position.

roxynew.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Gale-Burial Great Hammer
roxynew.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front, dealing massive Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxynew.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Requiem for the Night-Burial
roxynew.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Dano de Vento; After using this skill, gain 1 Wind Energy; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxynew.name: Assist: More Overtime?
roxynew.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Roxy stays on field and Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Vento. Upon activating this skill, it is considered a Ataque Básico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxynew.name: Suporte Rápido: At Your Service
roxynew.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate: Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxynew.name: Suporte Defensivo: Allow Me to Assist
roxynew.desc: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate: Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of [Assist Points] when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

roxynew.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Perform a forward strike, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seed.name: Ataque Básico: Chrysanthemum Wheel Dance
seed.desc: Press to activate: Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Dano Físico for the first two hits and Dano Elétrico for the third and fourth hits. When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic Esquiva.

seed.name: Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Slaughter
seed.desc: After the 4th hit of a Ataque Básico, Contra-ataque de Esquiva, Suporte Rápido, or Ataque de Suporte, hold or press to activate: Summon the mech to perform a charged punch Ataque, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. When Steel Charge reaches 120, gain one chance to quickly activate Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Slaughter by holding . This effect expires when Steel Charge is less than 120 or after using the method above to activate Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Slaughter once. Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seed.name: Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Downfall
seed.desc: Seed has Steel Charge, which she can accumulate by hitting enemies with her skills. Steel Charge has a maximum value of 150, and an initial value of 60. Upon reaching 120 Steel Charge and triggering Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Slaughter or Suprema (Ultimate): Clockwork Garden - Bloom!, press or hold to consume 60 Steel Charge and unleash Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form, then automatically consume 60 Steel Charge to follow up with Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form. Pilots the mech to fire sweeping shots and perform a jumping smash, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seed.name: Esquiva: Running on Petals
seed.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seed.name: Dash Ataque: Magnetic Wheel Dance
seed.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Throw steel wheels forward, dealing Dano Físico.

seed.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Blossom Burst
seed.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seed.name: Ataque Especial: Withered in Frost
seed.desc: Press to activate. Throw a steel wheel that traces a curved path, dealing Dano Elétrico.

seed.name: Ataque Especial EX: Raining Iron Petals
seed.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Enter flight mode, where Seed can move in four directions, and unleash a continuous barrage of missiles, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Hold to extend the barrage duration while continuously consuming Energy. During flight, release to trigger Ataque Especial EX: Raining Iron Petals - Away. Upon consuming 60 Energy points in one flight, automatically trigger Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Slaughter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seed.name: Ataque Especial EX: Raining Iron Petals - Away
seed.desc: During Ataque Especial EX: Raining Iron Petals, release to activate: Unleash rapid cannon fire, dealing Dano Elétrico Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seed.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Tempest of Frosty Petals
seed.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Summons her mech for protection, then launches cannon shots and a barrage of missiles, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seed.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Clockwork Garden - Bloom!
seed.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Seed will pilot the mech personally, raining down missiles and a meteor shower of rockets, then performing a jumping smash, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. After using this skill, accumulate 60 Steel Charge. Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seed.name: Ataque de Suporte: Crimson Core Burst
seed.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Unleash continuous floating turret attacks at enemies ahead, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seed.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

This effect can trigger once every 1s.Seed's Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Slaughter, Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Downfall, and Suprema (Ultimate): Clockwork Garden - Bloom! deal 30% increased DMG and ignore 25% of enemy Electric RES.

seed.name: M1 Hibernation Period Cinema (Mindscape) 1
seed.desc: When Seed's Steel Charge reaches 100, Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Downfall can be triggered, and the total Steel Charge consumed is reduced to 100. Gain an additional 40/20 Steel Charge when entering the battlefield/using Suprema (Ultimate). Increases Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Downfall Dano Crítico by 30%.

seed.name: M2 Light Absorption Technique Cinema (Mindscape) 2
seed.desc: When Besiege is active for an Agent, that Agent's DMG ignores 20% of DEF. When activating Ataque Especial EX: Raining Iron Petals, after consuming a total of 60 Energy, Seed can continue consuming Energy to extend the duration of the skill until the button is released or a total of 120 Energy is consumed. For every 5 Energy consumed by Ataque Especial EX: Raining Iron Petals, the following Ataque Básico: Falling Petals - Slaughter's DMG increases by 5%.

seed.name: M3 A Story of Sprouting Cinema (Mindscape) 3
seed.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

seed.name: M4 Fragrant Tune Cinema (Mindscape) 4

seth.name: Ataque Básico: Lightning Strike
seth.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 4 attacks in front, dealing Dano Físico and Dano Elétrico.

seth.name: Ataque Básico: Lightning Strike - Electrified
seth.desc: When Resolve is above 75%, hold to activate: Consume 75% Resolve to launch continuous attacks in front, followed by a finishing strike that deals Dano Elétrico. When the finishing strike hits an enemy, it triggers the Suporte Rápido of the squad member positioned before Seth. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

seth.name: Esquiva: Evasion Maneuver
seth.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seth.name: Dash Ataque: Thunder Assault
seth.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Charge forward with a shield Ataque, dealing Dano Físico. Damage received during the move is decreased by 40%.

seth.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Retreat to Advance
seth.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Unleash a quick downward strike on enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. After the move, hold to chain into Ataque Especial EX: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seth.name: Ataque Especial: Thunder Shield Rush
seth.desc: Hold to activate. Launch two shield strikes forward, dealing Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

seth.name: Ataque Especial EX: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage
seth.desc: When Seth has enough energy, press to activate: Unleash a series of slashes in front, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Hold to charge the move, and Seth will dash forward, unleashing a series of powerful slashes, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Activating the move accumulates 75% Resolve. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging this skill, and damage taken is reduced by 40%. Seth is invulnerable during the continuous slashes.

seth.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Final Judgement
seth.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select Seth to activate: Launch a series of slashes in front, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Activating the move accumulates 75% Resolve. After the move, hold to chain into Ataque Especial EX: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seth.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Justice Prevails
seth.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Launch a series of upward slashes in front, followed by a finishing strike, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Activating the move accumulates 75% Resolve, and grants 3 additional Assist Points. After the move, hold to chain into Ataque Especial EX: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seth.name: Ataque de Suporte: Public Security Ruling
seth.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Launch a forward thrust Ataque, followed by two horizontal slashes, dealing Dano Elétrico. When the finishing strike hits an enemy, it triggers the Suporte Rápido of the squad member positioned before Seth. After the move, hold to chain into Ataque Especial EX: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seth.name: Suporte Defensivo: Thundershield
seth.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze). Seth gains 25% Resolve upon activating the skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seth.name: Suporte Rápido: Armed Suporte
seth.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Unleash a quick downward strike on enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. After the move, hold to chain into Ataque Especial EX: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, enabling faster charging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

seth.desc: Lv. 1

seth.name: Habilidade Adicional High Spirit
seth.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:When Seth's Ataque em Cadeia: Final Judgement or finishing strike during Ataque Básico: Lightning Strike - Electrified hits an enemy, the target's Anomalia Buildup RES to all Attributes is reduced by 20%, lasting 20s.

seth.name: M1 Heroism Cinema (Mindscape) 1
seth.desc: The shield value provided by Shield of Firm Resolve and its maximum limit is increased by 30%. When Shield of Firm Resolve ends, the Proficiência de Anomalia increase provided by Passiva de Núcleo: Protector lasts an additional 10s.

seth.name: M2 Recklessness of Youth Cinema (Mindscape) 2
seth.desc: Upon entering battle, Seth immediately gains 75% Resolve. Hitting an enemy with Ataque Básico: Lightning Strike - Electrified increases the move's accumulated Electric Anomalia Buildup by 35%.
