seth.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

seth.name: M6 Idealist Cinema (Mindscape) 6
seth.desc: When Seth lands a finishing strike on an enemy with Ataque Básico: Lightning Strike - Electrified, it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The Ataque is guaranteed to trigger a CRIT, and Dano Crítico is increased by 60%.

sigrid.name: Ataque Básico: Frost-Tipped Spear
sigrid.desc: Press to activate: Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Dano de Gelo. The 4th hit of Ataque Básico: Frost-Tipped Spear is considered an Unbridled Spear Ataque.

sigrid.name: Ataque Básico: Converging Spear
sigrid.desc: While in the Aerial Patrol Spear state and Ataque Básico: Converging Spear can be used, hold to activate: Launches the corresponding Ataque Básico: Converging Spear based on the current stage, dealing Dano de Gelo. Ataque Básico: Converging Spear has three stages. Each use advances it to the next stage. After performing the third stage of Ataque Básico: Converging Spear, it resets to the first stage. If Sigrid is attacked while charging the 1st or 2nd stage of Ataque Básico: Converging Spear, she blocks with her shield. On a successful block, the Ataque's DMG is negated, the next Ataque Básico: Converging Spear deals 100% more Atordoamento (Daze), the Aerial Patrol Spear state is refreshed, and she gains one use of Ataque Básico: Converging Spear. Press after a successful block to perform the corresponding stage of Ataque Básico: Converging Spear. Ataque Básico: Converging Spear performed after Ataque Básico: Frost-Tipped Spear retains the current stage of Ataque Básico: Frost-Tipped Spear. DMG taken is reduced by 60% during this skill. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill. Character is invulnerable during the third stage of Ataque Básico: Converging Spear.

sigrid.name: Esquiva: Cloudstep
sigrid.desc: Press to activate: A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sigrid.name: Dash Ataque: Windchase
sigrid.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Performs a forward cleaving slash, dealing Dano Físico.

sigrid.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Counterthrust
sigrid.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Condenses frost around the spearhead before unleashing a powerful counterattack, dealing Dano de Gelo. When performed after Ataque Básico: Frost-Tipped Spear, Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Counterthrust retains the current stage of Ataque Básico: Frost-Tipped Spear. This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sigrid.name: Ataque Especial: Frostflower
sigrid.desc: Press to activate: Performs three forward thrusts, dealing Dano de Gelo. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

sigrid.name: Ataque Especial EX: Scattered Jade
sigrid.desc: With enough Energy and while not in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, press to activate: Performs a series of powerful stabs ahead, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sigrid.name: Ataque Especial EX: Shattered Jade
sigrid.desc: With enough Energy and while in the Aerial Patrol Spear state, press to activate: Performs a series of powerful lunging stabs ahead, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sigrid.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Encroaching Ice
sigrid.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Performs a powerful piercing Ataque against enemies ahead, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Upon activating this skill, gains the Tempered effect, increasing the DMG dealt by subsequent Ataque Básico: Converging Spear attacks by 20% for 50s. When the current skill hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, the current stage of Ataque Básico: Converging Spear is recorded and then reset before entering the Formation Breaker state. While in Formation Breaker, Aerial Patrol Spear's duration will not be reduced. Hold Icon_Normal to continuously activate the 1st through 3rd stage of Ataque Básico: Converging Spear. After activating the 3rd stage of Ataque Básico: Converging Spear, Formation Breaker ends and Ataque Básico: Converging Spear's stage is restored to the recorded stage. Formation Breaker can trigger at most once against the same target before the target recovers from Atordoamento (Stun). This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear Ataque. While in the Formation Breaker state, Ataque Básico: Converging Spear does not trigger the Ataque em Cadeia window when hitting Stunned enemies. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sigrid.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Frozen Heavens
sigrid.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Gathers the power of extreme cold before unleashing a devastating series of lunging attacks, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sigrid.name: Suporte Rápido: Iron Sentinel
sigrid.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate: Condenses ice before lunging forward, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sigrid.name: Suporte Defensivo: Dauntless Cold
sigrid.desc: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate: Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sigrid.name: Ataque de Suporte: Devouring Frost
sigrid.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Swings the spear upward before following with a powerful downward Ataque, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. This skill is considered an Unbridled Spear Ataque. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sigrid.name: Passiva de Núcleo Sky Knight
sigrid.desc: Lv. 1

sigrid.name: Habilidade Adicional Legion of the Skies
sigrid.desc: When another character in your squad is a Suporte or Atordoamento (Stun) character:Sigrid's ATK increases by 120. This effect scales with character level, with each level providing an additional increase of 12, up to a maximum increase of 840.DMG increases by 15% when hitting enemies in the Contamination state.

sigrid.name: M1 Long, Long Ago Cinema (Mindscape) 1
sigrid.desc: Upon activating the 3rd stage of Ataque Básico: Converging Spear, enters the Aerial Patrol Spear and gains 1 additional activation of Ataque Básico: Converging Spear. When activations exceed the stored Ataque Básico: Converging Spear's activation limit, the next Ataque Básico: Converging Spear's final hit deals an additional 100% of ATK as Dano de Gelo. Sigrid's ATK increases by 25%.

sigrid.name: M2 Legend's First Act Cinema (Mindscape) 2
sigrid.desc: Perfuração Ratio of Unbridled Spear attacks and Ataque Básico: Converging Spear increases by 24%. The duration of Aerial Patrol Spear is extended by 2s. Sigrid's Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%.

sigrid.name: M3 Protector of Miracles Cinema (Mindscape) 3
sigrid.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

sigrid.name: M4 Hero in Training Cinema (Mindscape) 4
sigrid.desc: Each time upon gaining Aerial Patrol Spear, DMG dealt increases by 18% for 8s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by 8s, up to a maximum of 40s.

sigrid.name: M5 Skybound Oath Cinema (Mindscape) 5
sigrid.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

sigrid.name: M6 Knight of the Skies Cinema (Mindscape) 6
sigrid.desc: When Ataque Básico: Converging Spear's 1st/2nd/3rd stage's final hit lands, it deals an additional 80%/90%/100% ATK as Dano de Gelo. There is no more limit on the number of times Sigrid can enter the Formation Breaker state upon hitting a Stunned enemy with Ataque em Cadeia: Encroaching Ice. Formation Breaker state's Ataque Básico: Converging Spear will activate faster.

soldier11.name: Potential Awakened Potential: Infernal Blaze
soldier11.desc: Lv. 1

soldier11.name: Ataque Básico: Warmup Sparks
soldier11.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing Dano Físico.

soldier11.name: Ataque Básico: Fire Suppression
soldier11.desc: Press at the right moment to activate: Launches a stronger slash, dealing Dano de Fogo. When Fire Suppression is guaranteed to trigger, pressing when the Ataque is about to end speeds up the transition into the next hit of Ataque Básico. When Fire Suppression is guaranteed to trigger, the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico string unlocks. Activating a Ataque em Cadeia or Suprema (Ultimate) powers up her next Ataque Básico 5th hit. A strengthened Ataque Básico 5th hit will consume all remaining guaranteed Fire Suppression activations to deal additional Dano de Fogo per activation spent. After triggering a Perfect Esquiva, the current Ataque Básico hit count is retained for 5s. After performing a Contra-ataque de Esquiva, pressing resumes the Ataque Básico from the retained hit count.

soldier11.name: Ataque Básico: Fire Assault
soldier11.desc: Hold to activate: Ataque Básico: Fire Charge Release while Ataque Básico: Fire Charge is activated to launch Ataque Básico: Fire Assault. If attacked by an enemy during Ataque Básico: Fire Assault or the moment Ataque Básico: Fire Charge is activated, a Block Counter can be triggered, negating that instance of DMG and granting 3 guaranteed triggers of Fire Suppression. Press to follow up with the 3rd hit of a Ataque Básico, up to 8 times. While charging, tilting the stick/joystick launches Ataque Básico: Blazing Rush.

soldier11.name: Esquiva: Tempered Fire
soldier11.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soldier11.name: Dash Ataque: Blazing Fire
soldier11.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

soldier11.name: Dash Ataque: Fire Suppression
soldier11.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo.

soldier11.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Backdraft
soldier11.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Executes a powerful slash against enemies in front, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soldier11.name: Ataque Especial: Raging Fire
soldier11.desc: Press to activate. Slashes enemies nearby, dealing Dano de Fogo. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

soldier11.name: Ataque Especial EX: Fervent Fire
soldier11.desc: With enough energy, press to activate. Executes a powerful slash against enemies nearby, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, Soldier 11's Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks are guaranteed to trigger Fire Suppression for up to 30s or 8 times. After using this skill, press to immediately follow up with the 4th hit of a Ataque Básico. Soldier 11 enters the Alert Stance after using this skill. While in Alert Stance, if hit during a Ataque Básico, triggers Ataque Básico: Fire Charge to block the Ataque, followed by Ataque Básico: Fire Assault. After Ataque Básico: Fire Assault is performed, press to resume Ataque Básico from the retained Ataque Básico hit count.

soldier11.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Uplifting Flame
soldier11.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate. Slashes enemies in a small area ahead, then executes a powerful upwards slash, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, Soldier 11's Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks are guaranteed to trigger Fire Suppression for up to 30s or 8 times. After using this skill, press to immediately follow up with the 4th hit of a Ataque Básico. Soldier 11 enters the Alert Stance after using this skill. While in Alert Stance, if hit during a Ataque Básico, triggers Ataque Básico: Fire Charge to block the Ataque, followed by Ataque Básico: Fire Assault. After Ataque Básico: Fire Assault is performed, press to resume Ataque Básico from the retained Ataque Básico hit count.

soldier11.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Bellowing Flame
soldier11.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Slashes enemies nearby, dealing massive Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, Soldier 11's Basic Attacks and Dash Attacks are guaranteed to trigger Fire Suppression for up to 30s or 8 times. After using this skill, press to immediately follow up with the 4th hit of a Ataque Básico. Soldier 11 enters the Alert Stance after using this skill. While in Alert Stance, if hit during a Ataque Básico, triggers Ataque Básico: Fire Charge to block the Ataque, followed by Ataque Básico: Fire Assault. After Ataque Básico: Fire Assault is performed, press to resume Ataque Básico from the retained Ataque Básico hit count.

soldier11.name: Ataque de Suporte: Reignition
soldier11.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Charge and cross slash enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soldier11.name: Suporte Defensivo: Hold the Line
soldier11.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soldier11.name: Suporte Rápido: Covering Fire
soldier11.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Fogo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soldier11.name: Passiva de Núcleo Heatwave
soldier11.desc: Lv. 1

soldier11.name: Habilidade Adicional Fields of Fire
soldier11.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:Soldier 11 deals 10% more Dano de Fogo. When attacking Stunned enemies, this effect is further enhanced by an additional 22.5%.

soldier11.name: M1 Rapid Heat Cinema (Mindscape) 1
soldier11.desc: When Soldier 11 enters combat or switches in, if her Energy is less than 40, her Energy is recovered to 80. This effect can trigger once every 50s.

soldier11.name: M2 Scorching Convergence Cinema (Mindscape) 2
soldier11.desc: When triggering Fire Suppression, Ataque Básico, Dash Ataque, and Contra-ataque de Esquiva DMG increases by 3%, up to 12 stacks, lasting 15s, with the duration of each stack calculated separately.

soldier11.name: M3 Elite Soldier Cinema (Mindscape) 3
soldier11.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

soldier11.name: M4 Indulgent Blaze Cinema (Mindscape) 4
soldier11.desc: If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd hit of Soldier 11's Ataque Básico or a Dash Ataque, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG received is reduced by 18% during skill activation. If Fire Suppression is triggered during the 4th hit of her Ataque Básico, she becomes invulnerable during skill activation.

soldier11.name: M5 Perfect Soldier Cinema (Mindscape) 5
soldier11.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

soldier11.name: M6 Scorching Flow Cinema (Mindscape) 6
soldier11.desc: When Soldier 11 uses her Ataque Especial EX, Ataque em Cadeia, or Suprema (Ultimate), she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When Fire Suppression is triggered, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, causing the current move to ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES.

soukaku.name: Ataque Básico: Making Rice Cakes
soukaku.desc: Press to activate. Unleashes up to 3 attacks, dealing Dano Físico.

soukaku.name: Ataque Básico: Making Rice Cakes (Frosted Banner)
soukaku.desc: When Frosted Banner is active, press to activate. Unleashes up to 3 faster attacks in front, dealing Dano de Gelo.

soukaku.name: Esquiva: Grab a Bite
soukaku.desc: Press to Esquiva. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soukaku.name: Dash Ataque: 50/50
soukaku.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

soukaku.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Away From My Snacks
soukaku.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soukaku.name: Dash Ataque: 50/50 (Frosted Banner)
soukaku.desc: When Frosted Banner is active, press during a Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo.

soukaku.name: Ataque Especial: Cooling Bento
soukaku.desc: Press to activate. Soukaku releases a wind current in front of her and unleashes her finishing move, dealing Dano de Gelo. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. Holding while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

soukaku.name: Ataque Especial EX: Fanning Mosquitoes
soukaku.desc: With enough energyy, press to activate. Releases wind currents of extended range in front of her, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. This skill can be used in rapid succession by pressing repeatedly. Each use consumes a specified amount of Energy. When Soukaku's Energy is depleted, or you stop pressing the button, she unleashes a powerful finishing move that deals massive Dano de Gelo. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and her DMG taken is reduced by 40%. Holding while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

soukaku.name: Ataque Especial: Rally!
soukaku.desc: Hold to activate. Soukaku plunges her weapon into the ground, morphs it into a flag, and launches Fly the Flag, dealing Dano de Gelo. Hitting an enemy with Fly the Flag triggers a Suporte Rápido. Pressing or after Fly the Flag activates a Ataque Especial as she retracts the flag, dealing Dano de Gelo. If Soukaku owns 3 stacks of Vortex on using Fly the Flag, she consumes all 3 stacks and enters the Frosted Banner state. In the Frosted Banner state, she can unleash an enhanced Ataque Básico or an enhanced Dash Ataque, dealing massive Dano de Gelo This effect can last up to 45s or stack up to 6 times. Soukaku's weapon gains Vortexes in the following circumstances: Gains 1 stack of Vortex when launching an Ataque Especial EX, Gains 1 stack of Vortex when launching a Ataque em Cadeia, Gains 3 stacks of Vortex when launching an Suprema (Ultimate). Soukaku can accumulate a maximum of 3 stacks of Vortex.

soukaku.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Pudding Slash
soukaku.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Soukaku quickly unleashes a series of strikes at enemies in front of her and follows up with Fly the Flag, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soukaku.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Jumbo Pudding Slash
soukaku.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Soukaku quickly unleashes an extended series of strikes at enemies in front of her and follows up with Fly the Flag, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Upon activating this skill, Soukaku enters the Masked state, increasing her Taxa Crítica by 15% for 15s. Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in gains an additional 20 Energy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soukaku.name: Ataque de Suporte: Sweeping Strike
soukaku.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate. Charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Holding while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

soukaku.name: Suporte Defensivo: Guarding Tactics
soukaku.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soukaku.name: Suporte Rápido: A Set for Two
soukaku.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

soukaku.desc: Lv. 1

soukaku.desc: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:When Soukaku consumes Vortex to activate Fly the Flag, the Dano de Gelo of the squad is increased by 20% for 22s..

soukaku.name: M1 Uplifting Current Cinema (Mindscape) 1
soukaku.desc: When Soukaku triggers Passiva de Núcleo: Blade Banner or Habilidade Adicional: Group Set Meal, the buff duration is increased by 8s.

soukaku.name: M2 Experimental Charging Module Cinema (Mindscape) 2
soukaku.desc: When Soukaku's Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, Esquiva Counters, or Suporte Rápido hits an enemy, there's a 15% chance she gains 1 stack of Vortex, triggering up to once per second. When Vortex reaches max stacks, any additional stacks grant Soukaku 1.2 Energy instead.

soukaku.name: M3 Attendance Meal Allowance Cinema (Mindscape) 3
soukaku.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

soukaku.name: M4 Hypothermia Cinema (Mindscape) 4
soukaku.desc: If an enemy is hit by Fly the Flag, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 10% for 8s.

soukaku.name: M5 Late-Night Snacks Cinema (Mindscape) 5
soukaku.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

soukaku.name: M6 Northern Wind Cinema (Mindscape) 6
soukaku.desc: While in the Frosted Banner state, the number of usable enhanced Basic Attacks and enhanced Dash Attacks is increased to 12, and also deal 45% more DMG.

sunna.name: Ataque Básico: Mischief Meteor Hammer
sunna.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to four attacks ahead, dealing Dano Físico.

sunna.name: Ataque Básico: Naughty Cat Spotted
sunna.desc: During combat, when Sunna is off-field and there are no enemies with Cat's Gaze, Bubblegum consumes 1 Claw Sharpener to automatically launch an Ataque, dealing Dano Físico. When any squad member activates Ether Veil, Sunna gains 2 Claw Sharpeners. When any squad member applies an Anomalia to an enemy, Sunna gains 1 Claw Sharpeners. This effect can trigger at most once every 10s. Bubblegum inherits Sunna's initial ATK. Sunna can hold up to 6 Claw Sharpeners.

sunna.name: Esquiva: Can't Hit Me
sunna.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sunna.name: Dash Ataque: Skyward Hammer
sunna.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Dano Físico.

sunna.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Delusion Strikeout
sunna.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Strikes enemies in front with a series of hammer blows, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sunna.name: Ataque Especial: Star Shooter
sunna.desc: Press to activate. Shoots Bubblegum to Ataque enemies in front using an air gun, dealing Dano Físico. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.

sunna.name: Ataque Especial EX: Bubblegum Barrage
sunna.desc: With enough energy, press to activate. Hurls Bubblegum at the target, dealing Dano Físico. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat. Upon activating this skill, all Agents in the squad gain Angelic Chord-ination for 40s. Landing a heavy Ataque with this skill triggers a Suporte Rápido. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sunna.name: Ataque Especial EX: Special Photography Technique
sunna.desc: While in the Angelic Chord-ination state, press to activate, or during Ataque Especial EX: Bubblegum Barrage, keep holding to quickly activate: Attacks the target enemy in coordination with Bubblegum, dealing Dano Físico. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat. Before the heavy Ataque is executed, activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will cancel the existing instance of Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. Landing a heavy Ataque with this skill triggers a Suporte Rápido. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Ataque Especial EX: Special Photography Technique can be used once each time Angelic Chord-ination state is entered.

sunna.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Don't Mess With the Cat
sunna.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Charges forward on Bubblegum, dealing massive Dano Físico. Landing a heavy Ataque with this skill triggers a Suporte Rápido. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sunna.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Smash It All!
sunna.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: After a series of hammer attacks, launches Bubblegum to cause an explosion, dealing massive Dano Físico to enemies in an area. On activating the heavy Ataque, gain 6 Claw Sharpeners. Upon landing the downward Ataque from above on an enemy, a Suporte Rápido is triggered, restoring some HP to all squad members. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sunna.name: Ataque de Suporte: Jump Training
sunna.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Continuously jumps forward on the inflatable hammer, dealing massive Dano Físico to enemies in front. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sunna.name: Suporte Defensivo: Stage Fright
sunna.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sunna.name: Suporte Rápido: Sonic Beatdown
sunna.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Unleash a series of hammer attacks against enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

sunna.name: Passiva de Núcleo Cuteness Is Justice
sunna.desc: Lv. 1

sunna.desc: When another character in your squad is an Ataque character or shares the same Faction:When characters inside Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise land attacks on enemies, the target's Atordoamento (Stun) DMG Multiplier increases by 30% for 40s.When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone mode, the effect can trigger once every 180s.

sunna.name: M1 Loneliness Corruption Symptoms Cinema (Mindscape) 1
sunna.desc: When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Cat's Gaze triggers and hits an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 7% for 40s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

sunna.name: M2 Feline Go-With-the-Flow Cinema (Mindscape) 2
sunna.desc: While Sunna is within any Ether Veil, all squad members gain 10% ATK and she obtains 1 Claw Sharpener every 10s. The number of attacks required to trigger Cat's Gaze is reduced, and the DMG Multiplier on trigger is increased: When triggered by an Ataque character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 200%.When triggered by an Anomalia character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 300%.

sunna.name: M3 Transformation Apple Cinema (Mindscape) 3
sunna.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

sunna.name: M4 Delusion Investigation Team Cinema (Mindscape) 4
sunna.desc: When Sunna uses her Suprema (Ultimate), all squad members deal 18% increased DMG for 60s.

sunna.name: M5 Galaxy Tramway Cinema (Mindscape) 5
sunna.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

sunna.name: M6 Hollow Big Bang Cinema (Mindscape) 6
sunna.desc: When Sunna uses an Ataque Especial EX, she enters the Focused Creation! state for 8s. While in the Focused Creation! state, all attacks Sunna performs are guaranteed to CRIT, and her Dano Crítico increases by 0.03% of her initial ATK, up to a maximum of 105%.While in the Focused Creation! state, Sunna's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.While in the Focused Creation! state, Sunna can trigger Cat's Gaze, its DMG being calculated using Ataque Agent rules. If Cat's Gaze is triggered while Sunna has a Claw Sharpener, the Claw Sharpener is immediately consumed, and Cat's Gaze is reapplied to the enemy. While in the Focused Creation! state, DMG dealt when any squad member triggers Cat's Gaze increases by 50%.

trigger.name: Ataque Básico: Cold-Bore Shot
trigger.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 4 shots ahead. The first 3 hits deal Dano Físico, the 4th hit deals Dano Elétrico.

trigger.name: Ataque Básico: Silenced Shot
trigger.desc: Hold to activate: Trigger enters the Sniper Stance and fires forward continuously, dealing Dano Elétrico. While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s. While continually firing, you can drag the stick/joystick to adjust her position to the left/right/back. Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a Perfect Esquiva, followed by an automatic charged counter. After releasing , Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit Sniper Stance. Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move. When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 Purge, up to a maximum of 100 Purge. When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the Suporte Rápido of the previous character in the squad.

trigger.name: Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot
trigger.desc: When Trigger has Purge, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a Ataque Básico, Contra-ataque de Esquiva, Ataque Especial, Dash Ataque or Suporte Rápido to activate: While encircling the enemy, rapidly fire two shots at the enemy, dealing Dano Elétrico. Upon activating this skill, consume 3 Purge. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot is an Aftershock Ataque. The squad can trigger Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot once every 3s.

trigger.name: Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus
trigger.desc: When Trigger has Purge, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a heavy Ataque from an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque de Suporte, or Suprema (Ultimate) to activate: While encircling the enemy, rapidly fires three shots at the enemy, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Dano Elétrico. Upon activating this skill, consume 5 Purge. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus is an Aftershock Ataque. The same skill type can trigger Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus up to 2 times within 20s for the entire squad.

trigger.name: Esquiva: Phantom Concealment
trigger.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

trigger.name: Dash Ataque: Vengeful Specter
trigger.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Rapidly lift the gun and fire, dealing Dano Físico.

trigger.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Condemned Soul
trigger.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

trigger.name: Ataque Especial: Spectral Flash
trigger.desc: Press to activate. Lunge forward with a slash, dealing Dano Elétrico. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

trigger.name: Ataque Especial EX: Flash Burial
trigger.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Lunge forward with a slash, then leap up with a powerful shot to the ground, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Suporte Rápido of the previous character in the squad. When this skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Suporte. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any Ataque, it triggers a Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Each repeated trigger extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

trigger.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Stygian Guide
trigger.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes continuous powerful shots forward, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

trigger.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Underworld Requiem
trigger.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Suporte Rápido of the previous character in the squad. When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Suporte. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any Ataque, it triggers a Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Each repeated trigger extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

trigger.name: Ataque de Suporte: Piercing Thunder
trigger.desc: Press after an Evasive Assist to activate: Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, followed by a powerful charged shot after landing, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

trigger.name: Suporte Defensivo: Delaying Demise
trigger.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

trigger.name: Suporte Rápido: Cold-Bore Cover Fire
trigger.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Rotate and fire a quick shot at enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

trigger.name: Passiva de Núcleo Soul-Searching Gaze
trigger.desc: Lv. 1

trigger.name: Habilidade Adicional Silver Lantern's Gaze
trigger.desc: When another character in your squad is an Ataque character or shares the same attribute:When Trigger's Taxa Crítica exceeds 40%, each 1% Taxa Crítica above this threshold increases her Atordoamento (Daze) dealt by Aftershocks by 1.5%, up to a maximum increase of 75%.

trigger.name: M1 Sharpened Senses Cinema (Mindscape) 1
trigger.desc: The Atordoamento (Stun) DMG Multiplier applied through Passiva de Núcleo: Soul-Searching Gaze is increased by an additional 20%. When activating Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. Purge gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in Sniper Stance increases by 25%. Maximum Purge increases to 125.

trigger.name: M2 Ether Vision Cinema (Mindscape) 2
trigger.desc: Upon using an Aftershock, Trigger gains 1 stack of Hunter's Gaze. When executing a Finishing Move in Sniper Stance, Trigger gains 2 stacks of Hunter's Gaze. Each stack of Hunter's Gaze increases all squad members' Dano Crítico by 6%, stacking up to 4 times, and lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

trigger.name: M3 Homecoming Cinema (Mindscape) 3
trigger.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

trigger.name: M4 Concealment Cinema (Mindscape) 4
trigger.desc: When Trigger enters or extends Coordinated Suporte, while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot or Ataque Básico: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus, it will trigger Disconnect upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Atordoamento (Daze) equal to 120% of Trigger's Impacto. This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.

trigger.name: M5 Locked In Cinema (Mindscape) 5
trigger.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

trigger.name: M6 Beyond the River of the Dead Cinema (Mindscape) 6
trigger.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, Trigger gains 5 Armor Break Rounds. For every 25 Purge consumed, Trigger gains 1 additional Armor Break Round, up to a maximum of 5 rounds. While possessing Armor Break Rounds, when Trigger hits a target in Sniper Stance, 1 Armor Break Round is consumed to deal additional Dano Elétrico equal to 1,200% of Trigger's ATK. In addition, this instance of DMG is additionally increased by 50%. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.

velina.name: Ataque Básico: Dancing Fans
velina.desc: Press to activate: Launches up to five attacks against enemies ahead, dealing Dano de Vento. During the 5th Ataque, Velina's Anti-Interrupt Level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

velina.name: Esquiva: Windward Sweep
velina.desc: Press to activate: A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

velina.name: Dash Ataque: Gale Step
velina.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Delivers a quick Ataque forward, dealing Dano de Vento.

velina.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Cloudrend
velina.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Launch a series of attacks on the target, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

velina.name: Ataque Especial: Wind Shear - Purging Surge
velina.desc: Press to activate: Unleash a sweeping gust forward, dealing Dano de Vento.

velina.name: Ataque Especial EX: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise
velina.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate: Dodges backward, then unleashes a massive wind blast to Ataque enemies, dealing Dano de Vento. During the backward Esquiva, a Esquiva effect is active. Successfully dodging an enemy Ataque triggers Vital View. After using this skill, press to chain into the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

velina.name: Ataque Especial EX: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow
velina.desc: With enough energy and after using Ataque Especial EX: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise, press or hold to activate: Continuously swing the fan, dealing Dano de Vento. After using this skill, press to chain into the 5th hit of the Ataque Básico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

velina.name: Ataque Especial EX: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm
velina.desc: With 90 or more , hold or to activate: Velina channels a whirlwind and summons a to continuously Ataque enemies and triggers the previous character's Suporte Rápido. Sweeping Cyclone lasts for 5s and deals Dano de Vento to nearby enemies once every 0.5s.

velina.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Thousandfold Spiral
velina.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Transforms into a hurricane to unleash multiple attacks against enemies, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

velina.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Heed the Tempest
velina.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Unleashes multiple attacks against enemies ahead, dealing massive Dano de Vento. After using this skill, the previous character's Suporte Rápido is triggered. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

velina.name: Ataque de Suporte: Negotiation Techniques
velina.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Unleash a series of attacks, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

velina.name: Suporte Defensivo: Judicious Intervention
velina.desc: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate: Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

velina.name: Quick Suporte: Emergency Protocol
velina.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate: Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing Dano de Vento. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

velina.name: Passiva de Núcleo Breeze in Bloom
velina.desc: Lv. 1

velina.name: Habilidade Adicional Mystery Hunt
velina.desc: When another character in your squad is an Anomalia character or shares the same attribute:Velina's [Windswept] and [Vortex] DMG increases by 10%. When the heavy Ataque from an [Suprema (Ultimate)] hits an enemy suffering a Wind Attribute Anomalia, it triggers an instance of [Abloom] DMG against the target: resolves one additional instance of Attribute Anomalia DMG, fixed at 680% of Wind Attribute Anomalia DMG.For [Passiva de Núcleo: Breeze in Bloom], the Attribute Anomalia Buildup RES reduction from is further increased by 7%, while Atordoamento (Daze) inflicted increases by 30%, and accumulated Attribute Anomalia Buildup increases by 15%.

velina.name: M1 Orderly Elegance Cinema (Mindscape) 1
velina.desc: Sweeping Cyclone from Habilidade Adicional: Tea Party Etiquette deals an additional 20% Atordoamento (Daze). When Velina triggers Vortex, she ignores 20% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When squad members deal Windswept DMG, 20% of the target's Wind RES is ignored.

velina.name: M2 Saturation Project Cinema (Mindscape) 2
velina.desc: When Velina triggers Windswept, she can also gain 1 point of Windbite. This effect can trigger once every 5s. After Sweeping Cyclone triggers the Chromatic Tint effect, it can accumulate the corresponding attribute's Anomalia Buildup. The buildup accumulated by this Ataque is excluded from Anomalia DMG calculations. The DMG increase effects of Velina's Windswept and Vortex from Habilidade Adicional: Tea Party Etiquette are further increased by 15%.

velina.name: M3 Conquest by Etiquette Cinema (Mindscape) 3
velina.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

velina.name: M4 Tea Party Tribunal Cinema (Mindscape) 4
velina.desc: When Velina uses an Ataque Especial EX, her ATK increases by 15% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

velina.name: M5 Death Witch Cinema (Mindscape) 5
velina.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

velina.name: M6 Chief Angel Cinema (Mindscape) 6
velina.desc: When Velina consumes 2 points of Windbite to increase the DMG Multiplier of Vortex, she gains 1 point of Windbite. This effect can trigger once every 6s. When Velina hits an enemy suffering a Wind Attribute Anomalia, the Wind Attribute Anomalia Buildup she inflicts increases by 20%. When Velina inflicts Windswept on an enemy already affected by Windswept, the new Windswept's DMG increases based on the remaining duration of the previous. Each remaining second increases the DMG by 2.5%, up to a maximum increase of 40%.

vivian.name: Ataque Básico: Feathered Strike
vivian.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 4 attacks in front, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Éter. After triggering the fourth Ataque, enter the Noblewoman state. With Flight Feathers available, holding during the fourth Ataque will activate the Fluttering Frock state.

vivian.name: Ataque Básico: Noblweoman - Waltz
vivian.desc: Press while in the Noblewoman state to activate: Dash forward with an Ataque that deals Dano de Éter and restores 1 Flight Feather upon hitting an enemy. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. If a Perfect Esquiva is triggered during the dash, gain 1 additional Flight Feather. If Flight Feathers are available after the skill, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding when the skill is used.

vivian.name: Ataque Básico: Fluttering Frock - Suspension
vivian.desc: Press while in the Fluttering Frock state to activate: Ataque an area ahead, dealing Dano de Éter. After activation, this skill consumes all Flight Feathers, and each one consurned grants 1 Guard Feather. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. When switching characters during the Fluttering Frock state, Vivian will automatically perform Ataque Básico: Fluttering Frock - Suspension. While in the Fluttering Frock state, press to exit the state.

vivian.name: Ataque Básico: Featherbloom
vivian.desc: After any character in the squad hits a target with an Ataque Especial EX, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Ataque Básico: Featherbloom against the target, dealing Dano de Éter, triggering at most once per use of a skill. This effect can trigger even while Vivian is off-field. A maximurn of 5 Guard Feathers can be stored.

vivian.name: Esquiva: Lightstream
vivian.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

vivian.name: Dash Ataque: Silver Thorned Melody
vivian.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Launches a forward thrust at enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

vivian.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Wingblade Reverb
vivian.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Launches an Ataque on enemies ahead, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After activating the skill, enter the Noblewoman state. When there are Flight Feathers available, hold during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

vivian.name: Esquiva: Dainty Steps
vivian.desc: When in the Noblewoman state and about to be attacked, an automatic Esquiva will trigger, during which the character will be Invulnerable, but a Perfect Esquiva will not be triggered. This can trigger once each time the Noblewoman state is entered.

vivian.name: Ataque Especial: Song of Silver Wings
vivian.desc: Press to activate. Quickly Ataque forward, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Éter. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

vivian.name: Ataque Especial EX: Violet Requiem
vivian.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Unleash a powerful forward Ataque that deals massive Dano de Éter and grants 3 Flight Feathers. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. Enter the Fluttering Frock state after using the skill. Hold during the skill to enter the Noblewoman state.

vivian.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Chorus of Celestial Wings
vivian.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Launch a powerful Ataque on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Dano de Éter and gaining 2 Flight Feathers. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After the skill activates, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding during the skill.

vivian.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Soarding Bird's Song
vivian.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Launch a powerful Ataque on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Dano de Éter and gaining 5 Flight Feathers. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After the skill is activated, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding during the skill.

vivian.name: Ataque de Suporte: Featherblade Execution
vivian.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Launch an Ataque at enanies ahead, dealing Dano de Éter and gaining 2 Flight Feathers. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After the skill activates enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding during the skill.

vivian.name: Suporte Defensivo: Silver Umbrella Formation
vivian.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

vivian.name: Suporte Rápido: Frostwing Guard
vivian.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Launches an Ataque on enenies ahead, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Éter. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After the skill activates, enter the Noblewoman state. With Flight Feathers available, hold during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

vivian.name: Passiva de Núcleo Dirge of Destiny
vivian.desc: Lv. 1

vivian.name: Habilidade Adicional Prophetic Tears
vivian.desc: When another character in your squad is an Anomalia character or shares the same attribute:Whenever another squad menber applies Attribute Anomalia to an enemy, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Ataque Básico: Featherbloom on the target. This can trigger once every 0.5s.Corruption DMG dealt by all squad members and the Corruption status' Disorder DMG increases by 12%.

vivian.name: M1 Walking Into the Orchard in Spring Cinema (Mindscape) 1
vivian.desc: When a total of 4 Guard Feathers are consumed, gain 1 Flight Feather. All Attribute Anomalia DMG and Disorder DMG received by targets under Vivian's Prophecy increases by 16%.

vivian.name: M2 Stormy Night, Stormy Night Cinema (Mindscape) 2
vivian.desc: Vivian's Ether Anomalia Buildup Rate increases by 25%. The benefits of Abloom from Proficiência de Anomalia are raised to 130% of the original value, and 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES is ignored.

vivian.name: M3 Another and the Same Cinema (Mindscape) 3
vivian.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

vivian.name: M4 The Wind Between the Reeds Cinema (Mindscape) 4
vivian.desc: Ataque Básico: Fluttering Frock - Suspension and Ataque Básico: Featherbloom will always CRIT on hit, and they will also increase Vivian's ATK by 12% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When entering the battlefield, Vivian immediately gains 5 Guard Feathers.

vivian.name: M5 Sonnet Cinema (Mindscape) 5
vivian.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

vivian.name: M6 Vivian Cinema (Mindscape) 6
vivian.desc: Vivian's Dano de Éter increases by 40%. When triggering a Perfect Esquiva during Ataque Básico: Noblewoman - Waltz's dash, or using Ataque Especial EX: Violet Requiem, gain 1 additional Flight Feather. Launching Ataque Básico: Fluttering Frock - Suspension consumes all Guard Feathers, the downward Ataque's area of effect increases, and upon hit, triggers a special instance of Abloom. Each additional Guard Feather consumed will increase the proportion of additional Anomalia DMG dealt by that instance of Abloom, consuming a maximum of 5 Guard Feathers to increase the DMG up to a maximum of 5 times the original.

yanagi.name: Ataque Básico: Tsukuyomi Kagura
yanagi.desc: Yanagi has two stances: Jougen and Kagen. Press to activate: Execute up to five forward slashes based on the current stance, causing Dano Físico and Dano Elétrico. During combat, Yanagi gains the corresponding stance buff based on her current stance: Jougen stance buff: Dano Elétrico increases by 10%. Anti-Interrupt Level increases during Basic Attacks. Kagen stance buff: Perfuração Ratio increases by 10%. Interrupt Level increases for Basic Attacks. For 8s after switching stances, Yanagi retains the bonus from the previous stance.

yanagi.name: Esquiva: Wandering Breeze
yanagi.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yanagi.name: Dash Ataque: Fleeting Flight
yanagi.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

yanagi.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Rapid Retaliation
yanagi.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Ataque Básico.

yanagi.name: Ataque Especial: Ruten
yanagi.desc: Press to activate. Perform a forward slash, dealing Dano Elétrico, and switch the current stance. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill. If activated after the 3rd, 4th, or 5th hit of a Ataque Básico, it activates Swift Ruten, speeding up the slashes while switching her current stance. Block enemy attacks while Swift Ruten is active. Upon activating Swift Ruten, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Ataque Básico.

yanagi.name: Ataque Especial EX: Gekka Ruten
yanagi.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Charge up power for a quick forward thrust, followed by a downward Ataque, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Upon executing the thrust, Yanagi switches stances and enters the Shinrabanshou state, lasting 15s. For the duration of this state, when following up with a subsequent Ataque Básico from the 5th hit of a Ataque Básico or other skills, the combo will begin directly from the 3rd hit of the Ataque Básico. If the downward Ataque hits an enemy suffering an Anomalia, it triggers a special Disorder effect, Polarity Disorder, dealing 15% of the original Disorder effect's DMG to the target, plus an additional percentage of Yanagi's Proficiência de Anomalia. Polarity Disorder will not remove the target's Anomalia.

yanagi.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Celestial Harmony
yanagi.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Switch stances and unleash a powerful slash on enemies in front, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Ataque Básico.

yanagi.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Raiei Tenge
yanagi.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Yanagi unleashes her potential and delivers a powerful slash to a large area of enemies in front in a very short time, followed by an additional lightning strike, dealing massive Dano Elétrico. When the lightning strike hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomalia, it triggers a special Disorder effect called Polarity Disorder. This deals DMG equal to 15% of the original Disorder effect plus an additional percentage of Yanagi's Proficiência de Anomalia. Polarity Disorder will not remove the target's Anomalia. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, Yanagi can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Ataque Básico.

yanagi.name: Ataque de Suporte: Weeping Willow Stab
yanagi.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Switch stances, and quickly deliver multiple slashes to enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Ataque Básico.

yanagi.name: Suporte Defensivo: Radiant Reversal
yanagi.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, inflicting massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yanagi.name: Suporte Rápido: Blade of Elegance
yanagi.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Elétrico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of the current stance's Ataque Básico.

yanagi.name: Habilidade Adicional Gessou
yanagi.desc: When another character in your squad is an Anomalia character or shares the same attribute:After switching stances, when Yanagi hits an enemy with Ataque Básico: Tsukuyomi Kagura, Anomalia Buildup increases by 45% for 8s.

yanagi.name: M1 Know Thy Self, Know Thy Enemy Cinema (Mindscape) 1
yanagi.desc: When any squad member inflicts an Anomalia on an enemy, Yanagi gains 1 stack of Clarity, lasting 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon being hit by an enemy Ataque, Yanagi consumes 1 stack of Clarity to gain invulnerability for 1s. When Yanagi has 1 or more stacks of Clarity, her Proficiência de Anomalia increases by 80.

yanagi.name: M2 Outstanding Adaptability Cinema (Mindscape) 2
yanagi.desc: During her Ataque Especial EX, the rapid thrust's Electric Anomalia Buildup increases by 20%. Holding down the Ataque Especial button after a rapid thrust hits an enemy will consume 10 additional Energy to launch another thrust. If Energy is insufficient or the button is released, the Ataque automatically follows up with the downward Ataque. When the downward Ataque hits an enemy suffering an Anomalia and triggers Polarity Disorder, the DMG multiplier increases to 20% of the original Disorder effect. Each additional thrust increases this multiplier by 15%, up to a maximum of 2 extra thrusts.

yanagi.name: M3 Tsukishiro Style Management Cinema (Mindscape) 3
yanagi.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

yanagi.name: M4 Chessmaster Cinema (Mindscape) 4
yanagi.desc: When Yanagi inflicts Attribute Anomalia DMG on an enemy, they suffer the Exposed effect, lasting 15s. Attacks on enemies under the Expose effect will have 16% increased Perfuração Ratio.

yanagi.name: M5 Other Mother Cinema (Mindscape) 5
yanagi.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

yanagi.name: M6 Inhuman Blood Cinema (Mindscape) 6
yanagi.desc: After a thrust Ataque during her Ataque Especial EX, the duration of the Shinrabanshou state increases to 30s. While the state is active and her Ataque Especial EX DMG increases by 20%. The maximum number of times the additional DMG multiplier increase effect for Polarity Disorder in Outstanding Adaptability can be triggered increases to 4, and the Energy cost for the first 4 additional thrust attacks is halved.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Básico: Swiftedge
yeshunguang.desc: Press to activate: Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Dano Físico. Can be chained into Dash Ataque: Phantasm Dash after the 4th hit.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Básico: Cloudstream Sword Will
yeshunguang.desc: Hold to activate: Launches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing Dano Físico. Hold to extend the Ataque. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents
yeshunguang.desc: While in the Enlightened Mind state and on the ground, press to activate: Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing Dano Físico. If struck by an enemy Ataque during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG. If she possesses Qingming Sword Force, the 3rd hit is replaced with Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
yeshunguang.desc: While in the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, after the 2nd hit of Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents, press to activate: Launches a swift rising Ataque, dealing Dano Físico and entering an airborne state. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
yeshunguang.desc: After activating Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation, and with Qingming Sword Force, press to activate: Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive Dano Físico. On hit, 1 point of Qingming Sword Force is consumed. If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. After using this skill and with Qingming Sword Force, press to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of Ataque Especial EX: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light. This skill is automatically followed up with Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight
yeshunguang.desc: In the Enlightened Mind state, and while airborne, press to activate: Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing Dano Físico. Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill. Press or to follow up with Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
yeshunguang.desc: After the 2nd hit of Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight, press to activate: Performs a falling Ataque in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing Dano Físico. When launching this skill with 2 or more points of Qingming Sword Force, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive Dano Físico. On hit, 2 points of Qingming Sword Force are consumed, granting the Culmination effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses Qingming Sword Force, press to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of Ataque Especial EX: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, which can be quickly followed up with Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum. Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill. During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Culmination
yeshunguang.desc: During Ataque Especial EX: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, each time Qingming Sword Force is consumed while Culmination is active, the Qingming Sword Force cost is replaced by consuming Culmination instead. This effect does not stack, and lasts until the current Enlightened Mind ends.

yeshunguang.name: Esquiva: Leave No Trace
yeshunguang.desc: Press to activate: A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill. During the Enlightened Mind state, and if a Perfect Esquiva is triggered, press to activate Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

yeshunguang.name: Esquiva: Wandering Cloud
yeshunguang.desc: While tilting the stick/joystick, hold to activate. Enters a high-speed movement state. Steer with the stick/joystick, and release the stick/joystick to stop.

yeshunguang.name: Dash Ataque: Phantasm Dash
yeshunguang.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Slashes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

yeshunguang.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Swallow Strike
yeshunguang.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate: Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Especial: Guiding Tides
yeshunguang.desc: Press to activate: If a Esquiva is available, 1 Esquiva chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Esquiva. If no Esquiva is available or a Perfect Esquiva is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy Ataque that deals Dano Físico. If a Perfect Esquiva is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword Ataque, dealing Dano Físico, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of Ataque Básico: Swiftedge. Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Especial EX: Gale Suppression
yeshunguang.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate: Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword Ataque at the enemy, dealing massive Dano Físico. Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill. After this skill is used, gain 1 point of Qingming Sword Force. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Especial: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit
yeshunguang.desc: While in the Enlightened Mind state and grounded, press to activate: Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing Dano Físico. If a Esquiva is available, 1 Esquiva chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Esquiva. If a Perfect Esquiva is triggered at this time, press to quickly activate Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum and enter Vital View. After this Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum activates, it can be immediately followed up with Ataque Básico: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Especial EX: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light
yeshunguang.desc: In the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, hold to activate: Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive Dano Físico while rapidly consuming Qingming Sword Force until none remains. The skill ends early if Qingming Sword Force is insufficient or if is released. Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque Especial EX: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust
yeshunguang.desc: In the Enlightened Mind state, press or hold when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate: Deals massive Dano Físico to enemies in a large area. Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill. After using this skill, Ether Veil: Verdict is removed and the Enlightened Mind state ends. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Smite the Wicked
yeshunguang.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder
yeshunguang.desc: While in the Enlightened Mind state, and when a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Dano Físico. Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill. Enter the airborne state after using this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Chasing Storms
yeshunguang.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Summons a sword formation and enter the Enlightened Mind state, activating an Ether Veil: Verdict while also gaining 6 Qingming Sword Force. This skill deals massive Dano Físico. Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press while in this Enlightened Mind state to launch an Suprema (Ultimate): Cleaving Heavens that doesn't consume Decibels. Enter the airborne state after using this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Cleaving Heavens
yeshunguang.desc: After consuming Decibels to launch Suprema (Ultimate): Chasing Storms and while in the Enlightened Mind state, press or hold when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate: Summons a massive blade, dealing massive Dano Físico to enemies. Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill. After using this skill, the Enlightened Mind state ends, and Ether Veil: Verdict is removed. This skill doesn't consume Decibels. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque de Suporte: Cease Hostility
yeshunguang.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Deals massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Ataque de Suporte: Enlightened Mind - Unification
yeshunguang.desc: While in the Enlightened Mind state and after a Suporte Defensivo, press to activate: Deals massive Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness
yeshunguang.desc: With 6 Qingming Sword Force and while not in the Enlightened Mind state, hold to activate, or press while in combat and switch on-field from off-field to activate: Enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict. Deals Dano Físico to enemies in a large area in front. Activating this skill is considered as activating a Suporte Rápido. Enters the airborne state after using this skill. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Suporte Defensivo: When I Return
yeshunguang.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Suporte Rápido: Suporte Guard
yeshunguang.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Suporte Rápido: Enlightened Mind - Tactical Suporte
yeshunguang.desc: While in the Enlightened Mind state, when the active character is launched, press to activate. Launches a forward slash, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yeshunguang.name: Passiva de Núcleo Burning Clarity
yeshunguang.desc: Lv. 1

yeshunguang.name: Habilidade Adicional Shadowtrace Flight
yeshunguang.desc: When another character in your squad is a Suporte or Defesa character:When a squadmate activates any Ether Veil, gain 3 points of Qingming Sword Force. If already in the Enlightened Mind state, this is instead converted into 3 stacks of Bearer.

yeshunguang.name: M1 Dreambound Self Cinema (Mindscape) 1
yeshunguang.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 6 Qingming Sword Force. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The Unity effect from Passiva de Núcleo: Burning Clarity increases DMG dealt by an additional 10%, and they ignore 20% of the target's DEF.

yeshunguang.name: M2 Light & Shadow Cinema (Mindscape) 2
yeshunguang.desc: The max stack count of Bearer increases to 6, and Culmination can stack up to 9 times; While in the Enlightened Mind state, each point of Qingming Sword Force consumed grants 1 stack of Culmination. Ataque Especial EX: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light and Suprema (Ultimate): Cleaving Heavens's DMG ignores 40% of the target's DEF.

yeshunguang.name: M3 Swordswoman Cinema (Mindscape) 3
yeshunguang.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

yeshunguang.name: M4 Together into the Dust Cinema (Mindscape) 4
yeshunguang.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. The Vulnerability bonus provided by Ether Veil: Verdict is increased to a maximum of 200%.

yeshunguang.name: M5 Guiding Glimmer Cinema (Mindscape) 5
yeshunguang.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

yeshunguang.name: M6 Lantern Wish Cinema (Mindscape) 6
yeshunguang.desc: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of Lantern Wish. When entering the Enlightened Mind state, gains 1 stack of Lantern Wish, stacking up to 4 times. With 3 stacks of Lantern Wish, Ataque Especial EX: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust is replaced with Suprema (Ultimate): Cleaving Heavens. When this Suprema (Ultimate): Cleaving Heavens is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of Lantern Wish. The last hit of Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust and Suprema (Ultimate): Cleaving Heavens deal 1,500% of ATK as additional Dano Físico.

yidhari.name: Ataque Básico: Crushing Strike
yidhari.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Dano de Gelo. On the 3rd hit, Yidhari recovers 10% HP.

yidhari.name: Ataque Básico: Frostbite Embrace
yidhari.desc: Hold to activate: Yidhari begins charging, continuously consuming HP to reach up to three levels of charge. When is released, Yidhari unleashes a powerful charged hammer Ataque in front based on the current charge level, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. The higher Yidhari's HP, the faster charging consumes it. HP consumption will at most reduce Yidhari's HP to 25% of Max HP. At 2 charge levels, after using the skill, press to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Ataque Básico: Crushing Strike. The DMG of a Ataque Básico: Crushing Strike triggered this way increases based on the current charge level, up to 30%. At 3 charge levels, Yidhari gains increased Anti-Interrupt level during the charged skill. Press to chain early into the finishing smash.

yidhari.name: Frost's Crushing Weight
yidhari.desc: While charging or spinning during Ataque Básico: Frostbite Embrace, if hit by an enemy, Yidhari can block with her tentacles, reducing the DMG taken by 25%. If charging or not yet at full charge, Yidhari counterattacks with her tentacles, returning to the charging stance and instantly gaining 1 charge level, while also dealing Dano de Gelo to enemies ahead. While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing makes Yidhari immediately unleash the finishing slam of Ataque Básico: Frostbite Embrace based on her current charge level. While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing or makes Yidhari unleash a Ataque Especial: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit that is guaranteed to trigger Surging Cold.

yidhari.name: Esquiva: Dreamshift
yidhari.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yidhari.name: Dash Ataque: Frostbloom Impacto
yidhari.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Strike forward, dealing Dano de Gelo.

yidhari.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Icehaul Reverb
yidhari.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yidhari.name: Ataque Especial: Cease Thoughts
yidhari.desc: Press to activate. Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Dano de Gelo. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

yidhari.name: Ataque Especial EX: Frost Coil
yidhari.desc: With enough Adrenaline, press to activate. Perform two consecutive upward strikes, then release an icy mist, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. If Ataque Especial EX: Frost Coil hits an enemy, Yidhari recovers HP at the end of the skill equal to 33% of her missing HP. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yidhari.name: Ataque Especial: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit
yidhari.desc: Press or while charging or spinning during Ataque Básico: Frostbite Embrace, or press while holding to activate: Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Dano de Gelo. When the skill's Ataque collides with an enemy's Ataque, it triggers Surging Cold. If the skill hits a Stunned enemy, and with sufficient Adrenaline, it triggers Crushing Pursuit. Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit instantly raises the charge level to maximum. During this skill, press and Yidhari will immediately unleash the finishing slam of Ataque Básico: Frostbite Embrace based on the current charge level. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

yidhari.name: Ataque Especial EX: Glacial Crush
yidhari.desc: When triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit, and with enough Adrenaline, press or to activate.Dash forward with an upward Ataque, then leap into the air before delivering a powerful downward smash, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. If Ataque Especial EX: Glacial Crush hits an enemy, Yidhari heals at the end of the skill for 33% of her missing HP. If the skill is used after Surging Cold, it grants an additional 15 Adrenaline. This effect can trigger once every 1s. After using this skill, press to immediately unleash the finishing slam of Ataque Básico: Frostbite Embrace based on the current charge level. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yidhari.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Frostbound Oath
yidhari.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleash a powerful strike against enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. If inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, tentacles join in the assault, further enhancing the skill's power. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yidhari.name: Ether Veil: Wellspring
yidhari.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, the final hit of Ataque Básico: Frostbite Embrace, Ataque Especial EX: Frost Coil, Ataque Especial EX: Glacial Crush, and Ataque em Cadeia: Frostbound Oath will consume 3,000 Decibels to activate an Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5% for 30s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a maximum of 300s. While Yidhari is within Ether Veil: Wellspring, the charge speed of Ataque Básico: Frostbite Embrace increases, and HP is consumed faster during charging.

yidhari.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret
yidhari.desc: After Yidhari expends Decibels to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring, press within 30s to activate: Deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike. Each time Yidhari expends Decibels to activate an Ether Veil: Wellspring, she can use Suprema (Ultimate): Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret once.

yidhari.name: Ataque de Suporte: Glacial Onslaught
yidhari.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Execute an ice shard hammer Ataque against enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yidhari.name: Suporte Defensivo: Flashquake Rejection
yidhari.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yidhari.name: Suporte Rápido: Frostshock Reinforcement
yidhari.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yidhari.name: Passiva de Núcleo Dreamscape Collection
yidhari.desc: Lv. 1

yidhari.name: Habilidade Adicional Narrative Completion
yidhari.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun) or Suporte character:When Yidhari's HP falls below 50%, Dano Crítico increases by 30% and DMG taken is reduced by 25%.While Yidhari is within Ether Veil: Wellspring, she gains the following additional effect:After the level 3 charged Ataque of Yidhari's Ataque Básico: Frostbite Embrace or Ataque Especial EX: Glacial Crush, an icy tentacle is summoned to Ataque, dealing extra damage. This effect can trigger once every 12s.The above skill is considered an Ataque Especial EX, the DMG multiplier increases based on the Ataque Especial EX's level.

yidhari.name: M1 The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss Cinema (Mindscape) 1
yidhari.desc: The Adrenaline cost to activate Yidhari's Ataque Especial EX is reduced by 10. After using Ataque Especial EX: Frost Coil or Ataque Especial EX: Glacial Crush, keeping hold of the Ataque Básico or Ataque Especial button consumes 35 Adrenaline to forgo healing and immediately chain into another Ataque Especial EX: Glacial Crush. The HP restored by this Ataque Especial EX: Glacial Crush is increased by 100% of the original value. Yidhari's Basic Attacks and EX Special Attacks ignore 20% of targets' Ice RES.

yidhari.name: M2 Who Lingers Here, Lost in Thought? Cinema (Mindscape) 2
yidhari.desc: Yidhari's Dano Crítico increases by 40%. Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit grants Adrenaline regen of 0.5/s for up to 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

yidhari.name: M3 A Story Without an Audience Cinema (Mindscape) 3
yidhari.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

yidhari.name: M4 Blooming in Silence Cinema (Mindscape) 4
yidhari.desc: Yidhari gains 10% more Decibels when losing HP for Passiva de Núcleo: Dreamscape Collection. While in Ether Veil: Wellspring, Yidhari's Max HP is further increased by 5%.

yidhari.name: M5 This Solace Is Real Cinema (Mindscape) 5
yidhari.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

yidhari.name: M6 At Last, a Peaceful Dream Cinema (Mindscape) 6
yidhari.desc: After Yidhari spends Decibels to activate or extend Ether Veil: Wellspring, she gains Erudition for 30s. While Erudition is active, her Sheer DMG increases by 25%. Also, upon taking fatal DMG for the first time, her HP is reduced to at most 1, and for the next 5s, she cannot be defeated and will restore 25% HP over time.

yixuan.name: Ataque Básico: Cirrus Strike
