yixuan.desc: Press to activate: Perform up to five attacks forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG. This skill's Anti-Interrupt Level increases during the 3rd and 4th hit.

yixuan.name: Ataque Básico: Ink‐Veil Cloud Coalescence
yixuan.desc: Hold to activate: Deploy a Grand Tai Chi Formation, dealing Auric Ink DMG. When the skill ends, automatically launch the 5th hit of Ataque Básico: Cirrus Strike. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

yixuan.name: Ataque Básico: Auric Array
yixuan.desc: With Auric Ink Point, activate Esquiva: Nimbus Step, then tap , or with Auric Ink Point, hold to activate: Deploy an array, continuously dealing Auric Ink DMG. When the skill ends, it automatically triggers Ataque Básico: Qingming Eruption. While channeling, continuously recover Adrenaline, recovering 7/s, for up to 3s. Character is invulnerable while using this skill, and enters the Vital View state.

yixuan.name: Ataque Básico: Qingming Eruption
yixuan.desc: Automatically activates when Ataque Básico: Auric Array reaches the max duration: Spreads her wings to launch an explosive Ataque, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Esquiva: Hidden Cloud Technique
yixuan.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Dash Ataque: Skybreaker
yixuan.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Launch a dashing Ataque at enemies in front, dealing Auric Ink DMG.

yixuan.name: Esquiva: Nimbus Step
yixuan.desc: When dragging the stick/joystick, hold to activate. Enter a high‐speed Light as Air state. While in the Light as Air state, automatically collect from all resource pickup points within range. While in the Light as Air state, use the stick/joystick to steer. Release the stick/joystick to stop. Character is invulnerable at the moment this skill activates.

yixuan.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Banishing Blow
yixuan.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing Auric Ink DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Ataque Especial: Shadow-Ignition
yixuan.desc: Press to activate. Swiftly retreat, then Ataque forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG. While retreating, a Perfect Esquiva can be triggered, but cannot be followed up with a Contra-ataque de Esquiva. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Ataque Especial EX: Ink Manifestation
yixuan.desc: With enough Adrenaline, press or hold to activate. Charge continuously, and release to launch an upward wing Ataque, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG; While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing Ataque; If hit at the exact moment of activation, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Suporte Defensivo, and recovering 10 Adrenaline; When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Suporte Defensivo, and recovering 10 Adrenaline; The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s; If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing Ataque can be followed by an additional Talisman Ataque; After using this skill, press to launch [Ataque Especial EX: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break]; After [Ataque Especial EX: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break], and with enough Adrenaline, press to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch [Ataque Especial EX: Qingming Eruption - Break]; After [Ataque Especial EX: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break], with enough [Auric Ink Point], hold to quickly chain into [Ataque Básico: Auric Array]; Character is invulnerable when activating this skill, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.

yixuan.name: Ataque Especial EX: Cloud-Shaper
yixuan.desc: With enough Adrenaline, hold to activate. Continuously charge up, channeling energy around enemies to deal damage over time, up to a max of 2s, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG. Once fully charged or if interrupted, automatically trigger Ataque Especial EX: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows. At the moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Esquiva can be triggered, and then enter the Vital View state. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Ataque Especial EX: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows
yixuan.desc: Triggers automatically during Ataque Especial EX: Cloud-Shaper: When the energy orb appears and collapses, it deals Auric Ink DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Auric Ink Rush
yixuan.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Rapidly dash forward and Ataque, followed by an explosive wing burst, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Qingming Skyshade
yixuan.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Launch a barrage of wing attacks, then guide countless talismans to Ataque, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG; Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP; After using this skill, if Auric Ink Point is sufficient, hold to quickly chain into Ataque Básico: Auric Array; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Endless Talisman Suppression
yixuan.desc: With enough Technique Points, press to activate. Spreads her wings, then guides countless talismans to Ataque, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG; With both enough Technique Points and Decibels, this skill triggers with priority; After using this skill, if Auric Ink Point is sufficient, hold to quickly chain into [Ataque Básico: Auric Array]; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Ataque de Suporte: Celestial Cloud Blitz
yixuan.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Quickly dash forward and Ataque, dealing Auric Ink DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Suporte Defensivo: Clear Sky Surge
yixuan.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Suporte Rápido: Cloudstream Shadow
yixuan.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing Auric Ink DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yixuan.name: Passiva de Núcleo Grandmaster of Mysticism
yixuan.desc: Lv. 1

yixuan.name: Habilidade Adicional Auric Ink Undercurrent
yixuan.desc: When another character in your squad is a Atordoamento (Stun), Suporte, or Defesa character:When a squad member uses an Suprema (Ultimate), Yixuan continuously recovers 2 Adrenaline over 10s. If Yixuan is switched out by a Perfect Assist, she automatically follows up with a lightning strike Ataque, dealing DMG equal to 225% of her Sheer Force and restoring an additional 5 Adrenaline.Ataque Especial EX: Cloud-Shaper and Ataque Especial EX: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows deal 30% increased DMG to Stunned enemies.After activating her Suprema (Ultimate), Yixuan enters the Meditation state, increasing her Dano Crítico by 40% for 15s.

yixuan.name: M1 Spiritual Path Cinema (Mindscape) 1
yixuan.desc: Upon entering combat, Taxa Crítica increases by 10% and immediately gain 120 Technique Points. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. When any squad member lands a hit on an enemy, Yixuan automatically summons an extra lightning strike, dealing DMG equal to 50% of her Sheer Force and restoring 5 additional Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 6s.

yixuan.name: M2 Ward Off Misfortune Cinema (Mindscape) 2
yixuan.desc: When an Suprema (Ultimate) or Ataque Especial EX deals DMG, it ignores 15% of the target's Ether RES; Triggering Suprema (Ultimate): Qingming Skyshade extends all enemies' Stunned state by 3s, enemies can only be affected by this effect once per Stunned state, and similar effects cannot stack; Additionally, when using Suprema (Ultimate): Endless Talisman Suppression, gain one stack of Condensed Ink effect. After Ataque Básico: Qingming Eruption or Ataque Especial EX: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows, press the Ataque Básico button, or after Ataque Especial EX: Qingming Eruption - Break, press the Ataque Especial button to launch Ataque Especial EX: Endless Talisman Suppression - Break, dealing DMG up to 1,200% of Sheer Force. Only one stack of Condensed Ink can be held at a time.

yixuan.name: M3 Cycle of Yin and Yang Cinema (Mindscape) 3
yixuan.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

yixuan.name: M4 The One Path of Mysticism Cinema (Mindscape) 4
yixuan.desc: Activating an Suprema (Ultimate) grants one stack of Tranquillity, up to a max of 2 stacks. For each stack of Tranquillity, the next Ataque Especial EX: Cloud-Shaper DMG and Ataque Especial EX: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows DMG increase by 30%.

yixuan.name: M5 Calm Sky Vigil Cinema (Mindscape) 5
yixuan.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

yixuan.name: M6 Swift Yet Still Cinema (Mindscape) 6
yixuan.desc: After using Suprema (Ultimate): Qingming Skyshade, gain a stack of the Regulated Breathing effect. While under this effect, you can ignore the Technique Point cost to launch Suprema (Ultimate): Endless Talisman Suppression once. The Regulated Breathing effect ends after Suprema (Ultimate): Endless Talisman Suppression is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s. Only one stack of Regulated Breathing can be held. Additionally, while in the Meditation state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.

yuzuha.name: Ataque Básico: Tanuki Claws
yuzuha.desc: Press to activate: Unleashes up to 5 strikes ahead, dealing Dano Físico.

yuzuha.name: Ataque Básico: Tanuki Cloak
yuzuha.desc: Hold to activate: Enter a defensive stance for up to 1.5 seconds. If hit during this time, parry the Ataque and inflict massive Atordoamento (Daze) against the attacking enemy. Successfully parrying an Ataque grants 1 Sugar Points. Character is invulnerable when successfully parrying.

yuzuha.name: Ataque Básico: Hard Candy Shot
yuzuha.desc: When Yuzuha has Sugar Points, landing a hit with other active characters' attacks will have Yuzuha continuously twirl her umbrella and Ataque centered around the target before launching a powerful shell, dealing Dano Físico. When this Ataque lands a heavy Ataque, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point. Ataque Básico: Hard Candy Shot is considered an Aftershock. Ataque Básico: Hard Candy Shot can be triggered once every 8s. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles
yuzuha.desc: Enemies under the effect of Sweet Scare will be attacked by a Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles once every 1s. Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles initially deals Dano Físico. Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomalia Buildup toward Anomalia DMG calculation. Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles Anomalia Buildup Rate increases.

yuzuha.name: Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max
yuzuha.desc: Enemies affected by Sweet Scare will be attacked by a Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max when hit with a heavy Ataque from Ataque Básico: Hard Candy Shot or Ataque de Suporte: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot. Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max initially deals Dano Físico. Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomalia Buildup toward Anomalia DMG calculation. Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max Anomalia Buildup Rate increases.

yuzuha.name: Ataque Básico: Tanuki Helper
yuzuha.desc: When Yuzuha is off-field, tanuki Kama assists the active character in attacking enemies, dealing Dano Físico. When Yuzuha performs Ataque Básico: Tanuki Cloak, tanuki Kama joins her in attacking the enemy, dealing Dano Físico. Tanuki Kama inherits Yuzuha's initial ATK.

yuzuha.name: Esquiva: Did I Scare You?
yuzuha.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Dash Ataque: You're Outta Luck!
yuzuha.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico.

yuzuha.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Time for Payback~
yuzuha.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Ataque Especial: Gummy Bombardment
yuzuha.desc: Press to activate. Fire a cannon shot forward, dealing Dano Físico.

yuzuha.name: Ataque Especial EX: Cavity Alert
yuzuha.desc: With enough Energy, press to activate. Throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Dano Físico; Upon hitting an enemy with a heavy Ataque, it inflicts the [Sweet Scare] state; Gain 2 [Sugar Points] upon activation; A [Suporte Rápido] is triggered when this skill hits an enemy; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Ataque Especial EX: Cavity Alert, Right Now!
yuzuha.desc: After using [Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Time for Payback~], [Suporte Rápido: Dessert Time], [Ataque de Suporte: We Have Cookies], or [Ataque de Suporte: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot], or when a [Perfect Esquiva] is triggered, press to activate. Quickly throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing Dano Físico; On hitting an enemy with a heavy Ataque, it inflicts the [Sweet Scare] state; Gain 2 [Sugar Points] upon activation; A [Suporte Rápido] is triggered when this skill hits an enemy; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Sweet Scare
yuzuha.desc: The Sweet Scare state lasts for specified duration, repeated triggers reset the duration. When an enemy affected by Sweet Scare is first hit by an active character using an Ataque of their attribute, Flavor Match is triggered against that enemy, changing the attribute of Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles and Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max against that enemy to match that of the character who triggered Flavor Match. When Sweet Scare is triggered again on an enemy, their existing Flavor Match state is removed. The process can be repeated to change the attribute of Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles and Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max again.

yuzuha.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Prank Assault
yuzuha.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Dano Físico; Gain 1 Sugar Points when used; A Suporte Rápido is triggered when this skill hits an enemy; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Surrender or Suffer the Mischief
yuzuha.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a large area around the character, dealing massive Dano Físico; Enemies hit with a heavy Ataque are inflicted with the Sweet Scare state; Upon activating this skill, other squad members gain Energy; Upon activating this skill, gain 2 Sugar Points; A Suporte Rápido is triggered when this skill hits an enemy; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Ataque de Suporte: We Have Cookies
yuzuha.desc: After triggering a Suporte Defensivo or successfully parrying an enemy Ataque with Ataque Básico: Tanuki Cloak, press activate: Strike enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Ataque de Suporte: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot
yuzuha.desc: After triggering a Suporte Defensivo or successfully parrying an enemy Ataque with Ataque Básico: Tanuki Cloak, press at the right moment to activate: Following a continuous spinning umbrella Ataque, fire a powerful projectile that deals Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Suporte Defensivo: Replenish Your Fun
yuzuha.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). Upon a successful parry, gain 1 Sugar Points; Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Suporte Rápido: Dessert Time
yuzuha.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Strike enemies in front, dealing Dano Físico. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

yuzuha.name: Passiva de Núcleo Whimsical Wonder
yuzuha.desc: Lv. 1

yuzuha.name: Habilidade Adicional The More the Merrier
yuzuha.desc: When another character in your squad is an Anomalia character or shares the same Faction:If Yuzuha's Maestria de Anomalia exceeds 100, every point over increases the Anomalia Buildup Rate of characters with Tanuki Wish by 0.2%, up to a maximum of 20%, and all Attribute Anomalia DMG and Disorder DMG by 0.2%, up to a maximum of 20%. When Yuzuha's Maestria de Anomalia is at 200, she grants the full buff effect.

yuzuha.name: M1 Lucky Constitution Cinema (Mindscape) 1
yuzuha.desc: Yuzuha regains 30 Energy when she enters the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180s. Enemies in the Sweet Scare state have their All-Attribute RES reduced by 10%. The Attribute Anomalia DMG and Disorder DMG buff from her Habilidade Adicional is increased to 130% of its original value.

yuzuha.name: M2 Full of Colorful Company Cinema (Mindscape) 2
yuzuha.desc: When Yuzuha's [Ataque Especial EX: Cavity Alert], [Ataque Especial EX: Cavity Alert, Right Now!], or [Suprema (Ultimate): Surrender or Suffer the Mischief] hits an enemy, all squad members' DMG increases by 15% and Anomalia Buildup Rate by 15%, lasting 40s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When a heavy Ataque hits an enemy that is not Stunned, it will trigger a forced [Ataque em Cadeia]. [Chain Attacks] triggered this way have reduced Interrupt Level and forced [Chain Attacks] can only occur once every 20s; whenever another character enters through a [Ataque em Cadeia], Yuzuha gains 1 [Sugar Points]; Yuzuha's [Ataque Básico: Hard Candy Shot] cooldown is reduced by 25%.

yuzuha.name: M3 Fairytale of the Haunted City Cinema (Mindscape) 3
yuzuha.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

yuzuha.name: M4 Falling Magic Cinema (Mindscape) 4
yuzuha.desc: The DMG of Yuzuha's Ataque de Suporte: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot and Ataque de Suporte: We Have Cookies increases by 30%, Anomalia Buildup Rate by 20%, and triggers a Suporte Rápido when it hits an enemy.

yuzuha.name: M5 Dreams of a Fading Winter Cinema (Mindscape) 5
yuzuha.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

yuzuha.name: M6 Put Down Roots Cinema (Mindscape) 6
yuzuha.desc: Gain 1 additional Sugar Points when successfully parrying an enemy Ataque using a Suporte Defensivo or Ataque Básico: Tanuki Cloak. When using Ataque de Suporte: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot, hold Normal Ataque to charge for up to 0.8 seconds.Releasing Normal Ataque or reaching full charge fires an extra powerful shell at the enemy. For every 0.4s charged, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point to fire an additional powerful shell, each dealing 300% of her ATK as Dano Físico. If any powerful shell from Ataque de Suporte: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot hits an enemy, all squad members' Disorder DMG Multiplier increases by 105% for 40s, and stacking up to 3 times, with each stack duration being calculated separately. In addition, if the powerful shell hits an enemy under Sweet Scare, it'll trigger 1 Ataque Básico: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max Ataque. If Yuzuha is attacked while charging, she will automatically Esquiva the Ataque and immediately unleash the max-charged Ataque.

zhao.name: Ataque Básico: Glacial Judgment
zhao.desc: Press to activate: Launches up to five slashes forward, the first dealing Dano Físico, and the following four Dano de Gelo.

zhao.name: Ataque Básico: Final Verdict
zhao.desc: Hold to activate: After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of Ataque Básico: Final Verdict, Ataque em Cadeia, or Ataque de Suporte hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals some of Max HP as additional DMG. When Zhao is in any Ether Veil, if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue. If Frostbite Points are maxed out when the skill activates, all Frostbite Points are consumed to trigger Ether Veil: Wellspring and a Suporte Rápido. If a squadmate is then switched in via Suporte Rápido, Zhao automatically follows up with Ataque Básico: Final Verdict and begins charging. During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhao.name: Esquiva: Bunny Hop
zhao.desc: Press to activate. A quick dash Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhao.name: Dash Ataque: Bouncing Dash
zhao.desc: Press during a Esquiva to activate: Slashes forward, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Gelo.

zhao.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Swift Blink
zhao.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Performs a falling slash ahead, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhao.name: Ataque Especial: Shatterfrost Surge
zhao.desc: Press to activate. Launches a forward slash, dealing Dano de Gelo. Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to 1.1-2% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Ataque Especial: Shatterfrost Surge and Ataque Especial EX: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s.

zhao.name: Ataque Especial EX: Frostflow Tundra
zhao.desc: With enough energy, press to activate. Launches multiple forward slashes, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to 1.1-2% of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of Ataque Especial: Shatterfrost Surge and Ataque Especial EX: Frostflow Tundra can trigger at most once every 30s. Upon activating this skill, gain 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring. Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Suporte Rápido is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Suporte Rápido, Zhao automatically follows up with Ataque Básico: Final Verdict and begins charging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhao.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Temporary Alliance
zhao.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Launches multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. After using this skill, gains 5 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring. Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Suporte Rápido is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Suporte Rápido, Zhao automatically follows up with Ataque Básico: Final Verdict and begins charging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhao.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Bunny Barrage
zhao.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate: Launches consecutive attacks in front, followed by a falling slash, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. After using this skill, gains 20 Frostbite Points. If Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring. Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Suporte Rápido is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Suporte Rápido, Zhao automatically follows up with Ataque Básico: Final Verdict and begins charging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhao.name: Ataque de Suporte: Frostlight Reflection
zhao.desc: Press after a Suporte Defensivo to activate: Launch multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Upon activating this skill, if Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring. Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Suporte Rápido is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Suporte Rápido, Zhao automatically follows up with Ataque Básico: Final Verdict and begins charging. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhao.name: Entry Skill: Burst of Frost
zhao.desc: When Zhao has maximum Frostbite Points, and is in combat, press to activate. Launches consecutive attacks forward, followed by a slash, dealing massive Dano de Gelo. Upon activating this skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring. Upon activating this skill, a Suporte Rápido is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Suporte Rápido, Zhao automatically follows up with Ataque Básico: Final Verdict and begins charging. Activating this skill is considered as activating a Suporte Rápido. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhao.name: Suporte Defensivo: Frostveil Suppression
zhao.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Parries the enemy's Ataque, dealing massive Atordoamento (Daze). This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhao.name: Suporte Rápido: Patch the Gaps
zhao.desc: When the active character is launched, press to activate. Launches a falling slash in front, dealing Dano de Gelo. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhao.name: Passiva de Núcleo Ideal Colleague
zhao.desc: Lv. 1

zhao.name: Habilidade Adicional Crystallization
zhao.desc: When another character in your squad is an Ataque, Anomalia, or Suporte character:When Zhao is within any Ether Veil, the whole squad's DMG increases by 10%. If Zhao's initial Max HP exceeds 15,000, every additional 400 initial Max HP increases this DMG bonus by an additional 1%, up to a total maximum increase of 40%. This bonus reaches its maximum when Zhao's initial Max HP reaches 27,000.

zhao.name: M1 Righteous Verdict Cinema (Mindscape) 1
zhao.desc: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.

zhao.name: M2 Krampus Senior Cinema (Mindscape) 2
zhao.desc: When Zhao recovers HP, her ATK increases by 20%, and other squad members' ATK increases by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

zhao.name: M3 Frostveil Edge Cinema (Mindscape) 3
zhao.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

zhao.name: M4 Featherlight Footsteps Cinema (Mindscape) 4
zhao.desc: When Zhao activates an Ether Veil, she gains 250 Decibels. The Dano Crítico of her Suprema (Ultimate), Ataque em Cadeia, and Ataque Básico: Final Verdict increase by 40%.

zhao.name: M5 Fuzzy Listener Cinema (Mindscape) 5
zhao.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

zhao.name: M6 No Value Has Its Own Value Cinema (Mindscape) 6
zhao.desc: The Taxa Crítica buff from Passiva de Núcleo: Ideal Colleague increases to 125% of the original value. The extra DMG gained from charging during Ataque Básico: Final Verdict increases to 140% of the original value, and accumulated charge time is no longer consumed when attacking.

zhuyuan.name: Ataque Básico: Don't Move!
zhuyuan.desc: [Assault Mode] Press to activate: Unleash a flurry of martial arts, bullets, and Ether Buckshots in a series of up to 5 attacks, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Éter. When the 4th or 5th hits strike an enemy, obtain 1 Enhanced Shotshell. A max of 1 can be obtained per skill use. While using this skill, drag the stick/joystick and press to activate Dash Ataque: Firepower Offensive and readjust to face the selected direction. While under Assault Mode, hold to switch to Suppressive Mode.

zhuyuan.name: Ataque Básico: Please Do Not Resist
zhuyuan.desc: [Suppressive Mode] Hold to activate. Unleash up to 3 Shotshell piercing attacks, dealing Dano Físico. If Zhu Yuan has Enhanced Shotshells upon firing, 1 Enhanced Shotshell will be consumed, dealing massive Dano de Éter. While using this skill, drag the stick/joystick to activate her Dash Ataque: Overwhelming Firepower and readjust to face the selected direction. While in Suppressive Mode, release to return to Assault Mode.

zhuyuan.name: Esquiva: Tactical Detour
zhuyuan.desc: Press to activate:. A rapid Esquiva. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhuyuan.name: Dash Ataque: Firepower Offensive
zhuyuan.desc: [Assault Mode] Press during a Esquiva to activate: Uses handgun to Ataque, dealing Dano Físico.

zhuyuan.name: Contra-ataque de Esquiva: Fire Blast
zhuyuan.desc: Press during a Perfect Esquiva to activate. Shoots enemies in front with an Ether Buckshot, dealing Dano de Éter. Gain 1 Enhanced Shotshell on skill use. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhuyuan.name: Dash Ataque: Overwhelming Firepower
zhuyuan.desc: Suppressive Mode Drag the joystick/joystickduring Ataque Básico: Please Do Not Resist to activate: Unleashes a Shotshell piercing Ataque, dealing Dano Físico. If Zhu Yuan has Enhanced Shotshells when firing, 1 Enhanced Shotshell will be consumed, dealing massive Dano de Éter.

zhuyuan.name: Ataque Especial: Buckshot Blast
zhuyuan.desc: Press to activate: Shoots Ether Buckshots that deal Dano de Éter. This can be repeated 3 times by repeatedly pressing . Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

zhuyuan.name: Ataque Especial EX: Full Barrage
zhuyuan.desc: With enough energy, press to activate: Shoots a series of Ether Buckshots, that explode and deal massive Dano de Éter. Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhuyuan.name: Ataque em Cadeia: Eradication Mode
zhuyuan.desc: When a Ataque em Cadeia is triggered, select the character to activate: Uses Modified Master Firearm to execute a saturated Ataque, firing lasers and seeking missiles to deal massive Dano de Éter. Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhuyuan.name: Suprema (Ultimate): Max Eradication Mode
zhuyuan.desc: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate. Uses Modified Master Firearm to execute a saturated Ataque, firing lasers and seeking missiles to deal massive Dano de Éter. Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhuyuan.name: Ataque de Suporte: Defensive Counter
zhuyuan.desc: Press after an Evasive Assist to activate. Ataque with a combination of martial arts and shotshells, dealing Dano Físico and Dano de Éter. Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhuyuan.name: Evasive Assist: Guarded Backup
zhuyuan.desc: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate. Dodges the enemy's Ataque and activates the Vital View. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhuyuan.name: Suporte Rápido: Covering Shot
zhuyuan.desc: When the on-field character is launched, press to activate. Shoots enemies in front with an Ether Buckshot, dealing Dano de Éter. Gain 1 Enhanced Shotshell on skill use. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

zhuyuan.name: Passiva de Núcleo Special Ops Ammunition
zhuyuan.desc: Lv. 1

zhuyuan.name: Habilidade Adicional Tactical Coordination
zhuyuan.desc: When another character in your squad is a Suporte character or shares the same faction:Zhu Yuan's Taxa Crítica is increased by 30% for 10s after using an Ataque Especial EX, Ataque em Cadeia, or Suprema (Ultimate).

zhuyuan.name: M1 Quick Reload Cinema (Mindscape) 1
zhuyuan.desc: When Zhu Yuan activates Chain Attacks/Ultimates, gain the Quick Reload effect. When Zhu Yuan has the Quick Reload effect and uses up all Enhanced Shotshells, the Quick Reload effect will be consumed to instantly gain 6/9 Enhanced Shotshells.

zhuyuan.name: M2 Ether Ember Cinema (Mindscape) 2
zhuyuan.desc: In Suppressive Mode, Zhu Yuan’s Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG taken reduced by 10%. When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, the target takes 10% more Dano de Éter from Ataque Básico: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Ataque: Overwhelming Firepower DMG, stacking up to 5 times and lasting for 5s. Each shot adds one stack of this effect, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

zhuyuan.name: M3 Public Security Special Training Cinema (Mindscape) 3
zhuyuan.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

zhuyuan.name: M4 Ether Perforation Cinema (Mindscape) 4
zhuyuan.desc: When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, her Ataque Básico: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Ataque: Overwhelming Firepower ignore 25% of the target’s Ether RES.

zhuyuan.name: M5 Special Ops Experience Cinema (Mindscape) 5
zhuyuan.desc: Ataque Básico, Assist, Esquiva, Ataque Especial, and Ataque em Cadeia Lv. +2

zhuyuan.name: M6 Expanded Energy Pack III Cinema (Mindscape) 6
zhuyuan.desc: When Zhu Yuan consumes a total of 12 Enhanced Shotshells, she receives the Ether Afterglow effect, and the Energy cost of the next Ataque Especial EX is reduced by 30. Launching an Ataque Especial EX will consume Ether Afterglow and shoot an additional 4-bullet Ether Buckshot. Each extra bullet deals DMG equal to 220% of Zhu Yuan's ATK.
